programme.title: Criminal Spirits: Evolution
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of the 18 season of the series Esprits criminiques
programme.desc-more: At the FBI headquarters in Quantico, Virginia, Agent Aaron Hotchner (Thomas Gibson) is head of the Behavioural Sciences Department, an essential unit dedicated to the analysis of criminal behaviour. This elite group, composed of experienced profilers, is called upon to intervene in homicide cases across the country, in order to understand the motivations of criminals and anticipate their future movements. The team, which is distinguished by its solidarity and efficiency, includes a variety of members with complementary skills. Derek Morgan (Shemar Moore), the impressive physics agent, does not hesitate to use his strength in perilous situations, while Penelope Garcia (Kirsten Vangsness), the computer specialist, shows unparalleled ingenuity to find critical clues. Emily Prentiss (Paget Brewster), who succeeds Hotchner, brings new momentum to the team with his determination and expertise. Together, they confront Machiavellic criminals while navigating the complexities of their own personal lives. Each investigation plunges the team into moral dilemmas and psychological challenges, constantly testing their limits and commitment.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: Marleau investigates the death of a man in a region marked by religious tensions. The case reveals community conflicts and family secrets.
programme.desc-more: In this new season of "Captain Marleau", broadcast in 2020, the famous investigator with flamboyant personality returns with her inimitable style that mixes acerbic humour and sharp intuition. Marleau, interpreted by actress Corinne Masiero, is distinguished by his exaggerated manners and his frankness, but it is above all his sense of the extraordinary deduction that imposes him as one of the most feared detectives. As the episodes progress, we witness the resolution of mysterious murders and complex cases, each investigation being cleverly built around a suspect individual, whom Marleau skilfully hunts. She does not hesitate to interfere with the lives of those she suspects, observing their actions, behaviors and interactions in order to discover the mysteries surrounding them. His ability to decode unsaid and to untrace lies makes him an investigative specialist, capable of reversing the most tense situations. In this season, Marleau is confronted with a variety of things, ranging from a mystery surrounding a disputed legacy to a series of disappearances in a small village. Each plot is interspersed with interactions with colorful characters that enrich the painting, mixing comedy with drama. The tension is palpable in his entourage, where confidence can easily squabble under the sharp eye of the captain.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: Marleau's investigating an attempted murder. The victim, a former policeman who became a hotelier, was silent not to endanger her loved ones.
programme.desc-more: Captain Marleau (Corinne Masiero), an inspector with a sharp intuition, finds herself immersed in a series of investigations as delicate as they are confusing. When an ex-policeman is the subject of an attempted murder, Marleau tries to convince her to testify. However, the victim, haunted by fear for the safety of his loved ones, remains silent. While this case seems to be resolved, Marleau is quickly confronted with another mystery: a man on the run, accused of killing his own son. Not believing in his guilt, Marleau decided to temporarily hide him, endangering his own career. His determination led him to collaborate with an English detective, while a British journalist was kidnapped. Through these surveys, Marleau navigates a world of colourful characters, with remarkable appearances of guests like David Suchet and Yolande Moreau, enriching a captivating intrigue.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: Marie-Ange Wagner, Mayor of Strasbourg and mother of Caesar, married Christian Haas. As the party is full in a castle, a corpse is found in a cold room.
programme.desc-more: César Wagner (Gil Alma), inspector in Strasbourg, finds himself in a real puzzle when he arrives late at the marriage of his mother, Marie-Ange, the mayor of the city. The ceremony, which takes place in a sumptuous castle, takes a tragic turn when a corpse is discovered in a cold room, plunging the festivities into chaos. The situation is complicated when Caesar and his team have to navigate a network of lies and secrets, as the main suspects are all linked to the organizing company of the event. Victoire Haas, the daughter of the groom Christian Haas (Florent Peyre), turns out to be the director of the company, adding a layer of tension and personal dilemmas to the investigation. In a context of loyalty and betrayal, Caesar must act with discretion to expose the culprit, while preserving the integrity of his family and the honour of his mother.

programme.desc: Two young people in formation in Hao's adapted military service regiment embody the question of Polynesian youth in the face of the choice of leaving or staying.
programme.desc-more: Emmanuelle and Tehau, two young Polynesians from the Tuamotu, are engaged in a one-year training within the regiment of adapted military service recently installed on the Hao atoll. Emmanuelle, from the island, and Tehau, from a neighbouring atoll, learn about tropical agriculture and restoration, with the hope of getting a job and, perhaps, discovering a military vocation. Their journey takes place on an island marked by history: former rear base of the army during the nuclear tests, prosperous and then deserted at its stop, Hao is now seeking to retain his youth.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Mylène discovers that Anatole borrowed her clothes for a role-playing game on pirates. She's gonna have to take the tests for Jason to get them back.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole wants to get her crocmuched plush and makes her bitch think she's razed and covered with chips to get it in an attic vacuum.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Vera's investigations
programme.desc: The famous presenter Rick Kelsall appears hanging in his room, the day after an evening with old friends in high school. Freshly cleared of charges of sexual harassment, he was preparing for the release of an explosive autobiography on his nearby circle. Inspector Vera immediately rejects the hypothesis of suicide and looks at the past of the party participants. The compromising revelations promised in the book are an obvious motive. His investigation probes the shadow zones of each guest to identify the target of future indiscretions.
programme.desc-more: In the wild moors of Northumberland, swept by icy winds and bathed in raw light, crimes never remain buried for long. It is here that Vera Stanhope (Brenda Blethyn), chief inspector with a rough temperament as the surrounding landscapes, conducts her investigations with a relentless intuition and caustic humour that destabilizes her colleagues as well as the suspects. Dressed in her eternal worn coat, with a headband in shape, she embodies a force of nature, indifferent to conventions, obsessed with one thing: the truth. With him, Joe Ashworth (David Leon), his dedicated assistant, acts as a spiritual son – a delicate balance between his ideal youth and the experienced cynicism of his mentor. Everything changes when a 15-year-old, Luke Armstrong, is found dead in his bathtub, his face frozen in an expression of terror, strangled by a lace. But what should look like an ordinary family drama turns into a macabre riddle: the assassin has laid fresh flowers on the surface of the water, such as a funeral offer or a sinister signature. For Vera, this too much theatrical detail feels the calculation. Who could have done such a cold and methodical act? A relative? A stranger? Or worse, someone who's just getting started? As the investigation sinks into the unfavorable secrets of the small community, Vera and Joe discover that Luke, apparently a high school student without history, hid troubled bonds – family lies, school tensions, perhaps even dangerous relationships. Each testimony raises new questions, each alibi cracks. Then a second murder occurs, even more meticulously staged. The doubt is no longer allowed: a serial killer is walking around the county, and his ritual seems to obey a logic that only a twisted mind could understand. Between the heavy silences of suspects, the unsaid of a region where everyone knows each other and the false-likes of well-organized respectability, Vera must unravel the skewer of a case where nothing seems to be the same. But the more it digs, the closer the danger gets. Because this killer isn't just hitting – He watches, he anticipates, and he likes to play with those who track him. How far will Vera have to go to get rid of her game before a new victim falls? And what does this series of murders reveal about the buried demons in this lost corner of England, where appearances are often the best of camouflages?

programme.title: Vera's investigations
programme.desc: At Peyton Harbour, a customs check turns into a drama when a heavy-duty driver runs away, overturning Gary Mallon, the foreman, in his unbridled race. Gary succumbs shortly after his injuries, and Inspector Vera Stanhope discovers that the truck was carrying a cargo of stolen heroin. Convinced that it is a set-up, Vera plunges into a complex investigation. The situation is getting worse when a new element upsets the investigations: Gary's ex-wife alerts the police about the disturbing disappearance of their 13-year-old son. Research is intensifying, but it is becoming even more complicated when the national agency against organized crime tries to seize the case, adding a dimension of rivalry and political pressure to an already explosive case.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: Xinyan realizes that Tiangou brought an egg from Beasticon from the Stone Garden. The monkey entrusts the baby Beasticon to Lan Jun, who takes care of it as she can.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Athena, the bitch of a scientist, comes to consult Clever and Bro, because she and her master were attacked by the spectre of an old associate.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. Together, they must navigate a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where each character hides a secret. As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: The Queen is here to solicit Clever for an ultra-confidential mission. The night before, her secret agent warned her of imminent danger before mysteriously disappearing.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unusual pets, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of exceptional observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive in character, are embarking on captivating investigations. Their peaceful daily life quickly turns into a series of thrilling adventures as they tackle mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Thanks to Clever's sharp intelligence and Bro's audacity, the two partners are at the heart of complex business, where every detail counts. From the disappearance of precious objects to puzzles that challenge logic, their determination leads them to foil clever plans. But their quest for truth also exposes them to unexpected dangers, testing their brotherly bond. In this episode, Clever and Bro's humor and ingenuity illuminate dark affairs, revealing that even the smallest of us can make a difference.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Clever announces to Bro and McFlare that she has finally gathered enough clues to know where the next meeting of The Cause, the secret organization of the evil Knight, will take place.
programme.desc-more: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole and Jason are training Princess to become a detective bitch. Mylène gets back at the wheel of Jason's video game and hides it in a secret place.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: One morning, the herd found out it snowed. The sheep, engaged in a battle of snowballs, do not realize that the farmer is trapped in the house.
programme.desc-more: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: After the incursions of Halowine, Arctix and Antarcticix into Lutèce, Labienus decided to capture the wolves that inhabit the surrounding forest. Turbine wants to warn Chevrotine.
programme.desc-more: In the captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Lutèce is in a state of discord after the recent incidents caused by Halowine, Arctix and Antarctix, invaders who sow discord in the city. Faced with this growing threat, Labienus, the Roman strategist, made the bold decision to capture wolves wandering around the surrounding forest, convinced that these creatures could be used as a weapon against the Gaulish irredentists. Meanwhile, Turbine, Idéfix's faithful companion, realizes that this initiative could have disastrous consequences for the balance of nature and the tranquillity of Lutece. Determined to prevent Labienus from harming wolves, Turbine launched a race against the clock to warn Chevrotine, the wise and cunning inhabitant of the village. In this thrilling adventure, the characters will have to navigate between loyalty and bravery, while facing complex moral choices.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: While Idéfix and Turbine are looking for crumbs for Asmatix, Chevrotine arrives at the den to use an underground passage to cause the Louve Palace to collapse.
programme.desc-more: While Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen) and his accomplice Turbine (Kelly Marot) are searching the surrounding area for crumbs for the Asmatix glutton (Jean-Claude Donda), their quest is taking an unexpected turn. Chevrotine (Edwige Lemoine), a bold and farceous figure, landed in the den with a bold idea: to use an underground passage to make the Louve Palace collapse, a formidable enemy. Together, they are building a clever plan, but this mission may well prove more complex than it seems. Tensions rise as they have to navigate between the luve traps and the hidden dangers of the underground. In this adventure, friendship and solidarity will be tested, while Idéfix and his friends face difficult choices. Will they succeed in accomplishing their mission without being overwhelmed by the obstacles that stand in their way?

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Padgachix found a cursed mirror that makes him softly invisible. To be rid of this curse, he must lay the mirror before the statue of Hohis.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Padgachix, a bold and often unpredictable character, makes a discovery that will upset his life: a cursed mirror capable of making his user progressively invisible. As he explores the mysteries of this ancient artifact, he quickly realizes that this invisibility is not without consequences, taking him away from his friends and plunged him into a state of growing loneliness. To lift the curse that eats him, Padgachix must undertake a perilous quest to lay the mirror before the statue of Hohis, an ancient god whose legend is marked by magic and wisdom. Accompanied by his faithful companions, he will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and confusing puzzles, while discovering the true value of friendship and courage in the face of adversity. This adventure promises to be rich in twists and life lessons.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Richard de Rastignasse, the magnificent lion of the household, makes a sensation with his entourage, so much so that many animals imitate him.
programme.desc-more: In the captivating world of the household, Richard de Rastignasse, a charismatic lion, is distinguished by its beauty and majestic appearance. Surrounded by a plethora of fascinated animals, it quickly becomes the pertussis of its entourage, attracting the attention of all in its elegant manners and undeniable charisma. His growing popularity encourages many companions to copy him, seeking to imitate his behavior and style. Within this dynamic, other animals, each with their unique personality, begin to compete to attract attention, resulting in a series of comical and touching situations. However, behind this facade of glory, Richard has to face his own doubts and the growing expectations of his entourage. As the household moves around, Richard will have to navigate between the quest for his identity and the pressure to stay at the top, while discovering what it really means to be a leader in this vibrant ecosystem.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Ariane accidentally laced Louis XIV's billiard mat. Belfort and Lupin will help him hide this awful nonsense before the game party starts.
programme.desc-more: In a context of fascist and mystery at the court of Louis XIV, an unfortunate incident occurred when young Ariane (Nathalie Homs) found herself to lace the royal billiard carpet, a masterpiece of craftsmanship. She panicked about the consequences of her act, and turned to her two accomplices, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), masters in the art of trickery and concealment. Together, they must develop a clever plan to mask this blunder before the game begins, where nobles and courtiers expect a demonstration of talent. Between daring ploys and nasty situations, the trio is launching a race against the clock, juggling the intrigues of the court and the expectations of the guests. As tensions rise, loyalty and ingenuity will be tested in a universe where every false step could have fatal repercussions.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: A tree made of plastic bricks, that's a good idea, isn't it? Cecile is convinced of this... until Max and Mathieu made him notice a detail that changed everything: his tree is made of plastic... And the plastic comes from oil! But where does oil actually come from? How is it transformed into plastic? And above all, are there more ecological alternatives? Curious, Cécile goes on a mission to go back to the source of plastic: from the ground floor to the toys. Meanwhile, Mathieu is embarking on another investigation: can we make plastic without oil? And if so, how?

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco would like to be older... The day he finds himself with a sushi seaweed accidentally glued under his nose, he discovers that he is considered an adult; He's got a good life! Except that the algae is toxic and makes it age prematurely...
programme.desc-more: In a world where the fantastic mixes with reality, Musculo, a young half-hustler, half-human boy, struggles to integrate among children of his age. At only eleven years old, he aspires to lead a normal existence, far from curious eyes and mockery. Between his adventures on the oceanfront and his interactions with human friends, Musculo faces unique challenges related to its hybrid nature. His days are rhythmic with unexpected encounters and crazy situations, where he must juggle his aquatic identity with his childhood desires. In this captivating episode, Musculo embarks on a quest to prove that he can be like any other child, while discovering the beauty of his difference. His relationships with his fellow students, as well as the lessons he learns about self-acceptance, reveal an unexpected depth of his journey.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco and Coco, obsessed with a new series, have not tidyed their rooms in weeks. In Molusco's socks even a particularly tough seaweed develops that invades the house. How can we get rid of it before the parents return, and they promised to clean it up?
programme.desc-more: In a world where normality is a distant dream, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, aspires to live like any child of his age. Despite his singular appearance, he navigates through the daily challenges of school life and social interactions, while trying to conceal his true nature. Musculo faces mockery and misunderstanding from his comrades, but he clings to his dream of an ordinary existence. Accompanied by his friends, he embarked on a series of rock adventures, ranging from discovering his own extraordinary abilities to fighting obstacles that seem insurmountable. In this episode, he will also have to face up to some crazy and unexpected situations that will prompt him to redefine what it means to be "normal". In seeking to integrate, Musculo will discover that self-acceptance is perhaps the key to a successful life.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Coco is sad, it's the end of the season of his favorite series. Molusco proposes to build a super powerful antenna that will allow him to capture series from all over the world...
programme.desc-more: Coco, a young show enthusiast, is distraught as she approaches the end of the season of her favorite show. His sadness does not go unnoticed, and it is then that Molusco (Marc Bretonnière), an eccentric and inventive character, enters the stage. To give Coco a smile, he proposes to build a super powerful antenna capable of capturing series from around the world. Together, they embark on a rock adventure, mixing creativity and technology, while facing unexpected challenges. The two friends explore unknown lands and meet colorful characters, each with a series to share. As they travel, Coco discovers not only a multitude of exciting new stories, but also the importance of friendship and passion for television. This quest to broaden their horizons will lead them to surprising discoveries and unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A cat named Jellybean comes to consult Clever: his master, a great violinist, suddenly went mad. He broke his violin and thought he was a baby.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, are embarking on captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and observational skills lead them into mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard has not managed to solve for years. While Clever uses his sagacity to decipher often neglected clues, Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to plunge head down into action, leading them to perilous but thrilling situations. Together, they face complex puzzles, ranging from inexplicable disappearances to daring flights, while combining with colourful characters encountered during their adventures. Their friendship and complementarity are tested as they navigate a world where danger and mystery hide at every corner of the street, proving that even the smallest heroes can make a big difference.

programme.desc: Accompanied by his faithful accomplice, pianist Jérôme Ducros and the Orchestre Lamoureux, directed by conductor Johanna Malangré, cellist Gautier Capuçon takes over the titles of his album " Destination Paris", among which we find "La Foule" by Edith Piaf, "Les Champs-Elysées" by Joe Dassin, or "La Bohème" by Charles Aznavour. In this concert recorded at Olympia, the French musician celebrates the capital Paris – an inspiring and poetic city, out of time – that crosses all styles and all the periods in which classical and variety are found.

programme.title: Gims in Paris la Défense Arena: the concert event
programme.desc: After being the first French rapper to fill the Stade de France in 2019, Gims chose a new arena for an exceptional concert in the largest hall in Europe: Paris la Défense Arena. With its twenty years of career, eight million albums sold and billions of streams, Gims is an out-of-class artist, multi-rewarded and acclaimed by more than 25 million fans around the world. In this phenomenal show that has already gathered 800,000 spectators this year in France, Gims offers a grand performance with its timeless tubes, such as "Sapés comme nevere", "Bella", or more recently "Ciel".

programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.desc: What's the point? What does that mean? Who's that? Why is it like that? Children's questions are answered daily.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. Together, they must navigate a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where each character hides a secret. As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unusual pets, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of exceptional observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive in character, are embarking on captivating investigations. Their peaceful daily life quickly turns into a series of thrilling adventures as they tackle mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Thanks to Clever's sharp intelligence and Bro's audacity, the two partners are at the heart of complex business, where every detail counts. From the disappearance of precious objects to puzzles that challenge logic, their determination leads them to foil clever plans. But their quest for truth also exposes them to unexpected dangers, testing their brotherly bond. In this episode, Clever and Bro's humor and ingenuity illuminate dark affairs, revealing that even the smallest of us can make a difference.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole and Jason are training Princess to become a detective bitch. Mylène gets back at the wheel of Jason's video game and hides it in a secret place.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: To win a stay at Tyrex Park, there are only a few crocosaurous points in Anatole and Jason (which can be found on the cereal packages of the same name). Anatole does not lack ideas to find, or even create, these points. The first initiatives of the two buddies are not successful. But as often, failures fail to discourage Anatole... On the contrary!
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.sub-title: At the corner of the fire
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In the captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Lutèce is in a state of discord after the recent incidents caused by Halowine, Arctix and Antarctix, invaders who sow discord in the city. Faced with this growing threat, Labienus, the Roman strategist, made the bold decision to capture wolves wandering around the surrounding forest, convinced that these creatures could be used as a weapon against the Gaulish irredentists. Meanwhile, Turbine, Idéfix's faithful companion, realizes that this initiative could have disastrous consequences for the balance of nature and the tranquillity of Lutece. Determined to prevent Labienus from harming wolves, Turbine launched a race against the clock to warn Chevrotine, the wise and cunning inhabitant of the village. In this thrilling adventure, the characters will have to navigate between loyalty and bravery, while facing complex moral choices.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: While Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen) and his accomplice Turbine (Kelly Marot) are searching the surrounding area for crumbs for the Asmatix glutton (Jean-Claude Donda), their quest is taking an unexpected turn. Chevrotine (Edwige Lemoine), a bold and farceous figure, landed in the den with a bold idea: to use an underground passage to make the Louve Palace collapse, a formidable enemy. Together, they are building a clever plan, but this mission may well prove more complex than it seems. Tensions rise as they have to navigate between the luve traps and the hidden dangers of the underground. In this adventure, friendship and solidarity will be tested, while Idéfix and his friends face difficult choices. Will they succeed in accomplishing their mission without being overwhelmed by the obstacles that stand in their way?

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Padgachix, a bold and often unpredictable character, makes a discovery that will upset his life: a cursed mirror capable of making his user progressively invisible. As he explores the mysteries of this ancient artifact, he quickly realizes that this invisibility is not without consequences, taking him away from his friends and plunged him into a state of growing loneliness. To lift the curse that eats him, Padgachix must undertake a perilous quest to lay the mirror before the statue of Hohis, an ancient god whose legend is marked by magic and wisdom. Accompanied by his faithful companions, he will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and confusing puzzles, while discovering the true value of friendship and courage in the face of adversity. This adventure promises to be rich in twists and life lessons.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Richard de Rastignasse, the lion of the household, can no longer move to cause a torticoli. He ordered Belfort and Lupin to help him to go to a recital.
programme.desc-more: In the captivating world of the household, Richard de Rastignasse, a charismatic lion, is distinguished by its beauty and majestic appearance. Surrounded by a plethora of fascinated animals, it quickly becomes the pertussis of its entourage, attracting the attention of all in its elegant manners and undeniable charisma. His growing popularity encourages many companions to copy him, seeking to imitate his behavior and style. Within this dynamic, other animals, each with their unique personality, begin to compete to attract attention, resulting in a series of comical and touching situations. However, behind this facade of glory, Richard has to face his own doubts and the growing expectations of his entourage. As the household moves around, Richard will have to navigate between the quest for his identity and the pressure to stay at the top, while discovering what it really means to be a leader in this vibrant ecosystem.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In a context of fascist and mystery at the court of Louis XIV, an unfortunate incident occurred when young Ariane (Nathalie Homs) found herself to lace the royal billiard carpet, a masterpiece of craftsmanship. She panicked about the consequences of her act, and turned to her two accomplices, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), masters in the art of trickery and concealment. Together, they must develop a clever plan to mask this blunder before the game begins, where nobles and courtiers expect a demonstration of talent. Between daring ploys and nasty situations, the trio is launching a race against the clock, juggling the intrigues of the court and the expectations of the guests. As tensions rise, loyalty and ingenuity will be tested in a universe where every false step could have fatal repercussions.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: A tree made of plastic bricks, that's a good idea, isn't it? Cecile is convinced of this... until Max and Mathieu made him notice a detail that changed everything: his tree is made of plastic... And the plastic comes from oil! But where does oil actually come from? How is it transformed into plastic? And above all, are there more ecological alternatives? Curious, Cécile goes on a mission to go back to the source of plastic: from the ground floor to the toys. Meanwhile, Mathieu is embarking on another investigation: can we make plastic without oil? And if so, how?

programme.title: Lego Scooby-Doo: Hollywood Ghost
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo and his friends won a trip to Hollywood. They visit the former Briqueton studios. But Scooby Gang soon discovered that these places are haunted by the ghost of a horror movie actor, Boris Karnak. He hunts Scooby-Doo and his band under the appearance of his old roles: a headless rider, a mummy or a zombie and sabotages the shooting of a fiction. The Scooby Gang decides to act: Sammy and Daphne become artists, Vera is the cameraman and Fred the director.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where the fantastic mixes with reality, Musculo, a young half-hustler, half-human boy, struggles to integrate among children of his age. At only eleven years old, he aspires to lead a normal existence, far from curious eyes and mockery. Between his adventures on the oceanfront and his interactions with human friends, Musculo faces unique challenges related to its hybrid nature. His days are rhythmic with unexpected encounters and crazy situations, where he must juggle his aquatic identity with his childhood desires. In this captivating episode, Musculo embarks on a quest to prove that he can be like any other child, while discovering the beauty of his difference. His relationships with his fellow students, as well as the lessons he learns about self-acceptance, reveal an unexpected depth of his journey.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a colorful and baffled world, Molusco, an endearing character, finds himself in a delicate situation with his friend Coco. Both eager to please Lola for Mother's Day, they set out on a quest to collect money to buy a memorable gift. Their search leads them to a Mexican wrestling tournament, an event as unpredictable as it is exciting. In this arena where sweat and rivalry reign, Molusco has to face formidable opponents, each with his own style of combat and eccentric personality. As he engages in this intense competition, Molusco discovers not only the strength of friendship and determination necessary to overcome obstacles, but also the values of loyalty and sacrifice. This tournament will become a real event of courage, where each catch is a step towards the perfect gift for Lola, while revealing unexpected facets of himself.

programme.title: Molusco

His sadness does not go unnoticed, and it is then that Molusco (Marc Bretonnière), an eccentric and inventive character, enters the stage. Together, they embark on a rock adventure, mixing creativity and technology, while facing unexpected challenges. The two friends explore unknown lands and meet colorful characters, each with a series to share. As they travel, Coco discovers not only a multitude of exciting new stories, but also the importance of friendship and passion for television. This quest to broaden their horizons will lead them to surprising discoveries and unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the lively Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, are embarking on captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and observational skills lead them into mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard has not managed to solve for years. While Clever uses his sagacity to decipher often neglected clues, Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to plunge head down into action, leading them to perilous but thrilling situations. Together, they face complex puzzles, ranging from inexplicable disappearances to daring flights, while combining with colourful characters encountered during their adventures. Their friendship and complementarity are tested as they navigate a world where danger and mystery hide at every corner of the street, proving that even the smallest heroes can make a big difference.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Capuçon Gautier at the Olympia
programme.desc: Accompanied by his faithful accomplice, pianist Jérôme Ducros and the Orchestre Lamoureux, directed by conductor Johanna Malangré, cellist Gautier Capuçon takes over the titles of his album " Destination Paris", among which we find "La Foule" by Edith Piaf, "Les Champs-Elysées" by Joe Dassin, or "La Bohème" by Charles Aznavour. In this concert recorded at Olympia, the French musician celebrates the capital Paris – an inspiring and poetic city, out of time – that crosses all styles and all the periods in which classical and variety are found.

programme.title: Roberto Alagna sings at the Opera of Versailles
programme.sub-title: The Kingdom of the two Sicilys
programme.desc: Tenor Roberto Alagna is investing the stage of the Royal Opera in Versailles for a concert alongside the greatest French and international lyrical singers. The programme highlights opera tunes and songs in close or far connection with Southern Italy, from Naples to Sicily. Sopranos Natalie Dessay, Aleksandra Kurzak and Pretty Yende, mezzo-soprano Beatrice Uria-Monzon, tenor Michael Spyres and bass baritone Laurent Naouri and Rubén Amoretti also make up the stage of the evening. Like tenors Francesco Demouro and Piero Pretti, violinist Nemanja Radulovic and American singer Gregory Porter. The Corsican polyphonic ensemble Barbara Furtuna shares the scene with the latter. The songs are carried by the Orchestre de chambre de Paris, directed by Yvan Cassar.

programme.title: Vildanden - Wild Duck
programme.desc: Under the direction of choreographer Marit Mum Aune and accompanied by the music of Nils Petter Molvær, the National Ballet of Norway revisits a disturbing work by Henrik Ibsen, the conclusion of a trilogy dedicated to Norwegian author with resounding success. Through the Ekdal family and the insidious secrets revealed by Gregers, the author explores the fragility of the bases on which existence is based when lies hide the realities difficult to face, as well as the guilt and vain sacrifices that it generates.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: When a secret is revealed, Hannah has to prove to her peers that she has the talent and motivation to be dragged to OME.
programme.desc-more: When Hannah arrives in South Korea, she is far from knowing that she will plunge into the heart of the ruthless world of K-pop. As a new tutor in the OME agency, she is entrusted with the responsibility of Chan-Mi, a young "trainee" with exceptional talent, but with fragile dreams. Chan-Mi (Julia Kim Caldwell) aspires to become a star, but intense pressure from the middle and rivalries between the traines threaten to engulf him. As Hannah strives to guide Chan-Mi in this competitive world, she also discovers the sacrifices young artists must make to achieve their goal. Between stressful auditions, rigorous training and complex relationships with other drags like Taran Kim (in the role of Ji-Hoon), Hannah must navigate through the emotional and psychological challenges that lie on their way. Together, they will have to face their fears and ambitions to break into the music industry, while building an unwavering link.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: An unexpected visitor arrives in Korea and questions everything Hannah thought she knew about her family.
programme.desc-more: In her first official K-pop course at the OME, Hannah, a talented young dancer, finds herself facing an unexpected challenge. In pairs with Chan-Mi, a student with a well-drained character, she must compose an original song. The two teenage girls, with diametrically opposed personalities, struggle to find common ground. Hannah, with her dreamy and creative approach, aspires to express deep emotions through music, while Chan-Mi favours striking and engaging rhythms. As they try to overcome their differences, tensions arise, testing their ability to work together. As the rehearsals progress, they discover not only the subtleties of musical writing, but also unexpected aspects of their own personality. This initiatory journey leads them to reflect on their common passion for K-pop, friendship and the strength of collaboration. An adventure that will bring them closer than they would have imagined.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Trying to get a package he dropped, Oscar falls head-on in the park lake. Malika dives into her suite to save him.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In a small Gallic village, harmony is disturbed by a cloud of pigeons that disturb Monalisa (Kelly Marot) and Labienus (Jean-Claude Donda), two inhabitants with well-dimmed characters. To solve this problem, Anglaigus (Benjamin Bollen), the village strategist, proposes a bold solution: to coat the old dovecote with birch-ray, a sticky substance that will trap unwanted volatiles. As the villagers gather around this somewhat farfetched plan, tensions are emerging. Monalisa, concerned about the fate of pigeons, opposes this method, while Labienus, more pragmatic, supports Anglaigus in his initiative. The situation becomes more intense when the plan of Anglaigus takes an unexpected turn, with surprising consequences for the inhabitants and their feathered friends. In this episode, the values of solidarity, respect for nature and friendship are put to the test, offering a humorous look at village disputes.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Idefix and the Indomitable", Asmatix, the famous Druid, finds himself in a situation to say the least unexpected after ingesting a potion concocted by the sorcerer Voldenuix. This potion carried him mentally to the tumultuous period of the battle of Lutèce, where he believed himself in the midst of the clashes between the Gauls and the Romans. As Asmatix tries to navigate this past world, Chevrotine, his accomplice, both unpredictable and cunning, sees an opportunity to settle his accounts with Labienus, the Roman centurion. Driven by a desire for revenge, Chevrotine embarked on a bold plan to destabilize Labienus, but things did not go as planned. Tensions are rising, and quiproquos are accumulating, testing Asmatix's ingenuity and Chevrotin's determination in an adventure full of twists and humour.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: When Idéfix complains to Asmatix that he is too overwhelmed to bring him a bun of bread, Voldenuix and Muffine give him a potion that multiplies him by three.
programme.desc-more: The Romans are preparing to celebrate the Tubilustrium, an emblematic celebration marking the opening of the war season. In this festive context, Chevrotine, the famous hero with a well-drained character, sees a golden opportunity to interfere in the festivities. With his mischievous spirit and determination, he plans to take advantage of the tumult to sow chaos and put everything that comes under his hand to waste. As the drums resonate and the inhabitants are carried away by excitement, Chevrotine, accompanied by his faithful companions, must navigate between the celebrations and the Roman manipulations. As the events unfold, he finds himself facing unexpected challenges and formidable opponents, testing his ingenuity and courage. In this world where ruse and bravery are essential, Chevrotine will have to show unprecedented boldness to realize her bold plans.

programme.desc-more: As Lutèce prepares to host a great parade, Labienus, an ambitious Roman officer, boasts to display the Camulogen shield, symbol of the Gaulish resistance. For him, it is a moment of glory, but for Asmatix, an irreducible Gaulish, it is an unacceptable farce that dishonors the heritage of his people. With the help of his friend Turbine, Asmatix is committed to a bold mission to thwart Labienus' plans. Their adventure takes them through the streets of Lutèce, where they have to sail between the Roman soldiers and the city's festivities. As they travel, they meet unexpected allies and must be ingenuity to thwart Labienus's ploys. As the parade approaches, tension rises, and Asmatix and Turbine realize that they must act quickly to protect the honour of their culture against this Roman provocation.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In a vibrant musical setting, Mr. Lully, a passionate conductor, leads an intense rehearsal with his musicians. As harmony reigns, the atmosphere changes abruptly when one of the musicians, Ariane, experiences an unexpected rise of anger. In the midst of tumultuous emotions, she threw herself on the cushion where Gazette, another member of the band, sat, thus disturbing the session and immerse the entire orchestra in chaos. Tensions rise as musicians try to understand the reasons for this emotional explosion. Mr Lully is facing a dilemma: how to manage this crisis without compromising the performance to come? Throughout the episode, the relationships between the characters are revealed, revealing hidden rivalries and buried secrets. This unexpected confrontation will test not only the group's cohesion, but also the individual aspirations of each member of the orchestra.

programme.desc: In the episode entitled "Le récital royal", Belfort and Lupin find themselves confronted with an unexpected situation when Richard de Rastignasse, the lion of the Household, hurts because of their unsureness. Unable to move because of a torticolis, the lion is determined not to miss the dance recital that Belfort must present in the groves that night. Furious, he demands that our two heroes assist him to join the event. Feeling guilty of his misadventure, Belfort and Lupin tried to find transport solutions, but Richard, sensitive and fearful, roared at the slightest vibration, thus attracting the attention of humans. Faced with this impasse, the two accomplices decided to show creativity and ingenuity by moving the recital towards the lion. This unexpected mission plunges them into a series of hilarious and touching adventures, testing their friendship and sense of spectacle.

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy, a smart, strong bear, reigns over a corner of the Canadian forest where a lovely family of mischievous lemmings give him a twist.
programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.

Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Teen Titans are not teenagers like the others. Thanks to their superpowers, they intervene when the world is in serious danger. With humour and relaxation, they save the universe from all perils. At their head, Robin, who grew up in a circus with his parents. He was adopted by Batman, who trained him well. He now flies his own wings, leaving Gotham City for Jump City. Next to him, the figure Starfire, an alien princess born on the planet Tamaran, but also Raven, daughter of a Terrin and a distant conqueror. A series of animated rhythmic, adventure-filled and humorous.
programme.desc-more: In a world where teenage superheroes fight for justice, the Teen Titans stand out for their offbeat humour and carefree spirit. Lead by former Batman protégé Robin (Scott Menville), they left Gotham City to settle in Jump City, where they dedicated themselves to protecting citizens while juggling the challenges of adolescence. Next to Robin are Starfire (Hynden Walch), an extraterrestrial princess with extraordinary powers, and Raven (Tara Strong), a young woman with mystical abilities inherited from an evil father. Together, they face various threats, ranging from super-villains to interdimensional monsters, while cultivating solid friendships and living hilarious adventures. With epic fighting and nasty situations, this series of animation takes the spectators into a whirlwind of action and laughter, proving that even heroes need moments of lightness.

programme.title: Captives
programme.desc: In 1894, Fanni Devander voluntarily entered the hospital of the Salpêtrière. While Dr. Charcot died a few months earlier, the young woman, married and mother of family, entered a facility where women of all ages, often suffering from mental disorders, were confined in very harsh conditions. Welcomed by a supervisor, nicknamed La Douane, who takes some of her property, Fanni meets Marguerite Botard, the nurse in chief, and Flaviane, a resident, to whom she entrusts that she is looking for her mother, who has been incarcerated for many years in a Parisian psychiatric institution.

programme.title: Surfing, the sacred fire
programme.desc: This documentary traces the evolution of surfing, from its Polynesian origins to its entry into the Olympic Games in Paris 2024. He explores how this ancestral practice has become a global phenomenon, despite the initial opposition of the Westerners. Through archives and testimonies, the film reveals the key moments and figures that marked this discipline. From Polynesian culture to the beaches of the world, surfing has become a symbol of freedom. The documentary thus offers an exciting look at the cultural, political and sporting history of this practice that has conquered the oceans.

programme.title: Billie Eilish, her French story
programme.desc: Billie Eilish has experienced a staggering ascent. Paris welcomed him particularly well. Since then, it has established a strong link with France.
programme.desc-more: This documentary traces the unique relationship between singer Billie Eilish and France. Testimonials, archival images and music excerpts depict an exceptional artist. Billie, the first star born after 2000 to conquer the planet, embodies a whole generation with her style, sincerity and intimate texts. From "SoundCloud" to the Grammy Awards, she successfully shook the music industry. Icon queer, vegan and feminist, she sang for the closing of the Olympics 2024 since California. An exciting "French Story", told by its fans, artists and experts.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: The tension is rising between Hannah, Sun Hee and Mina; They have a lot of trouble getting along as they repeat for the showcase without their leader.
programme.desc-more: In this intense episode of "Gangnam Project, the K-pop adventure", tension reaches its peak while Hannah (Julia Kim Caldwell), Sun Hee (Angela Son) and Mina (M.J. Kang) find themselves in a difficult situation. In the absence of their charismatic leader, the three young artists face growing disagreements that threaten their cohesion and performance during rehearsals for a crucial showcase. Each individual's personal ambitions are beginning to emerge, exacerbating rivalries and testing their nascent friendship. Hannah, determined to prove her worth, is confronted with Mina's sometimes naive optimism, while Sun Hee, more pragmatic, tries to maintain a semblance of harmony. As the hours of repetition go by, disagreements turn into open confrontations, revealing the real motivations of each. This internal conflict may well have disastrous consequences for their future in the competitive world of K-pop.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A very long-glawed feline with a speckled coat, wearing a carved mask, bursts into the Queen's room in the middle of the night and disappears with her.
programme.desc-more: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: On the way to school, Oscar and Malika fail to be taken away by Bloubs, little gelatinous beings. Fortunately, a super heroine saves them.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole wants to go to the fireworks. Unfortunately, that night, he and his little sister were guarded by Mylène Bombix, who did not want to move.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Challenged by Lupin, the two sisters of Belfort entered the maze. According to legend, will they be transformed into a stone statue?
programme.desc-more: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unlikely companions, Belfort, a faithful dog of King Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, formed an inseparable team. Their friendship leads them to extraordinary adventures, where their courage and ingenuity are tested. Together, they travel the green alleys of the royal residence, launching rescue missions to rescue animals in distress, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the surrounding forests. Their quest leads them through intriguing mysteries and unexpected encounters, while highlighting the richness of animal life at that time. In a fascinating historical setting, Belfort and Lupin discover not only the importance of friendship and loyalty, but also the challenges of protecting those who have no voice. Each episode brings them a little closer to the soul of Versailles and its secrets.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: While the King's rosary plans to design a new hat with ostrich feathers, Madame Du Bec and Madame De Buc panic.
programme.desc-more: In the lively city of Belfort, the atmosphere warms up when the rosary of the King, an eccentric artist, begins to create a flamboyant hat decorated with ostrich feathers. This capricious ambition arouses the concern of two ladies of the high society, Madame Du Bec (Nathalie Homs) and Madame De Buc (Barbara Tissier), who see this as a danger to their status and reputation. Fearing that this new trend would destabilize the classical elegance of their circle, they decided to do everything possible to sabotage the chapelier's project. In a frantic race against the clock, the two women develop schemes to counter the designer's plans, leading them to a parade of colourful characters, including the faithful assistant of the chapelier (Guillaume Beaujolais) and a young apprentice (Hugo Brunswick) who wanted to prove his worth. Tensions rise as each one confronts each other in a ballet of intrigues and quiproquos, revealing the hidden undersides of the high society.

programme.title: The treasures of the Paris of the Belle Epoque
programme.desc: From 1880 to 1914, a generation of artists arrived from all over the world in Paris to express their creativity. The Paris of that time shaped the image of Parisienne.
programme.desc-more: From 1880 to 1914, Paris became the capital of the world. During the Belle Epoque, a new generation of artists seeking freedom came from around the world to express their creativity in areas such as architecture, decorative arts, jewellery and advertising. The Paris of this flourishing era will also shape the mythical figure of Parisienne. As the dancers of the French cancan fascinate their audience, Paris celebrates progress and modernity by hosting the largest universal exhibition in history. This documentary explores these treasures of the Paris de la Belle Epoque.

programme.title: The metamorphoses of the Grand Palais
programme.desc: While the Grand Palais, a famous Parisian monument, is undergoing the most important renovation in its history, close-up on this site and on those of the past.
programme.desc-more: Inaugurated for the Universal Exhibition of 1900 and built to "the glory of French art", the Grand Palais is currently experiencing the greatest renovations of its history. The monument, which was designed to host the major artistic events, is being re-established to host the largest sporting event, the Olympic Games of 2024, where the fencing and taekwondo events will take place. This documentary traces the history of this building and its many past and future renovations.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: This morning, Oscar and Malika go to the museum to visit an exhibition on Egypt. As they're early, they decide to sneak inside.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.
