programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: During the school press week, Anatole and Jason investigate an apple thief. They discover an unexpected robber: Madame Latouche.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: When a meteor shower is announced, Bitzer really wants to see the shooting stars, but the curiosity of the herd and the farmer's night picnic distracted him.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Lupin, a flair professional, starts a coaching session to wake up the nose of his friend Belfort who has to take a test in front of the king.
programme.desc-more: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, a unique bond was established between Belfort, Louis XIV's favorite dog, and Lupin, a daring wolf. Together, they form an unexpected duo, uniting their forces to protect their fellow animals, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the vast surrounding areas. Their friendship leads them into thrilling adventures, oscillating between humour and emotion. While the kingdom is plagued by political intrigues and conspiracy, Belfort and Lupin often find themselves at the heart of delicate situations. They must overcome the traps set by the jealous courtiers and solve mysteries surrounding the disappearance of animals. Through fascinating discoveries and bold rescues, this heteroclite couple learns to overcome their differences, proving that friendship transcends the barriers between species. Their achievements are a celebration of loyalty and courage in a world full of greatness and danger.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: A great show is preparing for the Great Ecuries; Bucephalus the horse has a pain in the legs and no one can cure it. He's convinced he's going to be driven out of the Ecuries.
programme.desc-more: As a great equestrian show prepares for the Grand Ecuries of Versailles, the noble Bucephale horse, well known for its presence, is facing a personal crisis: a mysterious legache that threatens not only his health, but also his future in the prestigious stables. Convinced that he will be driven out and relegated to oblivion in a meadow, Bucephalus is invaded by anguish and despair. Faced with this delicate situation, the two protagonists, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), are committed to a determined mission to save their equine friend. With the complicity of an empathic veterinarian (Nathalie Homs) and other unexpected allies, they explore unusual remedies and unconventional methods to give Bucephale hope. As the carousel date approaches, friendship and solidarity will be tested, but Belfort and Lupin's determination could make all the difference.

programme.desc: A spider stings Molusco on the hand, which makes it immediatly sticky! Unfortunately Ozzy helps him to rise up (after he has pushed him) and the two enemies find themselves stuck, hand in hand...

This sting causes a surprising reaction: his hand becomes sticky, making him unable to escape from this uncomfortable situation. In an inadvertent moment, Ozzy (Matthew Forbes), his eternal rival, came to his rescue after accidentally shoving him. Unfortunately, their awkward interaction leads them to an even more delicate situation: they are stuck hand in hand. While Molusco desperately tries to get rid of this grip, Ozzy is forced to help him, despite their differences. This episode highlights the comic and conflict dynamics between these two characters, which everything opposes, while exploring the themes of unexpected friendship and forced cooperation. The ensuing misadventures promise hilarious moments and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A very long-glawed feline with a speckled coat, wearing a carved mask, bursts into the Queen's room in the middle of the night and disappears with her.
programme.desc-more: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: When Detective McFlare meets his agent, Pigeon Paxton, who is about to reveal important information to him, they are both attacked.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen mind and remarkable observational capacity, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive and bold, are embarking on police investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve thorny business, the two fur brothers take charge, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact. Their first case plunges them into an intriguing mystery: a series of inexplicable disappearances of precious toys in the neighbourhood. With their sense of deference, Clever and Bro question unlikely witnesses, explore dark alleys and use clever schemes to dislodge the culprits. As they investigate, they discover an unsuspecting criminal network, testing their intelligence and courage. Each investigation brings them a little closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Serial killer, autopsy of fascination
programme.desc: An exploration of the morbid fascination of the public for serial killers by the prism of popular culture: extracts from heritage films, archives of cult television programs and series today. An insatiable curiosity that questions the unfavorable impulses of contemporary societies. With the participation of Christophe Hondelatte, who decrypts the 23 seasons of "Bring the Accused" by Maxime Chattam analysing the trajectory of Ed Gein who inspired "Psychosis" and "Le Silence des lambes" or even the journalist Patricia Tourancheau.

programme.title: Gims in Paris la Défense Arena: the concert event
programme.desc: After being the first French rapper to fill the Stade de France in 2019, Gims chose a new arena for an exceptional concert in the largest hall in Europe: Paris la Défense Arena. With its twenty years of career, eight million albums sold and billions of streams, Gims is an out-of-class artist, multi-rewarded and acclaimed by more than 25 million fans around the world. In this phenomenal show that has already gathered 800,000 spectators this year in France, Gims offers a grand performance with its timeless tubes, such as "Sapés comme nevere", "Bella", or more recently "Ciel".

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Inspector McFlare and his team tolerate the actions of the famous "Animal Rabbi" law, a mysterious dog who steals the unsold from human shops to distribute them to street animals by means of a air balloon, until the day he sends them a threat message against the Queen...
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. Together, they must navigate a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where each character hides a secret. As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Oscar and Malika meet Jin, a ninja who asks them to pretend to be his apprentices. In fact, to become a ninja master, he must present at least one apprentice this morning to the great master of his clan. Curious to see a real secret dojo and a ninja clan, the children accept. But the simple presentation turns into a fight against the great master's apprentice to prove their worth
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.

Meanwhile, Turbine, Idéfix's faithful companion, realizes that this initiative could have disastrous consequences for the balance of nature and the tranquillity of Lutece. But where does oil actually come from? How is it transformed into plastic? And above all, are there more ecological alternatives? Curious, Cécile goes on a mission to go back to the source of plastic: from the ground floor to the toys. Meanwhile, Mathieu is embarking on another investigation: can we make plastic without oil? And if so, how?

programme.title: Lego Scooby-Doo: Hollywood Ghost
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo and his friends won a trip to Hollywood. They visit the former Briqueton studios. But Scooby Gang soon discovered that these places are haunted by the ghost of a horror movie actor, Boris Karnak. He hunts Scooby-Doo and his band under the appearance of his old roles: a headless rider, a mummy or a zombie and sabotages the shooting of a fiction. The Scooby Gang decides to act: Sammy and Daphne become artists, Vera is the cameraman and Fred the director.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco is obsessed with his new video game, to the point that he doesn't want to do anything else. Luckily, he discovers that when he rolls in Eugene's fertilizer it gives rise to a clone, that Coco is delighted to study...
programme.desc-more: In a world where the fantastic mixes with reality, Musculo, a young half-hustler, half-human boy, struggles to integrate among children of his age. At only eleven years old, he aspires to lead a normal existence, far from curious eyes and mockery. Between his adventures on the oceanfront and his interactions with human friends, Musculo faces unique challenges related to its hybrid nature. His days are rhythmic with unexpected encounters and crazy situations, where he must juggle his aquatic identity with his childhood desires. In this captivating episode, Musculo embarks on a quest to prove that he can be like any other child, while discovering the beauty of his difference. His relationships with his fellow students, as well as the lessons he learns about self-acceptance, reveal an unexpected depth of his journey.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a colorful and baffled world, Molusco, an endearing character, finds himself in a delicate situation with his friend Coco. Both eager to please Lola for Mother's Day, they set out on a quest to collect money to buy a memorable gift. Their search leads them to a Mexican wrestling tournament, an event as unpredictable as it is exciting. In this arena where sweat and rivalry reign, Molusco has to face formidable opponents, each with his own style of combat and eccentric personality. As he engages in this intense competition, Molusco discovers not only the strength of friendship and determination necessary to overcome obstacles, but also the values of loyalty and sacrifice. This tournament will become a real event of courage, where each catch is a step towards the perfect gift for Lola, while revealing unexpected facets of himself.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Coco, a young show enthusiast, is distraught as she approaches the end of the season of her favorite show. His sadness does not go unnoticed, and it is then that Molusco (Marc Bretonnière), an eccentric and inventive character, enters the stage. To give Coco a smile, he proposes to build a super powerful antenna capable of capturing series from around the world. Together, they embark on a rock adventure, mixing creativity and technology, while facing unexpected challenges. The two friends explore unknown lands and meet colorful characters, each with a series to share. As they travel, Coco discovers not only a multitude of exciting new stories, but also the importance of friendship and passion for television. This quest to broaden their horizons will lead them to surprising discoveries and unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the lively Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, are embarking on captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and observational skills lead them into mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard has not managed to solve for years. While Clever uses his sagacity to decipher often neglected clues, Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to plunge head down into action, leading them to perilous but thrilling situations. Together, they face complex puzzles, ranging from inexplicable disappearances to daring flights, while combining with colourful characters encountered during their adventures. Their friendship and complementarity are tested as they navigate a world where danger and mystery hide at every corner of the street, proving that even the smallest heroes can make a big difference.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

Their insatiable curiosity prompts them to explore ancient and complex affairs, mixing legends and hidden truths. Through exciting surveys, they discover clues, meet eccentric characters and navigate a world where danger is rumbling around every corner. The two brothers, although very different in their approach, combine their strengths to thwart the plans of the most clever criminals. Their complicity and team spirit will lead them to surprising revelations, while confronting them with moral dilemmas. In this quest, Clever and Bro demonstrate that even the smallest can accomplish great things when justice is at stake.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Okoo-koo
programme.desc: Okoo-koo is the reception and entertainment program with a pedagogy of a group of young animators: Manon, Julia, Karim and Jason.
programme.desc-more: Okoo-koo - Season 5: even closer to children, even more inspiring! For his fifth season, Okoo-koo continues his mission: to awaken curiosity, encourage creativity and accompany children in their discovery of the world through fun, positive and inspiring content. This year, the show is getting even closer to its audience with \" Okoo, it's at home \", a new weekly sequence that gives the children the floor. Karim will meet them all over France to discover their passions, talents and initiatives, or will host them directly on the stage to share their universes. A section that places children at the heart of the program and values their creativity, personality and commitment.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.sub-title: Bumpy and the wise old grey-eyed leach
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Vincent Niclo and the Symphonic Choir: Bel Canto Tour
programme.desc: In this show, Vincent Niclo, the famous tenor with four octave voices, pays tribute to the beautiful canto by mixing vocal virtuosity and emotions, thus transporting the spectator into a lyrical and majestic universe. Since his meeting with Celine Dion, whose debut he made and a world tour with Sarah Brightman, he has had the chance to sing on the most beautiful scenes in the world.

programme.title: Capuçon Gautier at the Olympia
programme.desc: Accompanied by his faithful accomplice, pianist Jérôme Ducros and the Orchestre Lamoureux, directed by conductor Johanna Malangré, cellist Gautier Capuçon takes over the titles of his album " Destination Paris", among which we find "La Foule" by Edith Piaf, "Les Champs-Elysées" by Joe Dassin, or "La Bohème" by Charles Aznavour. In this concert recorded at Olympia, the French musician celebrates the capital Paris – an inspiring and poetic city, out of time – that crosses all styles and all the periods in which classical and variety are found.

programme.title: Planet Rap
programme.desc: "Planète Rap" sets course for the Caribbean with Malty 2BZ. This artist of Guadeloupéan origin returns the crowds with his verses in Creole and his mix of drill and trap. Along with Fred Musa, he looks back at his connection to the West Indies and the success of the new Caribbean scene. And he plays live the titles of his new project, "Solite".

programme.title: Meryl at the Zenith of Paris
programme.desc: The author/composer Meryl passes without complex from Creole to French, from dancehall to rap. It is solo, with the title "Béli" extracted from her first project "Day before caviar" in 2019 that she makes herself known everywhere in France. Trap, rap, reggae, pop, Meryl masteres all styles and works with the major rap artists (JUL, Soprano, SCH, Shay, Jahyanai...). On 16 March 2024, she imposed her serious and dragging voice on the Zenith of Paris.

programme.title: BreakDO
programme.desc: "BreakDO" is a choreographic creation project that brings together hip-hop dancers (breakers) and judokas from the overseas (Guyane, Martinique, Guadeloupe). While the breakdance entered the Olympic Games in 2024, judo has been practiced since Tokyo in 1964. 60 years apart, There is like a transmission, a symbolic scope in this project at the crossroads of disciplines, publics and territories.

programme.title: Heiva, at the heart of Polynesian traditions
programme.desc: Every year, Polynesia lives at the pace of a captivating festival, the oldest in Tahiti, which has been fascinating for more than a century: the Heiva.

programme.title: Music Box
programme.desc: Juan Carmona presents his latest album, a trip from Baghdad to Cordoba that goes back to the sources of Arab-Andalous music.

programme.title: Moonwalk
programme.desc: Bilal Hassani goes back on his journey with Oumar: he evokes his desire to break into music, his parents, school ridicule, his homosexuality or chess.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Master of Lightning" During an electrical failure in the Lexington neighbourhood, where electronic devices ceased to function, Clever investigates the scene of a flight.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India with exceptional insight, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive, are embarking on fascinating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to attack cases that even Scotland Yard detectives struggle to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex mystery involving a series of unexplained disappearances and clues lost in the alleys of the city. While Clever uses his keen sense of observation to decipher the puzzles, Bro often gets carried away by his enthusiasm, which leads them into unforeseen and sometimes perilous situations. Together, they must navigate through a world of intrigues and secrets, while cultivating their brotherly bond and their love for adventure. The two brothers will discover that the key to solving this mystery may be their ability to combine their unique talents.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "Totems"After meeting a shaman, Oscar and Malika travel in an astral dimension where they are transformed into totem animals.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: ‘SOS Swans in Distress All eggs were requisitioned for Easter, so there is no more one for the king's meal. Belfort and Lupin try to preserve a swan egg from cooks.
programme.desc-more: In the majestic setting of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, the intrepid duo of Belfort, a faithful dog of Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, was illustrated by his heroic actions. In the lush gardens of the royal residence, these two unlikely friends devote themselves to protecting their fur-and-fine companions, whether they are from the Royal Household or the surrounding wilderness. Each episode leads them into thrilling adventures, where their friendship and courage are tested. Whether it's to rescue an injured bird or to find a lost cat, Belfort and Lupin are showing remarkable team spirit. Through unexpected challenges, they discover not only the joys of mutual aid, but also the dangers that lie ahead in this enchanting and perilous world. Their incessant quest to save the most vulnerable leads them to experience moments rich in emotions, thus forging an unwavering link between these two creatures, emblematic of loyalty and bravery.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: "Mme Rosa's 100th anniversary" Belfort and Lupin help Madame Rosa, the elephant, prepare a grand and improvised celebration to celebrate her 100th anniversary with all the animals of the Household.
programme.desc-more: While the Court of Humans left the fascist of Versailles to take refuge in the soothing setting of Fontainebleau, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) found himself immersed in an ocean of despair. In the King's room, he mourns his forgetfulness, feeling abandoned and invisible in a courtyard where prestige and power reign as masters. As the festivities were full at Fontainebleau, he wondered about his role and place in this world where appearances predominate. Meanwhile, political intrigues and court rivalries threaten to upset the fragile balance between the nobles. In this tumultuous context, Belfort will have to navigate through conspiracy and manipulation, seeking to regain the King's attention and prove his worth. His quest will lead him to meet with colorful characters, each with his own ambitions, and rediscover the true sense of friendship and loyalty.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Mulusco", Molusco, an endearing and somewhat clumsy character, finds himself in a delicate situation after vexing his friend Arthur (Yoann Sover) without wanting to. Feeling guilty and eager to repair his mistake, Molusco concocts a bold plan to give the smile back to his fellow scientist-fiction. He decided to dress up as an alien and began making spectacular appearances in front of Arthur's window, hoping to entertain and surprise him. Things take an unexpected turn when, in one of his passages, Molusco loses control and ends up crashing in Arthur's garden. The latter, amazed by the presence of his new alien friend, sees his worries fade. This crazy adventure highlights the importance of friendship and creativity, while offering a touch of humour and emotion through Molusco's misadventures.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In the "Supermollusk" episode of the "Molusco" series, Molusco, a young mollusk with a tender heart, finds himself confronted with a destabilizing reality after viewing a documentary on molluscs. To his surprise, he realized that his classmates felt a deep disgust for him and his nature. Feeling rejected and misunderstood, Molusco, interpreted by Matthew Forbes, is taken from a impulse of despair and loneliness. To remedy this sense of isolation, he makes the bold decision to disguise himself as a superhero, hoping to conquer the affection and admiration of his peers. This choice drives him into a series of adventures where he will have to prove not only his worth, but also understand that self-acceptance is paramount. On the way, he meets various characters, including his friends who help him discover the strength of friendship and the importance of being self-reliant, even in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In the "Terminaprof" episode of the "Molusco" series, the atmosphere is tense within the class, as the teacher decided to subject his students to a surprise check the next day. As anxiety rises among the students, Molusco, a daring and clever character, realizes that he must act quickly to avoid an academic debacle. Determined to secure answers, he developed a bold and risky plan: infiltrating the hideout of the fearful Monsieur Plusse, a mysterious character and feared by all. The latter is known for his encyclopedic knowledge, but also for his unorthodox methods. With the help of his comrades, Molusco embarked on a mission of infiltration, juggling disguise, trick and a bit of luck. The crazy situations and the twists will not fail, as the group will try to get rid of the traps set by Mr. Plusse and to get the valuable answers before the big day.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: During a museum trip, Molusco accompanies his friend Coco, whose enthusiasm for art is palpable. In exploring the various works, Coco is particularly captivated by a painting depicting a Saint-Jacques shell, symbol of beauty and delicacy that deeply affect him. However, their visit takes an unexpected turn when, back home, Molusco discovers with astonishment that Coco has stolen this work of art. This impulsive flight is not only an act of malice, but the sign of an emerging and obsessive love for this unique piece. As Molusco tries to understand his friend's motivations, he finds himself drawn into a whirlwind of moral emotions and dilemmas. The situation prompts them to reflect on the value of art, friendship and the consequences of their actions, while revealing the depth of their connection.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.sub-title: Mission I tidy up my room
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", Simon (a fearless young boy) and his friend Gaspard find themselves facing a disturbing mystery: their toys have disappeared without leaving any trace. In the face of this disconcerting situation, their father offers them a simple but effective solution: to tidy up their room. Motivated by the idea of finding their treasures, Simon and Gaspard embark on a thrilling adventure, adopting superhero postures and transforming themselves into real storage experts. With enthusiasm, they implement storage techniques worthy of the greatest heroes, deploying their energy and creativity to bring their playing space back to life. As they do their mission, they discover not only the importance of the organization, but also the value of friendship and teamwork. This playful challenge is proving to be a rewarding lesson on disorder and responsibility.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", our eponymous hero, Superlapin, finds himself facing a major challenge: facing the formidable Professor Wolf, a genius of evil who does not retreat in front of anything to sow chaos. Superlapin, who embodies the spirit of determination and optimism, categorically refuses to let himself be defeated by adversity. Each mission he undertakes is marked by his unwavering willingness to find a solution, no matter what the obstacles. While Professor Wolf is implementing a Machiavellical plan to take control of the city, Superlapin must bring together his friends, such as his faithful acolyte, Simon, and other colorful characters, to thwart the wicked's plans. Through a series of hilarious adventures and puzzles to solve, Superlapin proves that with courage and ingenuity, it is possible to overcome even the most desperate situations.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: In this sparkling episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", humor and imagination blend into a captivating adventure. Simon (voice of the actor) decides to make a joke to his brother Gaspard (voice of the actor) by devouring his chocolate flan, which causes a disastrous reaction. Gaspard, obviously upset, exclaims: "It's not funny at all! To calm his brother and change his mind, Simon proposes a superhero game. The two brothers quickly turned into Captain Rabbit and Superlapin, diving into a fantastic world full of colours and adventures. However, the situation took an unexpected turn when Captain Rabbit, in a malice, made the same joke to Superlapin by drinking his long-awaited mega flan. To add to the confusion, he pretended the presence of the dreadful Professor Wolf, but he actually appeared, taking advantage of the discord to seize their gadgets. Now, Captain Rabbit and Superlapin must join forces to recover their valuable tools and restore order in their imaginary world. A mission that looks as funny as it is exciting!

programme.title: Simon Superlapin

This activity could not only distract them, but also increase their complicity. programme.title: The Moodz
programme.sub-title: Bisou shares the words of the heart
programme.desc: In this poignant episode of the series "Les Moodz", tensions rise between Furax and Grongron when Furax accuses Grongron of having lost his precious giraffe stuffed. The ensuing dispute is marked by hurtful words and mutual accusations, revealing deep-seated frustrations and unexpressed emotions. Faced with this delicate situation, Bisou, the empathic character of the group, decides to intervene. He invites his friends to share their comments and feelings about the dispute, creating a space for dialogue and understanding. As each person exchanges, he or she reveals his or her own fears and vulnerabilities, transforming a simple argument into an opportunity for emotional growth. This episode explores the themes of friendship, communication and the importance of expressing one's feelings, while highlighting the relationshipal dynamics within the group, echoing universal experiences of conflict and reconciliation.

programme.title: Hot potato! Potato in danger
programme.desc: France is not only a major potato consumer, cooked in all its forms, but also the world's largest exporter. Focusing on the Hauts-de-France and Brittany, this potato culture brings with it its lot of problems. Indeed, its production requires a lot of energy and water and damages the soil. France therefore faces a huge challenge, namely to maintain its status as a potato master while taking into account the environmental and economic challenges associated with it.

programme.title: A year on Earth
programme.desc: Before the end of the year and the return of winter, anticipation is essential. For many animals, autumn offers as many opportunities as challenges.
programme.desc-more: For the animal world, autumn is a period of transition and great change. In America, the tamias are waging a land war and seeking to make food reserves for winter, grizzly bears are enjoying fishing before rivers freeze and lilliputians grow wings to migrate to Mexico. In Antarctica, young penguins become adults and prepare for the big dive. In Africa, thirsty elephants are waiting for rains that have become unpredictable due to climate change and are being hunted by opportunistic lionesses.

programme.desc: When Simon and Gaspard can't find their toys anymore, Dad advises them to clean up their room. Like superheroes, they put in supersonic mode.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", Simon (a fearless young boy) and his friend Gaspard find themselves facing a disturbing mystery: their toys have disappeared without leaving any trace. In the face of this disconcerting situation, their father offers them a simple but effective solution: to tidy up their room. Motivated by the idea of finding their treasures, Simon and Gaspard embark on a thrilling adventure, adopting superhero postures and transforming themselves into real storage experts. With enthusiasm, they implement storage techniques worthy of the greatest heroes, deploying their energy and creativity to bring their playing space back to life. As they do their mission, they discover not only the importance of the organization, but also the value of friendship and teamwork. This playful challenge is proving to be a rewarding lesson on disorder and responsibility.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: Superlapin doesn't like losing, especially against Professor Wolf. He will never abandon a mission, because as a real superhero, Superlapin always finds a solution.
programme.desc-more: In this thrilling episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", our eponymous hero, Superlapin, finds himself facing a major challenge: facing the formidable Professor Wolf, a genius of evil who does not retreat in front of anything to sow chaos. Superlapin, who embodies the spirit of determination and optimism, categorically refuses to let himself be defeated by adversity. Each mission he undertakes is marked by his unwavering willingness to find a solution, no matter what the obstacles. While Professor Wolf is implementing a Machiavellical plan to take control of the city, Superlapin must bring together his friends, such as his faithful acolyte, Simon, and other colorful characters, to thwart the wicked's plans. Through a series of hilarious adventures and puzzles to solve, Superlapin proves that with courage and ingenuity, it is possible to overcome even the most desperate situations.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: Simon jokes to his brother by drinking his chocolate flan. As Gaspard takes it very badly, Simon offers to play superheroes.
programme.desc-more: In this sparkling episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", humor and imagination blend into a captivating adventure. Simon (voice of the actor) decides to make a joke to his brother Gaspard (voice of the actor) by devouring his chocolate flan, which causes a disastrous reaction. Gaspard, obviously upset, exclaims: "It's not funny at all! To calm his brother and change his mind, Simon proposes a superhero game. The two brothers quickly turned into Captain Rabbit and Superlapin, diving into a fantastic world full of colours and adventures. However, the situation took an unexpected turn when Captain Rabbit, in a malice, made the same joke to Superlapin by drinking his long-awaited mega flan. To add to the confusion, he pretended the presence of the dreadful Professor Wolf, but he actually appeared, taking advantage of the discord to seize their gadgets. Now, Captain Rabbit and Superlapin must join forces to recover their valuable tools and restore order in their imaginary world. A mission that looks as funny as it is exciting!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but they send tennis balls everywhere. Instead, they start playing badminton.
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little mischievous slut who shares her daily life with her family in a colorful and playful world. Surrounded by her little brother George, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, she explores the world around her with curiosity and enthusiasm. Both children embark on daily adventures, whether they jump into mud puddles, visit the zoo or play with their friends. Through fun and sometimes nasty situations, Peppa and George discover the simple joys of life, learning to express their emotions and develop their vocabulary. The themes of friendship, family and learning are at the heart of each episode, offering young spectators valuable lessons while entertaining them. The series, which won a BAFTA Award in 2005 for its quality of animation, continues to captivate children from all over the world with its endearing characters and fantasy stories.

programme.title: The Moodz
programme.desc: Furax, Zoumzoum and Oops are about to paint a fresco in the forest, but tensions are emerging. Youpi then offers them to learn a song together.
programme.desc-more: In the episode "The Song of the Moodz", friends Furax, Zoumzoum and Oops gather in the forest, ready to create a colourful fresco that could brighten their environment. However, creative excitement is rapidly darkened by growing tensions between the three accomplices. Each has different ideas about the artistic direction of their project, which leads to disagreements and frustration. In the face of this delicate situation, their friend Youpi, always optimistic, proposes an unprecedented solution: to learn a song together. This activity could not only distract them, but also increase their complicity. As they plunge into the musical world, tensions begin to dispel, allowing each one to express his emotions and to reconnect. This moment of sharing and creativity could well transform their friendship and artistic project into a memorable experience.

programme.title: The Moodz
programme.sub-title: Bisou shares the words of the heart
programme.desc: Furax accuses Grongron of losing his giraffe stuffed. Dispute and hurtful words are exchanged. Bisou invites his friends to tell what everyone has observed and felt.
programme.desc-more: In this poignant episode of the series "Les Moodz", tensions rise between Furax and Grongron when Furax accuses Grongron of having lost his precious giraffe stuffed. The ensuing dispute is marked by hurtful words and mutual accusations, revealing deep-seated frustrations and unexpressed emotions. Faced with this delicate situation, Bisou, the empathic character of the group, decides to intervene. He invites his friends to share their comments and feelings about the dispute, creating a space for dialogue and understanding. As each person exchanges, he or she reveals his or her own fears and vulnerabilities, transforming a simple argument into an opportunity for emotional growth. This episode explores the themes of friendship, communication and the importance of expressing one's feelings, while highlighting the relationshipal dynamics within the group, echoing universal experiences of conflict and reconciliation.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pécheux descends the St. Lawrence, a Canadian river 1200 kilometres long, meeting those living on its shores or on the water.
programme.desc-more: François Pêcheux takes us to Lake Saint Laurent in Canada. His journey begins with a friendly meeting and a plane trip. Departure from Lake Ontario, stops at Gananoque to sail on a luxury boat. His route continued to Montreal, where he faced the void during his meeting with a glass washer specializing in large buildings. Then it was in Quèbec that he met two lovers of freedom and wood who showed him their unusual home, nestled in the swamps. Last stop at Tadoussac to observe whales.

programme.title: Hot potato! Potato in danger
programme.desc: Potatoes, a favourite food for French people, are at risk because of climate change, soil depletion and food security issues.
programme.desc-more: France is not only a major potato consumer, cooked in all its forms, but also the world's largest exporter. Focusing on the Hauts-de-France and Brittany, this potato culture brings with it its lot of problems. Indeed, its production requires a lot of energy and water and damages the soil. France therefore faces a huge challenge, namely to maintain its status as a potato master while taking into account the environmental and economic challenges associated with it.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The series follows Bluey, an anthropomorphic six-year-old puppy, an Australian Bouvier, characterized by its abundance of energy, imagination and curiosity.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: With renewable energies, eco-districts and sustainable resource management, Denmark is a model of ecology. Jérôme Pitorin is trying to understand how the country has built such a harmony between nature, modernity and strong identity and to decipher what makes the Danish model singular.
programme.desc-more: Jérôme Pitorin explores Denmark and its 7,300 km of coastline that have shaped its deep sea-facing traditions and identity. The traces of their ancestors the Vikings can be found all over the country, especially in this attachment to the ocean and the environment which today make Denmark a model of ecology. Between Copenhagen, Møn Island, the Wadden Sea and the South Fionian archipelago, Jérôme Pitorin discovers this unique culture through memorable encounters.

programme.title: A Frenchman named Gabin
programme.desc: Jean Gabin was the most emblematic actor of French cinema of the 20th century because of his personal journey and his roles on the big screen.
programme.desc-more: Jean Gabin remains the most emblematic French actor of the last century. From the Third to the Fifth Republic, the Popular Front at the end of the Thirty Glories, the artist has embodied in cinema France of cities and fields, that of factories and cafes, ports and suburbs, through a comprehensive and varied filmography, rich in masterpieces such as "La Bête humaine", "Le Quai des mismes", "La Grande Illusion", "La Traversée de Paris" or "Un ape en hiver". Between 1935 and 1940, Gabin was featured in twelve films, ten of which became classics of French cinema, under the leadership of Jean Grémillon, Marcel Carné, Jean Renoir and Julien Duvivier. This documentary outlines a portrait of the actor and man, Jean Alexis Moncorgé.

programme.title: Anti-Semiticism, a hatred still in motion
programme.desc: To understand the outbreak of anti-Semitic statements and acts, we must go back to the history of this hateful ideology in France since the Dreyfus affair.
programme.desc-more: Since the terrorist attacks of Hamas on October 7th and the outbreak of the brutal response of the Hebrew state, an international movement of reprobation has developed, in which an unjust amalgam emerges, confusing Jews, Israelis and supporters of Prime Minister Benyamin Netanyahu into one indistinct whole. This confusion has led to an outbreak of anti-Semitic acts in France. To understand this confusion and new anti-Semitism, one must look at history, from the appearance of anti-Semitic thought in political discourse to the end of the 19th century to the most recent amalgams.

programme.title: Doctor David, King Doctor
programme.desc: Jean-Joseph David, a physician and military with an unusual destiny, alone embodies the ambiguities of the colonial system, where medicine was also an instrument of power.
programme.desc-more: Jean-Joseph David, a doctor and military doctor, landed on the island of Wallis in 1933, and was responsible for treating the population while strengthening French influence. But over the years, he far surpassed this role: he became a leading figure, and was nicknamed "Te Hau Tavite", King David. Through the journey of this fascinating and controversial figure, inhabited by humanist ideals or devoured by its ambitions, reveals a unknown facet of the history of colonization: that where medicine becomes a tool of power, between care and control.

programme.title: Chauvet, voyage to the origins
programme.desc: The Chauvet Cave offers a fabulous dive in time, but it is also a fragile natural monument that science is trying to preserve today.
programme.desc-more: In France, in the heart of the gorges of the Ardèche, is a cave formed 6 million years ago by nature and to the unusual history. In 1994, a team of amateur speleologists discovered its walls covered with the oldest drawings ever discovered. Closed to the public to protect it, the cave hosts a first scientific mission in 1998. The interdisciplinary team led by the prehistorian Jean Clottes then embarks on a long scientific and human adventure in order to discover all the secrets of this place.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pécheux sails on the 1000 kilometers of the Loire, the longest river in France, from its source in Ardèche to its estuary in Saint-Nazaire.
programme.desc-more: François Pécheux travels the longest river in France, the Loire, from the Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc, in Ardèche, to the estuary of Saint-Nazaire, where it flows into the Atlantic Ocean. 1,000 km down on a fierce and always unpredictable beauty. The globe-trotter meets enthusiastic guardian angels, solitary freshwater sailors but also well-drained characters and lovers of the Loire River. The journey begins at the foot of thousands of thousand-year-old volcanoes of the Central Massif, where we follow shy balloon meanders. Then the river widens to canoe.

programme.title: The fabulous history of birds, dinosaurs among us
programme.desc: Daniel Field, a specialist in paleo-ornithology at Cambridge University, is working on the reconstruction of the major stages of bird evolution, the last survivors of the disaster that led to the extinction of their cousins dinosaurs. In 2019, he found in a fossil the crane of the oldest modern bird ever discovered. Now, research focuses on the reasons for their survival for millions of years and on their colonization of our planet. However, many of the 11,000 species of birds that inhabit the Earth today are threatened with extinction.

programme.title: Winning return for the kitchen of old
programme.desc: Once put in the old grimoires, the recipes of old make a frantic return today on social networks, in bookstores and in starred restaurants. This phenomenon, which combines nostalgia, a quest for meaning, conviviality and eco-responsible approach, demonstrates a deep need to reconnect with our roots but also with "good eating". Constance has made her 86-year-old Mamou a social media star by filming her preparing her family recipes. Some restaurateurs, like Jean Sévénes, surf on their childhood memories. Elsewhere, others do not hesitate to rehabilitate the offal or to put the soup in fashion.

programme.title: Farm products: to drink and eat?
programme.desc: Farm products represent 4 billion euros in turnover each year in France. Farmers' and producer's co-operative markets are growing, and even large areas offer wide ranges of farm products in their shelves. In the consumer imagination, these products oppose industrial agriculture and are based on all the virtues. The reality is more contrasted. Apart from a few very well-structured sectors, the regulation that defines the farmer label is vague and not binding. To be entitled to it, we must produce and transform on the farm, defined as a single geographical entity.

programme.desc: With privileged access to an intact and virgin corner of the Serengeti, this series follows the thread of the daily life of the animals and the moments of emotion they are confronted with. Meeting with the lonely lioness who rattles her pride, the passionate baboon who desperately tries to win back her lost love, and the family of brazen and fun mangouses on the lookout for a free lunch.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa is a little mischievous slut who shares her daily life with her family in a colorful and playful world. Surrounded by her little brother George, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, she explores the world around her with curiosity and enthusiasm. Both children embark on daily adventures, whether they jump into mud puddles, visit the zoo or play with their friends. Through fun and sometimes nasty situations, Peppa and George discover the simple joys of life, learning to express their emotions and develop their vocabulary. The themes of friendship, family and learning are at the heart of each episode, offering young spectators valuable lessons while entertaining them. The series, which won a BAFTA Award in 2005 for its quality of animation, continues to captivate children from all over the world with its endearing characters and fantasy stories.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa is a little mischievous and life-filled pig who shares her colorful universe with her little brother George, their mom Pig and their dad Pig. Together, they explore the world around them with curiosity and joy. Peppa loves to have fun, whether playing hide and seek, disguised as princesses or jumping in mud puddles, which gives him immense pleasure. Each episode highlights Peppa's and her family's daily adventures, while introducing a gallery of endearing characters, such as her friends Rebecca Rabbit and Suzy Mouton. Through simple situations and life lessons, Peppa learns essential values such as friendship, sharing and creativity. With its humor and good, contagious mood, Peppa invites young spectators to discover the world with a wonderful look, while cultivating their imagination.

programme.title: The Treasures of Shu's Kingdom
programme.desc: A team of archaeologists, historians and scientists have uncovered a city that has been forgotten for millennia in southwestern China. They try to lift the veil on this great civilization until then unknown, upsetting the history of antiquity. Thousands of objects, bronze, jade and gold relics, dating back more than three thousand years, are back in the light. The site is a testimony to a sophisticated civilization with advanced metallurgy, complex urban planning and a rich belief system centered on the cult of the sun. The history of this fascinating international scientific inquiry offers a renewed reading of the origins of ancient China.

programme.desc-more: In the sea off Alexandria, under several meters of water, lies the remains of one of the seven wonders of the ancient world: the legendary lighthouse of Alexandria. For nearly 30 years, archaeologist Isabelle Hairy and her team have been exploring thousands of blocks to reconstruct the history of this extraordinary monument. Today, an exceptional operation is being prepared. The most monumental remains of the lighthouse, some of which weigh several dozen tons, will be re-assembled and digitized. Thanks to new technologies enriched by AI, the archaeologist will be able to establish a virtual replica of the lighthouse and show the genius of its architects.
programme.desc: In the sea off Alexandria, under several meters of water, lies the remains of one of the seven wonders of the ancient world: the legendary lighthouse of Alexandria. For nearly 30 years, archaeologist Isabelle Hairy and her team have been exploring thousands of blocks to reconstruct the history of this extraordinary monument. Today, an exceptional operation is being prepared. The most monumental remains of the lighthouse, some of which weigh several dozen tons, will be re-assembled and digitized. Thanks to new technologies enriched by AI, the archaeologist will be able to establish a virtual replica of the lighthouse and show the genius of its architects.

programme.desc: "I'm unbeatable"Superlapin feels unbeatable today. But he's being captured by Professor Wolf with Super Lou. They're gonna have to ruse to escape the bad guy.
programme.desc-more: In this thrilling episode of season 2 of "Simon Superlapin", Superlapin (Simon) wakes up with unwavering confidence, convinced that he is invincible. While Professor Wolf is developing a Machiavellical plan to dominate the city, Superlapin and Super Lou must unite their forces to escape his claws. Using their ingenuity and team spirit, they embark on a series of bold tricks. With unexpected reversals of situation and moments of tension, this episode highlights the strength of friendship and resilience to adversity. Heroes will have to show courage and creativity to thwart the wicked's plans, proving that even in the most desperate situations, hope and solidarity can triumph.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.sub-title: Opale coast, between winds and tides
programme.desc: Nestled in the Hauts-de-Frances, the Opale Coast is a territory of character, deeply shaped by the sea, land and history. From Boulogne-sur-Mer to Caps Blanc-Nez and Gris-Nez, passing through the villages still very typical, this region reveals a strong and sincere identity. On 120 km of coast, the Opal Coast brings together a variety of landscapes of beaches, dunes, marshes, estuaries and cliffs. Through their daily commitment, the inhabitants, attached to their roots, participate in the preservation of their traditions, the preservation of their environment and the transmission of a unique know-how, forged by centuries and the wind of the sea.
programme.desc-more: In the Hauts-de-France, Ismaël Khelifa is part of the discovery of the Opal Coast, a territory shaped by its rich history and its unique relationship to the sea. He discovers the unique identity of this region thanks to the inhabitants attached to their roots, all of whom participate in their way in the preservation of their traditions, know-how and environment. Ismaël goes through the port town of Boulogne-sur-Mer, the mythical Caps Blanc-Nez and Gris-Nez, but also through small typical villages.

programme.title: A house, an artist
programme.sub-title: André Malraux, the secrets of a giant
programme.desc: "André Malraux, the secrets of a giant"In 1945, André Malraux, 44, rented the first and second floors of a large villa in Boulogne-Billancourt, where he began a new period of creation.
programme.desc-more: André Malraux, a committed writer, first and most famous of the ministers of culture, knew how to put art into action as a person. Yet this historical figure of the Thirty Glorys hides a secret man, who never let anything appear, nor his intimacy, nor the dark hours he had passed through in the early 1960s. In 1945, after the resistance and the fighting, André Malraux, 44, dropped down his arms and rented the first and second floors of a large villa in Boulogne-Billancourt. As a new man, the famous pre-war novelist, author of "The Hope" and Goncourt Prize with "The Human Condition", begins a new period of creation.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: "The Manambolo River (Madagascar)"François Pécheux embarks on the Manambolo River, west of Madagascar, for a journey full of surprises and unforgettable encounters.
programme.desc-more: François Pêcheux takes us to the banks of the Mananbolo River, which was named after a Malagasy princess. The journey begins with the discovery of a muscled custom meringued. It consists of fighting each other to bring down the other. Surrounded by the indigenous people, he travels by boat and discovers on his way the remains of the Malagasy people. Between encounters and mythical places, he discovers friendly characters. We discover caves once home to ancient populations, a very artisanal rum that is torn away at gold prices in the cities. Not to mention the crocodile and crab hunt.

programme.title: Winning return for the kitchen of old
programme.desc: Family cuisine, simmered dishes and the comforting side of Proust made a remarkable return to the table of great chefs and amateur cooks.
programme.desc-more: Once put in the old grimoires, the recipes of old make a frantic return today on social networks, in bookstores and in starred restaurants. This phenomenon, which combines nostalgia, a quest for meaning, conviviality and eco-responsible approach, demonstrates a deep need to reconnect with our roots but also with "good eating". Constance has made her 86-year-old Mamou a social media star by filming her preparing her family recipes. Some restaurateurs, like Jean Sévénes, surf on their childhood memories. Elsewhere, others do not hesitate to rehabilitate the offal or to put the soup in fashion.

programme.desc: "Two communities, from dream to nightmare" Between 1980 and 1985, thousands of people were infected in France with the AIDS virus through transfusions and blood products.
programme.desc-more: Between 1980 and 1985, thousands of people were infected in France with the AIDS virus through transfusions and blood products: hemophiliacs, transfused, and their spouses and children. Physicians, senior officials and ministers had to answer to the courts. One formula remained in all memories: "responsible but not guilty". But how could a transfusion system based on voluntary donation and solidarity become the vector of such a disaster?

programme.desc: The hour to walk again the shores of the middle Earth rang. The very first series of the franchise brings us back 3,000 years before the films signed Peter Jackson. We follow the rise in power of the terrible Sauron and the creation of its famous "Single Ring".
programme.desc-more: After many years away from Middle Earth, it is time to walk back along its famous shores and cross elves, dwarfs and other mythical creatures. The universe conceived by J.R.R. Tolkien in 1937 finally renews. Literary success at the beginning, with more than 600 million copies, the saga "exploses" thanks to director Peter Jackson who adapts the trilogy The Lord of the Rings to the cinema in 2001. Three films (excluding the Le Hobbit derivative franchise) that account for no less than 21.4 million entries in France alone... And 17 Oscars! A new stone is added to this monumental building and aims to delight fans of the first hour and new curious. Exit Frodo and Gandalf: the series focuses on the rise of the terrible Sauron and the creation of its "Single Ring". If we find some names familiar with the young version of the Galadriel Elves, embodied in the cinema by Cate Blanchett, and Elrond (Hugo Weaving on large screen), most of the characters are original.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Aurora
programme.desc: Aurore, a 10-year-old girl, lives with her mother in a loneliness-filled daily life. One night, while playing in a sandbox, she meets Paulo, a 4-year-old child, and her sister Maya, who is busy snacking cakes. A conflict broke out between the children when Aurora demanded a biscuit that Paulo refused, leading to a series of violent exchanges that tragically ended: Aurora accidentally killed the boy. Years later, Aurore (Elodie Bouquez), having served his sentence, devoted himself entirely to the education of his daughter, Rose. However, the past caught her up when Maya (Lolita Chambah), now an adult, found her trace, driven by a desire for revenge. This poignant drama explores the themes of guilt, mourning and the consequences of childhood acts, while highlighting the complexity of human relations and the difficulty of turning the page.
programme.desc-more: In a city of Provence, Aurore, a 10-year-old girl, shares her daily life with her mother, evolving in a difficult and often sorry environment. One day, young Aurora, hungry after a day without food, crossed the way to Paulo, a classmate who holds a pack of cookies. When Paulo refuses to share his snack, Aurore, in a moment of despair, drags him into a desolate building, hoping to find a respite for his hunger. However, the situation takes a tragic turn when an accident occurs, resulting in the unexpected death of Paulo. Two other children, Chris and Maya, are witnessing this devastating event, but remain silent, fearing the consequences of their revelations. This tragedy not only upsets the life of Aurora, but also has repercussions on their entire small community, highlighting the struggles and challenges of childhood in a often hostile environment.

programme.title: The beauties of the Andes Cordillera

programme.title: Aurora
programme.desc: Aurore, 10, lives alone with his mother. One night, in a playground, she accidentally killed four-year-old Paulo, who refused to give him a cookie.
programme.desc-more: Aurore, a 10-year-old girl, lives with her mother in a loneliness-filled daily life. One night, while playing in a sandbox, she meets Paulo, a 4-year-old child, and her sister Maya, who is busy snacking cakes. A conflict broke out between the children when Aurora demanded a biscuit that Paulo refused, leading to a series of violent exchanges that tragically ended: Aurora accidentally killed the boy. Years later, Aurore (Elodie Bouquez), having served his sentence, devoted himself entirely to the education of his daughter, Rose. However, the past caught her up when Maya (Lolita Chambah), now an adult, found her trace, driven by a desire for revenge. This poignant drama explores the themes of guilt, mourning and the consequences of childhood acts, while highlighting the complexity of human relations and the difficulty of turning the page.

programme.desc-more: After beginning on Berlin's stage during the war, Hildegard Knef became known by embodying a survivor of the camps in Wolfgang Staudte's "The assassins are among us". In 1955, she flew to Broadway at Cole Porter's initiative, where she played Ninotchka in the musical "Stilk Stockings". New horizons opened up: if she continued her career as an actress, often confined to intellectual characters who doubted, Hildegard Knef would now flourish in the song, in parolière and exceptional performer, while publishing books, including the autobiographic bestseller "A péval donné".

programme.title: Fedora
programme.desc: A film producer who came to Corfu to hire an old star discovers the horrific plan he has been working on to keep his youth alive.
programme.desc-more: In the Paris of the 1970s, Fedora (Marthe Keller), an icon of cinema, chose to end her life by falling under a train, plunged the world of show in terror. At his funeral, Barry Detweiler (William Holden), a Hollywood producer, recalled the tragic events that preceded this fateful decision. His quest to find Fedora led him to Corfu, where the actress, now recluse, tries to escape the pressure of success. Barry met Countess Sobryanski (Hildegard Knef), a close friend of Fedora, and Dr. Vando (José Ferrer), an expert in aesthetic surgery, who held secrets about the actress's life. Through their stories, Barry discovers Fedora's hidden suffering, between the desire for renewal and the relentless reality of the film industry. This poignant journey raises questions about fame, loneliness and the price to pay for glory.

programme.title: Killer compartment
programme.desc: A murder was committed on the Marseille-Paris night train. A particularly sagacious police inspector is trying to figure out what happened.
programme.desc-more: In Avignon, Bambi (Simone Signoret), a woman with a well-dipped character, embarks on the night train connecting Marseille to Paris. On the way, she meets Daniel (Jacques Perrin), a young runaway, clumsy and without a ticket, whom she decides to help by hiding him in her compartment. The complicity between the two characters is settled, but their journey takes a tragic turn when, in the early morning, a passenger is found strangled in the train. Inspector Grazziani (Jean-Louis Trintignant) was quickly called to the scene to conduct the investigation. His mission is to interview the occupants of the compartment, but he quickly discovers that the killer always seems a step ahead. As tensions rise and the mystery thickens, Bambi and Daniel find themselves trapped in a dangerous game where trust is put to the test and where everyone could be the next suspect. Suspense is intensifying as time is running out to expose the murderer.

programme.title: Stardust, the mystery of the star
programme.desc:
In 19th century England, the small village of Wall hides a secret passage to a magical kingdom, where reality and fantastic are at the same time being found. Tristan Thorn (Charlie Cox), a young man who is naive and dreaming, is fond of the beautiful Victoria Forester (Sienna Miller), who sees him as a friend. To win his heart, Tristan embarks on a bold quest: he promises to bring back a star from heaven. This journey takes him beyond the borders of his world known, into the enchanted kingdom of Stormhold, populated by wonderful creatures and unsuspected dangers.
In this fairy world, the star he seeks has taken on a human form, embodied by the fascinating Yvaine (Claire Danes), who finds himself at the heart of a struggle for his survival. As Tristan tries to find her, he encounters formidable opponents, including power-loving sorcerers, daring pirates, and the two sons of a late king, each eager to take the star for very different reasons. Tristan's quest becomes an initiatory journey, where he will have to face his own demons and discover the true nature of love, while sailing through a world filled with mysteries and magic.
