The Little Wadrouille
programme.desc: After a professional conference, Franck (Daniel Auteuil), a businessman with romantic ambitions, asked his right-hand man Justine (Sandrine Kiberlain) to organize a special weekend with a woman he barely knew. By giving him a generous sum of money and complete freedom for the preparations, he leaves him to make this getaway unforgettable. Justine, excited by this mission, immediately talks to her companion Albin (Denis Podalydes). The latter, opportunistic, sees it as a chance to earn a little money easily and to improve the lives of their eccentric group of friends . However, an unexpected turnaround is on the horizon: the woman Franck imagines for this weekend is none other than Justine herself. As projects take on a comical and unpredictable turn, Justine must juggle her feelings, professional expectations and the quiproquos that are constantly accumulating. The plot is complicated as Albin, aware of the situation, tries to intervene, transforming this romantic weekend into a veritable whirlwind of adventures and revelations.

programme.title: The beast
programme.desc: In 1910, in Paris, Gabrielle Monnier (Léa Seydoux), a talented and fervent pianist admirer of Arnold Schönberg, ran a dolls factory with her husband Georges. At an elegant reception, she met Louis Lewanski, a man she had met a few years earlier in Italy. This encounter, marked by nostalgia, is in reality a reflection of one of his past lives. In 2044, Gabrielle evolved into a futuristic world dominated by artificial intelligence where humanity was in decline. In this dehumanized society, she struggles to find her place. To adapt to this new reality, she must undergo treatment to purge her from the emotions inherited from her previous existences. This complex emotional journey raises questions about identity, memory and the quest for meaning in a universe where feelings have become superfluous. Gabrielle will have to navigate between past and present to redefine her essence.

programme.title: Storia di vacanze
programme.desc: In a pavilion in the Roman suburbs, a warm summer evening brings together Bruno (Elio Germano), Pietro and Amelio to discuss their respective lives informally. Bruno introduces his two children, Alessia and Dennis, who are reading their excellent school reports publicly, to impress his friends, revealing the pressure young people feel in the face of their parents' expectations. The days pass under a overwhelming sun, and the atmosphere of conviviality gradually turns into tension. During dinner, an unexpected incident occurs when Dennis chokes with food, plunging the family into sudden panic. Bruno, caught short, reacts erraticly, while the incident leaves deep emotional traces in all family members. This moment of crisis highlights the complex family dynamics, parental anxieties and challenges of modern life, while exploring the fragile ties that unite generations.

Very early, he was taught Catalan, Spanish, French, Latin and Greek, but also singing and dancing. She is also familiar with poetry, so that her conversation may be gracious and entertaining. Considered a "marriage capital" capable of serving the interests of her family, she was very soon prepared to fulfil the role of a good wife according to the alliances that her father wished to seal. In 1493, the latter married her for diplomatic reasons to Giovanni Sforza in order to make a rapprochement between the Holy See and the Duchy of Milan.

programme.desc: While Europe has experienced a 2.3°C warming since the pre-industrial era, the prospect of extreme weather conditions over time threatens agricultural crops and therefore the food supply. In the face of the urgency, innovative solutions must be put in place quickly. As part of the BreedWheat project, agronomist Jacques Le Gouis, research director at l'Inrae (Institut national de recherche pour l'agriculture, l'nféré et l'environnement), has specialized in the creation of resistant wheat varieties that will offset the decline in yields observed today in France.

programme.title: Polar Ice Metamorphoses: A Challenge for Ecosystems
programme.desc: Whether microscopic or gigantic, plants are crucial to life on Earth. But how can plants grow in the ice and in the winter night? The interactions between the ice, ocean and atmosphere are particularly complex. Researchers have long had difficulty understanding natural processes in these extreme areas, with the functioning of the food chain appearing as a riddle. But recent studies have gradually shed light on its fascinating mechanism. Unfortunately, the data collected over the past 30 years have also measured the decline of the ice in the Arctic Ocean. So much so that scientists wonder what time frame it will be without ice in the summer.

programme.desc: The Andes Cordillera, the world's longest mountain range that borders the western coast of South America for some 8,000 kilometres, is in perpetual motion. Colossal forces from the atmosphere and the depths of the earth are doing this tirelessly. The Anglo-German geologist Colin Devey embarked on a large expedition from Ecuador to Patagonia, through the Amazonian basin and the Atacama Desert, during which he exchanged with other geologists, volcanologists or biologists. It also meets the women and men who live in these areas, sometimes directly near volcanoes and their dangers, such as the Chimborazo, in Quito. But this ardent neighbour also brings benefits: its ashes, rich in minerals, enrich the soils that become suitable for agriculture.

programme.title: Vatican: The City That Wanted to Become Eternal
programme.desc: How did the tomb of the apostle Peter, on one of the hills of Rome, become the universal seat of Christendom, along with a major political and artistic centre? Depositary of a unique memory through its archives and its collection of manuscripts, the Vatican City, which includes the Basilica of St Peter, the Episcopal Palace, the State and Holy See administrations, museums and gardens, concentrates, on less than 1 square kilometre, an exceptional architecture and masterpieces of painting and sculpture. From the frescoes of Giotto, Fra Angelico and Michelangelo to the columns of Bernin, these treasures contributed to the influence of the papacy.

programme.desc: From the reliefs of the Ardennes to the dikes of Flanders, water shapes the territories and determines the richness of their biodiversity. programme.title: Wild Belgium
programme.desc: This is the beginning of winter in Belgium and the High Fagnes are the ideal stopover for the thousands of cranes migrating south. They gather together with their families before returning to North Africa, driven by the rising currents generated by the last hot winds of the year. Flying spiders, too, use wind as a means of transport. When this one is favorable, they rush into the air, hung on a long wire that they themselves secreted, to quickly reach their feeding areas. With its piercing view, the peregrine falcon is distinguished by its impressive ability to catch prey. Capable of flying at 350 kilometers/hour, it is the fastest animal in the world.

Artificial Intelligence: The ultimate human invention?
programme.desc: For a long time, considered a promising yet still infancy technology, artificial intelligence is now evolving at a dizzying pace. As it gains ground, the question of its limits and our ability to maintain control of it arises with a new urgency. From the first networks of neurons to increasingly autonomous systems, this documentary traces decades of research by combining archives and testimonies of pioneer researchers. He compares his views with those of former employees of large AI companies, those working for his safety and families directly confronted with the drifts of certain chatbots. A multi-voice story that makes the history of a technological revolution intersect with the questions it raises today.

programme.title: Robot killers, weapons in AI's hands
programme.desc: In Kiev, on the 17th day of the war in Ukraine, the crash of a drone revealed advanced narcotics in the field of autonomous lethal weapons. On land, in the air or on the sea, the AI is revolutionizing weapons systems. Beyond its use in the field, AI is also under study in other areas: law enforcement, recognition, transportation... The researchers bring their expertise here on these advances in the field of new technologies, and on the necessary limits to be put in place to avoid dangerous drifts.

programme.title: Justice in France
programme.sub-title: Correctional appeal hearing at the Rennes Court of Appeal
programme.desc: At the Rennes Court of Appeal, two men appeared in the accused's box. How can we plead the case of an accused whose defence system is not so credible?
programme.desc-more: At the Rennes Court of Appeal, two men appeared in the accused's box. One is prosecuted for four offences, the other for six. At the heart of the audience: drug trafficking and possession of weapons. How can we plead the case of an accused whose defence system is not credible? How can we demand the fair penalty when the defendant has been convicted many times for similar acts? Yet, despite the seriousness of the accusations, the two men defend themselves in a casual manner and sometimes deny the evidence. In addition to the question of whether the defendants are guilty, the force of a public hearing is to be the privileged witness of the contradictory debate between lawyers and magistrates. The power of a hearing is also to witness the fight that lawyers are leading for their client.

programme.title: The meeting is open!
programme.sub-title: Expensive life in the overseas countries: a bill in committee
programme.desc: The LCP editors will present you with the selected pieces of public sittings in the Chamber and working sessions or committee hearings.
programme.desc-more: On Monday 9 November, the members of the Committee on Economic Affairs discussed the proposal for a law to combat the cost of living by strengthening competition law and economic regulation overseas. The text, adopted by senators in March 2025, includes measures to strengthen the transparency of companies' accounting and to combat unfair competition between local companies and large groups in a monopoly position. The bill, which was submitted by the member of the French Parliament for Guadeloupe Christian Baptiste, is being considered in the context of the parliamentary niche of the "Socialists and Related" group scheduled for Thursday, 19 November.

programme.title: The meeting is open!
programme.sub-title: Neighboring rights: last vote in the Assembly
programme.desc: The LCP editors will present you with the selected pieces of public sittings in the Chamber and working sessions or committee hearings.
programme.desc-more: On Thursday 12 November, MEPs will take a final decision on the bill to strengthen the effectiveness of neighbouring rights of publishers and news agencies. The text was first examined by Members in committee in February 2025 before arriving for the first time in the Chamber more than a year later in March 2026. The bill was then reviewed and passed by senators in June 2026. On November 4, MPs and senators met and reached agreement on the text, which is intended to ensure that publishers and news agencies receive fairer and more transparent remuneration for the use of their content on digital platforms. This is the final vote of the Members on this agreement.

programme.title: Head for the Elysée
programme.sub-title: The N.R., on the way to victory?
programme.desc: Marine Le Pen, a favourite of the polls, is embarking on the conquest of the Elysée. Citizens are talking about their daily concerns while following the presidential campaign.
programme.desc-more: On 7 July 2026, the presidential campaign was launched. On that day, Marine Le Pen saw his electoral horizon clear. The favourite of the polls can finally embark on the conquest of the Elysée. In Hayange, a town of Moselle, formerly a fief of the left, the RN is now raising great hope. At the other end of the country, in the Gard, the RN elected representatives are mobilizing to defend the taurine traditions, which is worth them some popularity. In Saumur, in the West, a business owner of SMEs is concerned. In Alfortville, a French teacher regrets that a class at the school has been closed again. For many citizens, politics is a daily reality, far from slogans and intrigues of power. This does not prevent them from following the presidential campaign and from having an opinion on the candidates and their programmes.

programme.title: Red Army
programme.desc: From 22 June 1941 to 2 February 1943, from Operation Barbarossa to the Katyn massacre, the story of two years of war rich in twists.
programme.desc-more: In telling the story of the famous Red Army from 1918 to 1945, this documentary traces the evolution of what was probably the major utopia. - in any case the most popular - of the twentieth century, communism. Besides the ideology of the soldiers, their weaknesses are pointed out in the Katyn massacre, perpetrated by the Red Army: on the eastern front, the war turns into apocalypse. On 21 June 1941, Germany launched more than three million of its soldiers on the Red Army as part of the colossal operation "Barbarossa", thus breaking the German-Soviet pact. In dealing with the battle of Moscow and the Stalingrad reconquest, this second part examines the psychological character of the victories, as well as their wide exploitation by propaganda of the belligerents.

programme.title: Marius and the sound of the waves
programme.desc: Emilie just had her first child, Marius. But very soon, something surprises him: Marius does not react to the sounds. Diagnosis falls: it is deaf deep.
programme.desc-more: Emilie just had her first child. Like all mothers, she filmed her son Marius' first moments. But very soon, something surprises him: Marius does not react to the sounds of his father's trombone. Diagnosis falls: it is deaf deep. Marius wouldn't hear a Boeing take off next to him. Then begins a forced immersion into an unknown world, made of medical appointments, expectations, hopes and doubts. The couple must reinvent their daily lives, learn sign language and rethink their future. From intimate images filmed over three years, the film tells from inside the shock of diagnosis, denial, and then the slow path to acceptance. Until that day when the couple discovers that a complex operation could give Marius the hearing.

programme.title: France - Cambodia, so far, so close
programme.desc: How did Cambodia, marked by genocide, become the host of the 20th Summit of La Francophonie? Back to historical links between Phnom Penh and Paris.
programme.desc-more: How did Cambodia, ravaged less than fifty years ago by one of the most deadly genocides of the twentieth century, become the host of the 20th Summit of La Francophonie? And what remains, more than 160 years after the protectorate chosen by King Norodom I in 1863, of the singular bond between Phnom Penh and Paris? The common history of the two countries is that of a passionate relationship: a protectorate requested rather than impossibly, an independence obtained without confrontation by Norodom Sihanouk in 1953, and then the collapse under Pol Pot's regime. Peace is negotiated in Paris at the 1991 Conference. Those who have lived it from the inside tell behind the scenes. Cambodian officials are talking about reconstruction, the delicate balance between China, Vietnam and the West, and the place France can still hold.

programme.title: Women of sin
programme.desc: At 36 years old, Karima Nadir has been waging a fierce struggle for the repeal of the liberticide laws in Morocco, including article 490 of the Criminal Code, which prohibits sexual relations outside marriage. In the presence of a member of Parliament or a senator, "Parliament Hebdo" proposes an informed rereading of the major parliamentary proceedings and discussions based on images and reports on the highlights of the week. This program, jointly directed by LCP-Assemblée Nationale and Public Sénat, provides insight into and understanding parliamentary news.

programme.title: Marius and the sound of the waves
programme.desc: Emilie just had her first child. Like all mothers, she filmed her son Marius' first moments. But very soon, something surprises him: Marius does not react to the sounds of his father's trombone. Diagnosis falls: it is deaf deep. Marius wouldn't hear a Boeing take off next to him. Then begins a forced immersion into an unknown world, made of medical appointments, expectations, hopes and doubts. The couple must reinvent their daily lives, learn sign language and rethink their future. From intimate images filmed over three years, the film tells from inside the shock of diagnosis, denial, and then the slow path to acceptance. Until that day when the couple discovers that a complex operation could give Marius the hearing.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS investigates an attack and goes to New Orleans to track down an active terrorist cell: local agents help them.
programme.desc-more: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Bishop is more determined than ever to avenge the murder of Qasim, his ex-boyfriend, since Gibbs and his team have been following a new lead.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: In a humorous and offbeat approach, this series highlights characters close to major historical figures of France, such as Vercingetorix, Jeanne d'Arc and Napoleon. Through a series of sketches in various historical contexts, the writers offer an unprecedented look at the landmarks of the past. Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

programme.title: School's over
programme.desc: A Parisian, who comes to teach English in Picardie, tries to adapt to life in the countryside and manage her new students very dissipated.
programme.desc-more: Agathe, a young, dynamic and life-filled English teacher, is very much appreciated by her Parisian students. However, her daily life changes when she learns that she was appointed to a small picturesque village of Picardie in Trouilly-sur-Selle. Determined to make a good impression, she moved to Gilbert and Simone, a welcoming couple who were happy to welcome her to their home. Yet, Agathe quickly discovers that Simone suffers from amnesia, making cohabitation somewhat difficult. The school year is expected to be complicated: at the pre-entry meeting, Agathe is increasing the bumblebees against her new colleagues, while her first hours with well-dipped students are just as chaotic. Over the days, she began to find her bearings in this new life, while developing an unexpected complicity with Raphael, her colleague teaching mathematics. Together, they navigate between the challenges of education and the unforeseen circumstances of a rural life that contrasts with its former Parisian daily life.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: In the 13th century, an archer of the army of late King Richard returned to England, bringing the crown of the sovereign before winning Nottingham.
programme.desc-more: In 1199 King Richard the Lion's Heart died in France in a battle, leaving his kingdom in the grip of uncertainty. Robin Longstride (Russell Crowe), a disillusioned archer of the army, decides to desert and finds himself playing an unexpected role: Sir Loxley, a recently deceased knight. On returning to England, he brought back the crown for the crown of Prince John, Richard's brother. Robin discovers the extent of corruption in the country and crosses the path of Marianne (Cate Blanchett), Loxley's widow, and her family, all in despair. While a plot threatens to plunge England into chaos, Robin, with the help of a band of outlawers, is engaged in a fierce struggle to defend the oppressed and restore justice, thus defying the authority of Prince John and his dark allies.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs was to give a field preparation course to young recruits, but he did not introduce himself. No one's heard from him since.
programme.desc-more: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs must quickly elucidate the death of a Navy captain, in order to save the life of the son of the deceased, who feels responsible for the tragedy.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: The Bodin's in Belgians
programme.desc: Maria Bodin and her son Christian are chosen by the Belgian sovereigns to organize a gala in honour of their 25 years of marriage. An event that will be organized at the Royal Palace in front of the sovereigns themselves. The duo must learn about the functioning of the Belgian monarchy and be able to live up to this special occasion. Selecting artists in the gala, getting used to princely language, having dinner with an atypical cook and wearing a royal outfit will not be simple tasks.

programme.title: Welcome to the Bodin's
programme.desc: The Bodins decided to organize a big evening in their farm to raise funds and rebuild the church of the village that Christian accidentally set fire to. They invite the comedians, actors, actors, and other singers they met during their tour or on TV sets to perform on an improvised stage in their courtyard, and beat the reminders of neighbours and acquaintances. It is thus a evening of high colour and rich in detonating guests that is announced in Pouziou-les-Trois-Galoches.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: After a meeting of anonymous addicts, Clayton Reeves attended the abduction of a friend of hers, Melissa, without being able to intervene. He is convinced that she was captured by her ex-companion, Eddie, who was raping and threatening her. Even though Melissa is not a Navy member, Gibbs accepts that his team is conducting the investigation.
programme.desc-more: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: In a humorous and offbeat approach, this series highlights characters close to major historical figures of France, such as Vercingetorix, Jeanne d'Arc and Napoleon. Through a series of sketches in various historical contexts, the writers offer an unprecedented look at the landmarks of the past. Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Mom, I missed the plane again.
programme.desc: In the effervescence of Christmas preparations, the McCallister family is about to go on holiday under the Florida sun, leaving behind the Chicago frimas. But between the suitcases to be closed, the tickets to be checked and the usual agitation of a crowded airport, a crucial detail is not at the attention of all: Kevin (Macaulay Culkin), the turbulent benjamin of the family, was still found alone... And this time, far away from home. He was in a game with his father's credit card, the boy mistakenly embarks on a plane to New York, while his parents, convinced of having him on board, take off to their destination without any doubt.Done to himself in Manhattan's urban jungle, Kevin, far from panicking, sees this forced adventure as a golden opportunity. Armed with his ingenuity and disconcerting audacity, he manages to make himself look like an adult, rents a luxurious suite in a palace and even offers the services of a limousine to go to Duncans Toy Chest, a gigantic toy shop where all his childhood dreams seem to be within reach. But the magic of Christmas also has its shadows: as he savors his freedom regained, Kevin crosses the gaze of two faces that ice his blood.Harry (Joe Pesci) and Marv (Daniel Stern), the unlucky burglar duo who had tried to break into his home two years earlier, are once again rumbling around. This time, they have a deal to settle... And revenge to be met. Kevin's dream is a nightmare: trapped in a huge hotel, hunted down by determined criminals, he'll have to redouble his imagination to escape them. Between wild chases in the halls of the palace, improvised traps and hilarious pros, the young hero will once again prove that intelligence and tricks can overcome the worst troubles. But in a city where everything seems possible, how far will he go to sow his pursuers and find his family? One thing is for sure: this time, the end-of-year celebrations are announced... Explosives.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), the NCIS director, finds himself in a desperate situation after being abducted by Hakim, a ruthless terrorist. Forced to produce a video in which he supports Afghan fighters, Vance desperately seeks a way to convey a message to his agents. After his release, he has to face the consequences of this traumatic experience while recovering from his injuries. At the same time, Officer Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon) is engaged in a complex investigation into the death of a soldier found sluggish in his jacuzzi, a case that is particularly delicate and enigmatic. As the team tracks a bomb-layer responsible for several attacks, Gibbs, who aspires to a well-deserved vacation, is forced to resume service to capture a fugitive robber. This sixteenth season explores Gibbs' mysterious past in depth, revealing unexpected facets of his history.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life
programme.desc: Every year, during the summer, shelters are filled with abandoned or mistreated pets. It is then the employees and volunteers of the shelters who take care of all these dogs, cats or other rabbits. They are very involved and work with goodwill and determination to ensure a better future in a safe home, in a responsible and loving master. The camera follows the teams and residents of several shelters throughout France with their daily lives, making moments, difficult moments but also episodes of joy.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life
programme.desc: Last summer, there was once again a record for the abandonment of animals, most of which are found in SPA shelters. There are nearly sixty scattered throughout France. Not including six territorial houses and impoundments. The backstage of these SPA shelters reveal how employees and volunteers are working daily with their neglected residents. It is then hundreds of animals, cats, dogs, puppies, kittens that are collected and waiting for a master to love.

A Christmas with pleasure
programme.desc: Lucy Collins is a young writer. The director of the Balaban film studios asked him to write the remake of a classic of the 1940s: "His happy wife!" To make her feel the atmosphere of the place, he offered her a holiday during the Christmas holidays at Biltmore estate where the film of the 1940s was shot. On the spot, by moving a hourglass that was one of the accessories of the feature film, Lucy found herself transported in 1947, in the middle of the filming of the original version of the film, in the middle of the age d'or d'Hllywood.

programme.title: The Christmas Treasure
programme.desc: On the eve of the Christmas holiday, archaeologist Stefanie Baxter embarked on an expedition to Iceland to find the legendary Lutin treasure and shelter it in a museum. With the help of her ex-husband, a translator specializing in dead languages, and her friend Oli, a pilot who accompanied her on many adventures, she launched a treasure hunt to reveal 13 clues that were supposed to lead her to a spoil of immeasurable value. But others covet it for less noble purposes and wealth is not always the ones that one believes.

programme.title: Anything I want for Christmas... It's you!
programme.desc: Becca and Robby's couple are not well. For Christmas, they try to make a few days of vacation together. They don't really believe in this solution to save their marriage, but in the small village of Gracious, nothing happens as they imagined.

programme.title: Emily's surprise Christmas
programme.desc: Emily works in a communications agency and she has to honour a contract in Jamie's former childhood town during the Christmas season. When she arrived at the station, she came across her old beautiful family, who, not pretending to know about the breakup between Emily and Jamie, took the young woman to spend Christmas with her.

programme.title: Catch : The Final Slam
programme.desc: The Final Slam. At the Plenitude Arena in Nanterre (Hautes-de-Seine).

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: In the bustling streets of New York, the Special Unit for Victims, led by the Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) determined, is facing disturbing cases that test their skills and humanity. In this 21st season, inspectors, including the faithful Fin Tutuola (Ice-T) and the insight Kat Tamin (Jamie Gray Hyder), are delving into complex investigations of sexual crimes, child abuse and domestic violence. Each episode reveals the emotional and moral challenges that team members face as they navigate between the pain of victims and the quest for justice. Unity, often confronted with failing systems and prejudices, must also manage its own internal struggles, while striving to restore hope and dignity to the people it serves. The series, rich in drama and tension, offers a free-ranging look at often neglected realities.
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: Catch : The Final Slam
programme.desc: The Final Slam is the largest catch event worn by content creators in France, organized by the streamer AmineMaTue. This spectacular show takes place at the Plenitude Arena in Nanterre, in the Hauts-de-Seine and combines confrontations of influencers, MMA fighters and professional wrestlers, all technically supervised by the APC Catch. In Main Event, a face-to-face event between Amine and Squeezie, then a multi-boxing shock between GregMMA and IbraTV, a team match, an international challenge with the former wrestler of WWE Raj Dhesi and, finally, the Final Rumble, a royal battle with 30 participants bringing together web stars and professional athletes.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Benson works with a young woman who asked her to help her remember details to find those who raped her.
programme.desc-more: In the bustling streets of New York, the Special Unit for Victims, led by the Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) determined, is facing disturbing cases that test their skills and humanity. In this 21st season, inspectors, including the faithful Fin Tutuola (Ice-T) and the insight Kat Tamin (Jamie Gray Hyder), are delving into complex investigations of sexual crimes, child abuse and domestic violence. Each episode reveals the emotional and moral challenges that team members face as they navigate between the pain of victims and the quest for justice. Unity, often confronted with failing systems and prejudices, must also manage its own internal struggles, while striving to restore hope and dignity to the people it serves. The series, rich in drama and tension, offers a free-ranging look at often neglected realities.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life
programme.desc: Every year, during the summer, shelters are filled with abandoned or mistreated pets. It is then the employees and volunteers of the shelters who take care of all these dogs, cats or other rabbits. They are very involved and work with goodwill and determination to ensure a better future in a safe home, in a responsible and loving master. The camera follows the teams and residents of several shelters throughout France with their daily lives, making moments, difficult moments but also episodes of joy.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life
programme.desc: The series follows the daily life of SPA shelters. A sincere immersion in a universe where every adoption is a victory, and every story a source of hope.
programme.desc-more: Last summer, there was once again a record for the abandonment of animals, most of which are found in SPA shelters. There are nearly sixty scattered throughout France. Not including six territorial houses and impoundments. The backstage of these SPA shelters reveal how employees and volunteers are working daily with their neglected residents. It is then hundreds of animals, cats, dogs, puppies, kittens that are collected and waiting for a master to love.

When she realizes that John and Jack are one and the same person, she dares not say anything to frown him.

programme.title: The secret of a perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Hayley is a fashionable interior designer on social media. Having lost her father six months ago, she tries to support her mother, overwhelmed by sadness. When she searches her garage, she discovers a picture of her mother next to a young boy. She learns that she has an uncle whose existence she did not know.

programme.title: Looking for Christmas magic
programme.desc: Harrington Davis is a scandal when he says he hates the end-of-year parties, he who made a fortune with his Christmas novels. April, the public relations officer of her publishing house, drags him on a promotional tour to save the release of her next book. Thanks to her, he will split up armor and rediscover the magic of Christmas.

programme.title: An Eternal Story for Christmas
programme.desc: After her husband disappeared, allegedly dead on mission with the Marines, Danielle found herself alone to raise her daughter Audrey. She, who is asking more and more questions, asks her to replace the evening story with anecdotes about her father.

programme.title: The Christmas Ballerina
programme.desc: A well-known former dancer, Lilly raised her niece alone, whose mother died in a car accident. As gifted as she is, she is one day recruited to play the main role of "Casse-Noisette", whose choreographer is the former boyfriend of her aunt.

programme.title: An unexpected invitation for Christmas
programme.desc: Three ghosts who were sent to instil the spirit of Christmas are confronted by a young man who does not look like the grinches they are used to caring for.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Fear still reigns at the Academy. Jessica, who was just released from prison, has to redouble her energy to put it right and make sure the show continues.
programme.desc-more: Accused of murder, Jessica (Bénédicte Delmas) finds herself behind bars, while her colleagues at the Academy continue their rehearsals, determined not to let this tragedy start their passion for the show. When she was released, Jessica invested herself in her life, but fate was subject to other trials. Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), for her part, learns that Louis (Romeo Sarfati) must undergo a cardiac transplant, a news that further complicates the dynamics of the group. Meanwhile, Mathias (Lionel Auguste), who was the victim of an accident, faced a difficult reality after losing the use of her legs. Jessica's health is deteriorating, because she discovers that she has breast cancer. Followed by Laure at the Gulf Clinic, she refuses to let her disease define her existence. This thirteenth season is marked by dramatic events that upset the daily lives of this joyful band, facing unprecedented emotional and physical challenges.

programme.title: Once upon a time Christmas in Castle Creek
programme.desc: Amelia, who dreams of running a Christmas decoration shop, finds herself competing with Vic, who dreams of opening a chocolate shop. Both want to buy the same shop, but forced to team up, they start to tie one to the other.

programme.title: Christmas at Crystal Falls
programme.desc: Joy, who leads a good career in Washington, returns to Crystal Falls to look after her aunt Ruby, who was immobilized after a fall. The young woman agreed to prepare the Biscuit Festival, which Ruby traditionally had in charge of.

programme.title: The key to a successful Christmas
programme.desc: Lisa, a specialist in shop design and decoration, and Oliver, her partner, make many professional trips abroad. But both dream of opening their own shop. One day, the young woman went to Evergreen, her hometown, where she found the atmosphere of Christmas her childhood. Lisa meets Kevin, a businessman, who is also from the village. Little by little, between the two young people who are used to moving constantly, the charm acts.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: A cartographer, whose employer is under contract with the state, is murdered. In addition, an unknown person is attacking former CBI agents.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: In Gotham City, a few years after General Zod's defeat, Barry Allen, a.k.a. Flash, was called in an emergency by Bruce Wayne to help him. Once Barry's mission was accomplished, he heard from his father, accused of killing his mother a few years earlier. Always traumatized by this event, and disturbed by the return to his life of Iris West, of which he was once in love, Flash is thinking of intervening on his own past.

programme.title: Shazam! The rage of the gods
programme.desc: A young man who can turn into a superhero with a magic word must once again use his power to save the planet.
programme.desc-more: A visit to the Acropolis Museum in Athens is interrupted by the invasion of Hespera and Kalypso, two of Atlas' daughters, who grab a magic stick, which they rush to bring to the old sorcerer, still detained in a cave. But at the end of their mission, heroes are criticized for the damage they have done. And Shazam is sadly learning that Freddy, Eugene, Pedro and Mary now want to fly with their own wings.

programme.title: A new start for Christmas
programme.desc: Tracie and Rick are the divorced parents of two little girls. Rick is a singer who can hardly live his music, while Tracie is a waitress in a restaurant. Girls live with their mother and spend half of their holidays and holidays with their father. This year, they no longer want to celebrate Christmas alternately but with the whole family, gathered in Tracie's family home. But these latter, and more particularly Mimi the grandmother of the little ones, nourish a deep aversion to their former father and his lifestyle, considered decadent. To please her little daughters whom she sees little, Mimi agrees to welcome their father for four days, to the great Dam de Tracie who hopes that this one will not make waves...

programme.title: A wonderful Christmas with the family
programme.desc: As the parties approached, Maddy and her son Wesley went to his parents' homes, owners of a luxury hotel in a ski resort. Maddy met Paul, a young widower who raised his son, Cody, alone. The two boys become instant friends as Paul and Maddy get closer and closer. They will soon find out that they share much more than they imagined...

programme.title: Christmas with the ambassador
programme.desc: Ambassador of Belmare to Washington, Magnus Anderson hates garlands, fir trees and other decorations. He nevertheless agreed to hire Emily Barnes, decorator, to put the embassy in the colours of Christmas. Little by little, he and his daughter are getting closer to the young woman.

programme.title: Hercules Poirot
programme.desc: Is Poirot getting too old? Should he retire and cross his exciting career? Forget her taste for the investigation and get to seams? Disturbed by the disparaging remarks of a teenage girl, who doubts her abilities, the detective questions herself. This eleventh season of "Hercules Poirot" adapts, among others, "Rendez-vous avec la mort", one of the most famous novels of the Queen of Crime, which relates the murder of the ruthless Madame Croyton on a trip to Petra. Ariadne Oliver, more adventurous and sentimental than ever, has a fundamental role in this part of the series.

programme.title: Hercules Poirot
programme.desc: Will Poirot ever be able to take a vacation? All his attempts were a baffling failure. First in the Cornwalls, where he plans to take the air with Hastings. Poirot's chivalry takes little rest, and they are soon to be thrown to the rescue of a young damsel in danger. In Whitcombe, after a busy London season, it is an antique flight that disturbs their serenity. Always quick to spread the mess in delicate affairs, and this despite all the good will of the world, Hastings does not lose anything of its comic potential. A pinch of humor welcome in the dreadful world of crime.

programme.title: Hercules Poirot
programme.desc: Belgian Hercule Poirot continues to use his retirement to practice his talents as a private detective in England. He conducts his investigations with a slender and acute sense of crime psychology. With the valuable help of his faithful Hastings, he also joined the services of former Inspector Japp of Scotland Yard, who became assistant to the Commissioner. Poirot investigates the mysterious death of a couple, made up of suicide, about the murder of several notables attributed to a secret society. He also tries to solve a series of mysteries in the Swiss Alps, before leaving the scene permanently. A 13th and final season marked by the return of the main characters of the first seasons: Captain Hastings, Inspector Japp and Miss Lemon.

programme.title: Hunger Games: The Fire
programme.desc: In a dystopic future where social inequalities have shaped a world divided into twelve districts oppressed by the Capitol, the Hunger Games remain a brutal reminder of the implacable authority of the regime. After their unexpected victory in the 74th edition, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) became, despite them, the faces of silent resistance. Their act of final distrust in the arena, perceived as a gesture of love by the public but as a provocation by the power, sow the seeds of an dissatisfaction that now roared through Panem. As the two young men begin a Victory Tower imposed by the Capitol, each public appearance becomes a perilous exercise. In the spotlight, they must embody the image of a loving couple, a symbol of peace and submission, while President Snow (Donald Sutherland) observes, impassively, their slightest false step. But behind the flamboyant costumes designed by Cinna (Lenny Kravitz) and the forced smiles, Katniss feels pressure rising. The districts, once resigned, are beginning to see in it more than just a survivor: a spark of hope. Anodizing gestures – a three-finger greeting, a exchanged look – take on a subversive dimension, fuelling the anger of the Capitol.While Peeta, torn between her sincere love for Katniss and her loyalty to a system he has always known, tries to play the game, the young woman discovers the extent of the manipulations orchestrated by Snow. Haymitch Abernathy (Woody Harrelson), their disillusioned mentor, and Effie Trinket (Elizabeth Banks), their always impeccable but increasingly troubled escorts, become ambivalent allies in this deadly chess game. When Snow announces a special edition of the Hunger Games bringing together former winners, Katniss understands that the trap is closing. The Capitol will no longer be content with symbols: it demands blood.Between the threat that is weighing on its loved ones, fragile alliances with tributes like Finnick Odair (Sam Claflin) or Johanna Mason, and the revelation of secrets buried on the true nature of the rebellion, Katniss finds himself at the heart of a much larger conflict than games. Every decision could trigger an open war – or seal its destiny. In this world where survival is measured in strategies and sacrifices, a question persists: how far will it go to protect those whom it loves, and at what cost?

programme.title: Hunger Games
programme.desc: After a series of blood-crash revolts, the United States has left room for Panem, a totalitarian nation divided into 12 submissive districts, each exploited for the resources of a luxurious and cruel Capitol. To remind everyone of the price of rebellion, the regime organizes an annual television event as popular as it is human: the Hunger Games. Twenty-four teenagers, a boy and a girl drawn at random in each district, are thrown into a deadly arena where only one rule applies: kill or be killed. The winners gain glory, the losers offer their death in entertainment. And for the Capitol, the show must continue.Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence), 16, has learned from childhood to survive in the ruins of District 12, a mining territory where hunger is rumbling and where hope is measured in pieces of stolen bread. She is an outstanding hunter, and every day she braves the limits of the forbidden forest to feed her family, composed of her mother, broken by grief, and her little sister, Prim (Willow Shields), who is gentle and vulnerable. When the day of the Month arrives – this drawing of lots that seals the fate of the Tributes – Katniss only has a prayer: let the name Prim not be called. Yet when the spell falls upon her sister, a visceral instinct pushes her to act. Without hesitation, she volunteered to replace her, sealing her entry into the arena and, perhaps, her death sentence.

programme.desc: Diving into the heart of RAID, the elite unit of the National Police, which is celebrating its 40th anniversary this year. programme.desc-more: Dive into the heart of RAID, the elite unit of the National Police, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year. programme.desc-more: Accused of murder, Jessica (Bénédicte Delmas) finds herself behind bars, while her colleagues at the Academy continue their rehearsals, determined not to let this tragedy start their passion for the show. When she was released, Jessica invested herself in her life, but fate was subject to other trials. Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), for her part, learns that Louis (Romeo Sarfati) must undergo a cardiac transplant, a news that further complicates the dynamics of the group. Meanwhile, Mathias (Lionel Auguste), who was the victim of an accident, faced a difficult reality after losing the use of her legs. This thirteenth season is marked by dramatic events that upset the daily lives of this joyful band, facing unprecedented emotional and physical challenges.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.sub-title: We have to save Grace Van Pelt
programme.desc: As he goes home, Wayne finds out Grace's missing. There is every indication that she was abducted by the man who attacked the former members of the CBI. Richard Haibach is the main suspect in this case. The team is amazed when the latter spontaneously reports to the FBI.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: Mascarade
programme.desc: Adrien, a former dancer with an accident-broken career, lives in the hooks of Martha, a former movie star for whom he feels nothing but contempt. His life turns around when he meets Margot, a young and beautiful con artist who, like him, moans his body against a luxury life...
programme.desc-more: In Nice, in a beautiful hotel room, Adrien Saillard and his companion, Margot Hansen prepares for their next stage. But Adrien and Margot are not actors but crooks, who set up stories at the expense of their victims. Then one of them, Simon Laurenti, arrives armed and shoots Margot. Some time later, while Simon's trial is taking place, various witnesses come to the stand to first evoke the past of Adrien, a promising young dancer whose career was broken by a motorcycle accident, before he became the lover of Martha Duval, a former film star, who became her protector.

programme.sub-title: Fries, prepared dishes, pizza, all melted frozen
programme.desc: Four in ten French people consume frozen food up to four times a week. Frozen products have invaded household freezers, supermarket shelves and even the kitchens of some restaurant owners. Unfortunately, taste and quality are not always on the list.
programme.desc-more: Four in ten French people consume frozen food up to four times a week. Frozen products have invaded freezers, supermarket shelves and even kitchens in many restaurants. Picard, Ecomiam, Thiriet or brand distributors, everyone wants their share of the cake, including the influencers stars. Mister V has launched his own brand of frozen pizzas. But taste and quality are not always on the list. Hidden sugars, fake cheeses reconstituted in the laboratory, some products reserve many surprises. The industry also has workers who are sometimes overworked in manufacturing plants. Not to mention some restaurants that do not indicate that their dishes are bought, or even ready to go.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life (Sid and Justin) S6 (No.5)
programme.desc: "Sid and Justin"Swipe into the emotion with this series of real that looks poignantly at the backstage of SPA shelters and reveals how employees and volunteers save, care for and try to get their residents adopted as quickly as possible! All are animated by the same passion and one credo: finding the best home for each of them. Cats, dogs, puppies, kittens... Each episode takes you to the heart of the upsetting stories of these animals collected, abused, abandoned... that wait only for the love of a new family. From their arrival at the shelter to their adoption, the series of reals traces their journey, between care, hope, joy and doubts. A sincere and emotional immersion in a universe where each adoption is a victory, each story a source of hope and inspiration.

programme.title: Tattoo Cover : Tattoo Saviours
programme.desc: On vacation in Mauritius with his son, Delphine succumbs to the desire to get tattooed the portrait of Michael Jackson, above the ankle. But the tattooer decided to add his personal touch. Coming especially from Switzerland, Claire wants to cover a tattoo cut in half by a scar on the bottom of her belly. Its objective: to regain a harmonious skin. Ludovic, a Flemish with a well-dimmed sense of humor, stops at the shop for a staggered tattoo. A typical case that promises nice surprises and good laughter. In Cagnes-sur-Mer, Vincent pays tribute to his father through a symbolic tattoo. This humble and discreet man raised his children with strength and courage. To sublimate it, Maya and Charly unite their talent around a cover full of emotion.

programme.title: Tattoo Cover : Tattoo Saviours
programme.desc: In Lyon, Marty has a delicate mission: tattooing Anaïs, a young woman who has undergone a double mastectomy. Thanks to his cover, he will help her regain some of her femininity and confidence in her. At the shop, Gisèle comes to cover an old, crazy tattoo, a relic far away from the woman she has become, caring for in psychiatry, dedicated and caring. Vincent, on his leg, wears a tattoo he no longer assumes. Express transformation is needed. Finally, from Belgium, Désirée, a young sparkling woman, comes to correct a spelling mistake tattooed behind her ankle. With this cover, she turns the page and turns this mistake into a pattern she will now wear with a smile.

programme.desc: Nations Championship. Day five. England / Japan.

programme.desc-more: The show "Star Academy" – which saw the birth of many successful singers such as Nolwenn Leroy, Olivai Ruiz or Jenifer – appeared in 2001 – has made a big return to TF1 in 2022 after fourteen years of absence. For several months, anonymous singers and singers live together in Dammaria-les-Lys Castle to take an intensive training with renowned teachers to advance them and help them to give the best of themselves. Their days are thus littered with classes, rehearsals, but also moments of relaxation and complicity in the heart of an exceptional experience that will mark them forever.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: In January 2023 at the Court of Assises du Mans, a high-voltage trial is about to begin. In the box, three men and one woman. They are accused of burning alive Aurélie Mignot, a mother of no history, in front of her own children. The drama took place in La Flèche on the night of April 28, 2019.
programme.desc-more: In the spring of 2001, Louis and Bernadette Moulin returned home to Pont-Saint-Esprit. A strange smell floats in the house. Intrigued, they found a bomb under their bed. Set to explode in the middle of the night, the device could have cost them their lives. Who wanted to kill this couple without a story, and especially why? The lead of a plot related to Louis's work, responsible for the safety of a nuclear site, is first considered. But soon another element is disturbing this hypothesis: their daughter Delphine has disappeared, as has her companion, Vincent Blachère. The young couple left Montpellier in a hurry. Have they fled a danger or are they trying to escape investigators?

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Yolène, 28, and Florian, 26, are waiting for their third child. For the first two, the couple had used in vitro fertilization. As for Anilia, she is pregnant for the second time. Although the father left, the thirty-year-old remained positive. She decides to give birth with her best friend, who works as a child care assistant at the hospital in Poissy. For their part, 26-year-old Marta and 27-year-old Carlos will welcome their first baby. Carlos is very relaxed, ready for all eventualities and approaches this delivery with great lightness.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Since the first shootings, five years ago, from "Baby boom" to the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain-en-Laye, more than a hundred babies were born under the eye of the cameras. The work of doctors, midwives and caregivers is a cross-section of the future parents' lives. For the first time, teams from the show went back to see Gabin, Cassandre, Andrea and Marie to show them the images of their coming to the world. Emotional moments are at the meeting.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: For every mother who arrives at maternity with contractions, the questions of the nursing staff are always the same: can you assess the pain on a scale of 1 to 10 and would you like a peridural? In France, one in five women prefers to give birth naturally. The other four, for their part, were anxious to benefit from the peridural so as not to suffer as their mothers at one time. It is an anesthesia that is supposed to alleviate the sometimes terrible pains of the world.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.
programme.desc-more: While Julian (Austin Nichols) finally made the decision to move to Brooke (Sophia Bush), she was preparing to welcome Alex Dupre (Jana Kramer), a famous actress who would become the face of her new clothing collection. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), Brooke's best friend, goes to the airport to get Alex back, but the meeting is not going as planned, as Alex proves to be unbearable and capricious. Meanwhile, Nathan (James Lafferty) was under pressure because of the blackmail exerted by Renee (Kate Voegele), which prompted him to worry about his career as a basketball player. Although he tries to reassure Clay (Robert Buckley) by saying that he did not have an affair with Renee, tensions are rising and secrets are beginning to emerge. The relationships between the characters become more complex as they navigate between ambitions, betrayals and desires, each seeking to find its place in this tumultuous world.

programme.title: Welcome home
programme.desc: The most famous guest house competition offers many surprises! Discover exceptional areas, moments of sharing and conviviality... but also competition and sharp criticism, prepare yourself for twists at each stage! Where the houses have charm and the guests of character: Every week, four couples open the doors of their guest house and receive themselves in turn to judge each other! From the reception to the quality of services, to the inspection of the house and its exteriors, to the quality/price ratio... everything will be checked and noted without concession. At the end of the week, only one duo will win the coveted title of "Best Guest House" and leave with the sum of €3,000.

programme.title: The Villa of Broken Hearts
programme.desc: A group of anonymous men and women or who have already participated in reality TV shows in the past is housed in a superb villa with the aim of solving their problems related to their love life. To help them, the seduction coach Lucie Mariotti offers them a galant appointment with suitors from outside. The expert is also present at individual coaching sessions to try to learn more about the failures of their sentimental past and help them identify the nature of the brakes to their love happiness.

programme.title: The idea of being with you
programme.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway), a 40-year-old divorced woman, juggles her career as an art gallery owner and her role as a dedicated mother to her teenage daughter, Izzy (Ella Rubin). Their complicity is palpable, and they share precious moments, especially at a music festival where they go with friends. It is there that Solène crosses the path of Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), a 24-year-old pop star who dedicates a song to her, triggering an unexpected spark between them. As the encounters progress, their attraction becomes an intense passion, and Hayes begins to frequent the gallery of Solene, deepening their connection. However, their age difference, initially perceived as a mere detail, becomes a source of tension when their relationship becomes public. As Solene navigates between her mother's responsibilities and her emerging feelings, she faces the challenges that this unexpected connection generates, both personally and socially.

Thanks to his cover, he will help her regain some of her femininity and confidence in her. At the shop, Gisèle comes to cover an old, crazy tattoo, a relic far away from the woman she has become, caring for in psychiatry, dedicated and caring. Vincent, on his leg, wears a tattoo he no longer assumes. Express transformation is needed. Finally, from Belgium, Désirée, a young sparkling woman, comes to correct a spelling mistake tattooed behind her ankle. With this cover, she turns the page and turns this mistake into a pattern she will now wear with a smile.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: In the spring of 2001, Louis and Bernadette Moulin returned home to Pont-Saint-Esprit. A strange smell floats in the house. Intrigued, they found a bomb under their bed. Set to explode in the middle of the night, the device could have cost them their lives. Who wanted to kill this couple without a story, and especially why? The lead of a plot related to Louis's work, responsible for the safety of a nuclear site, is first considered. But soon another element is disturbing this hypothesis: their daughter Delphine has disappeared, as has her companion, Vincent Blachère. The young couple left Montpellier in a hurry. Have they fled a danger or are they trying to escape investigators?

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: At the maternity of Poissy, each mother imagines her delivery in another way, even if Mother Nature, behind the scenes, premeditates very different issues.
programme.desc-more: Women's expectations for childbirth are high. Some want to control everything, others hope that this moment is as short as possible or that everything will take place according to their convictions, even if it is suffering. For almost a month, the series followed the daily maternity day of the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain. Midwives, doctors, caregivers, childcare workers are mobilized every day to help mothers live in the best conditions this unforgettable moment.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: In February 1982, Amandine, the first test baby, was born in Clamart, a miracle made possible by Professors René Frydman and Jacques Testart.
programme.desc-more: In February 1982, the first test baby was born at the maternity hospital of Antoine-Béclère de Clamart, Hauts-de-Seine, thanks in particular to Professors René Frydman and Jacques Testart. A step forward that now allows one in thirty children to be born in France thanks to a medically assisted reproductive technique. Many doctors have since taken over the torch of these two Professors, including Michael Grynberg. He is a specialist in reproductive medicine and manages several hundred births every year.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: Severely injured by gun, Clay and Quinn struggle to stay alive. Julian, for his part, is doing everything possible to occupy little Jamie.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: Emergency Calls
programme.sub-title: Critical Accidents and Emergencies: Maximum Alert for Besançon Samu
programme.desc: The Besançon Samu is constantly mobilized with nearly 4000 interventions per year. Road accidents, heart distress patients or post-traumatic amnesia situations, missions are proceeding at a steady pace. Doctors intervene without delay, not only to treat but also to reassure.
programme.desc-more: The Besançon Samu is constantly mobilized with nearly 4000 interventions per year and missions sometimes out of standard. Road accidents, heart distress patients, post-traumatic amnesia situations, the procedures are proceeding at a steady pace. In this city of eastern France, at the gates of Switzerland, with a population of 120,000, these doctors intervene without delay, not only to treat but also to reassure. It is not only about saving the wounded, but sometimes also about appeaseing anxious families.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: A rigid academic inspector arrives at school and refers Captain La Barrée to the first pretext he hates! He replaces her and runs.
programme.desc-more: The arrival of a rigid and haughty academic inspector at the school of the Pirate Academy causes a real upheaval among the students. The latter, determined to bring order to rule, did not hesitate to send Captain La Barrée, a charismatic figure and appreciated by Planktons, for the slightest pretext. His replacement does not go unnoticed, because he embarks on strict courses, constantly reprimanding his young students. Plankton, disgusted by this new authority, are encamping to thwart the inspector's plans. With the support of their former captain, who looks after them in a more or less discreet manner, they are developing a bold plan to bring down this tyrannical inspector. This battle between freedom to learn and authoritarianism promises unexpected twists and will test the team spirit of young pirates, determined to defend their school and their values.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: Andrew invited Dolores to watch the shooting stars, but he discovered that the Pachas had taken possession of them. Finn and Sam decide to intervene.
programme.desc-more: In the episode "Un amour de vigie" of the series "Pirate Academy", Andrew, a young romantic pirate, invites Dolores, his comrade, to climb up to the vigie to admire the show of the shooting stars. This enchanting moment quickly turns into a delicate situation when they discover that the vigil was invaded by a group of Pachas, fearsome pirates known for their unpredictable temperament and penchant for looting. As Andrew tried to convince Dolores to remain calm in the face of this threat, Finn and Sam, two other crew members, decided to intervene to save their friends. A confrontation between young pirates and Pashas is then set in motion, where ruse and bravery will be put to the test. As the episode unfolds, unexpected alliances are formed and tensions emerge, revealing the real motivations of the characters and the stakes of their quest for freedom.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: Planktons fought the Pachas in a naval battle, but they recovered a new boat. Captain La Barrée has a trick for her students.
programme.desc-more: Finn, Sam and Andrew, three young pirate seekers, are entering the formidable Pirate Academy, a school where rivalry is as intense as the waves of the ocean. Upon arrival, they were assigned to the Plankton class, a group often underestimated, and found themselves quickly competing with the Pachas class, students renowned for their navigation and combat skills. In a naval battle that puts their ingenuity and courage to the test, pressure rises. To help them overcome this obstacle, their teacher, Captain La Barrée, a charismatic and cunning pirate, offers them an unorthodox solution: cheating. As tensions get stronger and the stakes get higher, Finn, Sam and Andrew have to decide how far they are ready to go to prove their worth and gain respect for their peers. Friendship, loyalty and honour will be tested in this thrilling adventure.
