programme.title: OSS 117 : Rio no longer responds
programme.desc: After a mission to Gstaad, the famous French spy was sent to Rio to find a former Nazi and to retrieve information that jeopardized France.
programme.desc-more: After a perilous mission to Gstaad, secret agent Hubert Bonisseur de la Bath (Jean Dujardin) was dispatched to Brazil for a delicate operation. His mission: to recover a compromising microfilm containing the names of French collaborators in exchange for a substantial sum of money destined for Von Zimmel (Rüdiger Vogler), a former Nazi. In Rio de Janeiro, Hubert found himself in contact with Mossad agents, who were also in the footsteps of Von Zimmel, seeking to bring him back to Israel to be tried for his crimes. Among them, the seductive Lieutenant-Colonel Dolores (Louise Monot) is forced to team up with Hubert, a duo as unexpected as it is explosive. Together, they try to find Heinrich (Alex Lutz), the son of Von Zimmel, who is hiding in a community of hippies. Between political tensions and whoops, Hubert will have to navigate a world where humour and action are mixed, while keeping in mind the importance of his mission.

programme.desc: Planktons and Ecumeurs are in full orientation in the jungle when a monkey arrives. Sam claims to be able to communicate with him.
programme.desc-more: In the episode entitled "Monkey business" of the "Pirate Academy" series, young recruits of Plankton and Ecumeurs find themselves immersed in a thrilling orientation exercise in the heart of a dense and mysterious jungle. As they try to navigate through challenges and puzzles, an unexpected event occurs: the appearance of a mischievous monkey who seems to have his own agenda. The latter, with its acrobatics and mimics, quickly caught the attention of young pirates. Sam (one of the main characters), convinced of having a particular gift, claims to be able to communicate with this intriguing animal. While the group is divided between skeptics and believers, the interaction between Sam and the monkey leads to a series of crazy and unexpected situations. This episode highlights the importance of communication, friendship and hidden talents, while adding a touch of humour and adventure to the initiatory journey of future pirates.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.sub-title: The pirate, the parrot and the mother
programme.desc: Finn is fighting his mom's portrait with Griff the parrot. The cascades and traps are chained on the gallion to get the portrait.
programme.desc-more: In the colourful world of the "Académie des Pirates", Griff, a young pirate full of dreams and ambitions, discovers an ancient portrait of the mother of his friend Finn. This portrait, which he admires with increasing affection, quickly becomes a source of lust for him. However, Griff's faithful parrot, who has the unfortunate habit of covering objects, takes hold of the precious image, holding it firmly in his beak. In the face of this messy situation, Griff finds himself in a dead end: he eagerly wants to get the portrait back without his comrades from the academy discovering his secret attachment to Finn's mom. As he tries to get the image back, Griff must navigate through a series of hilarious misunderstandings and unexpected challenges, while realizing the importance of friendship and loyalty in this world of adventures.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: Finn wants to look like a heroic pirate for the class portrait. He found some rutilating boots, but too small for him at Captain La Barrée.
programme.desc-more: In the episode "Right in his boots" of the series "Pirate Academy", Finn, a young pirate aspiring, is preparing for a class portrait that could make all the difference in his quest for recognition. Desiring to embody the image of the heroic pirate, he set out to look for the perfect accessory: a pair of boots that reflects the courage and boldness of the legendary flibers. His adventure led him to Captain La Barrée, an emblematic figure of the pirate world, known for his epic treasures and stories. However, the boots he found were too small for him, which made his mission difficult. While Finn has to face this difficulty, he discovers that appearance does not do everything and that he must draw from his own courage and creativity to stand out. This initiatory journey leads him to redefine what it really means to be a pirate, beyond the clichés.

programme.title: The twelve works of Asterix
programme.desc: Asterix and Obelix are taking up a new challenge launched by Julius Caesar, more than ever overtaken by the valiant resistance of the Gallic village to the armies of Rome.
programme.desc-more: Pushed to the end by the determination of the Gauls, Julius Caesar, the Roman leader, saw his army wipe out the crushing defeats against this intrepid village. Convinced that these warriors can only be gods, he concocts a bold plan to prove the opposite: to propose to the Gauls an epic challenge composed of twelve works, inspired by the trials of Hercules. If Asterix (Roger Carel) and Obelix (Jacques Morel), chosen as champions of their village, succeed in accomplishing these impossible missions, Caesar promises to recognize his defeat and to liberate Gaul. If not, they will have to submit to Roman supremacy. Equipped with the famous magic potion of Panoramix (Henri Virlogeux), which gives them an incredible strength, Asterix and Obelix embark on an adventure filled with humor and unexpected adventures. Through tumultuous trials, they will have to show courage, cunning and friendship to overcome the obstacles posed by Caesar and his army.

programme.title: The Unicorn School
programme.desc: In an enchanting setting where unicorn magic coexistes with the challenges of everyday life, Mrs Wildwood, the wise director of the Unicorn School, is making an urgent appeal to the Sapphires, a group of talented students. Their mission: to evacuate the wild unicorns from the vicinity of an erupting volcano, an imminent threat that threatens the safety of mythical creatures. As the team prepares to face the dangers of this heroic task, Sophia (Kamaia Fairburn), a bold and determined student, sees an unhoped-for opportunity. She decides to take advantage of this situation to go looking for another Crown Star, a magical artifact of vital importance. As the episode unfolds, the Sapphires will not only have to unite their forces to save the unicorns, but will also navigate through trials that will test their courage and friendship, while discovering the hidden truths about their own abilities.
programme.desc-more: Sophia, an ordinary teenager, sees her life swing when she receives a mysterious invitation to the unicorn school, a legendary establishment located on an enchanted island. On board a magical boat, it crosses glittering waters before arriving in this magical world, where magic and friendship reign as masters. Upon her arrival, she was welcomed by a fascinating faculty of mythical creatures and benevolent wise men, who revealed that her hidden powers must be developed to learn how to communicate with these majestic animals. On the island, Sophia is friendly with five other teenagers, each chosen for his unique abilities. Together, they dive into captivating lessons about the magic of unicorns, but quickly discover that their idyllic sanctuary is threatened by dark forces. As they try to master their skills, they will face unexpected dangers that could jeopardize their future and that of the school.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Within the secret Phoenix society, an organization acting in the shadows to protect the interests of the US government, Angus "Mac" MacGyver (Lucas Till) uses his intelligence and ingenuity to get out of the most perilous situations. In the second season, he was under the supervision of Matty Webber (Meredith Eaton), former superior of Jack Dalton (George Eads) to the CIA, who entrusted him with increasingly complex missions. At the same time, Wilt (Justin Hires) was sent to espionage training, learning to navigate the dangerous world of intelligence. Between international intrigues and technological challenges, MacGyver struggles to save lives while testing his unique skills.

programme.title: To follow with Loïc de La Mornais
To follow with Loïc de La Mornais
Christmas at the ranch
programme.desc: Erin, a dedicated occupational therapist and single mother of two mischievous young girls, leads a busy life between her work and the education of her children. Widow for several years, she has learned to move forward, but the end-of-year celebrations still revive in her a mixture of nostalgia and melancholy. When her mother, usually present at her side for Christmas, announces her departure on a cruise, Erin is forced to rethink her plans. Under the enthusiastic pressure of her daughters, who dream of discovering life in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts to spend her father's texan ranch, Gary, a bulwark and distant man whom she has carefully avoided for years. The ranch, with its rustic stables and breathtaking sunsets, is a world apart, far from the urban agitation that Erin knows. But it is also the place where unsaid and old resentment resurface. Gary, a man with a heart as vast as the land he owns, carries the weight of a past that has taken his daughter away from him. The tensions are palpable, and every exchange seems to revive injuries that never really healed. Yet, in the midst of this landscape full of history, an unexpected encounter will change everything. Mateo (author/actor not specified in the data), the charismatic owner of the local Mexican restaurant, embodies a joy of life and generosity that contrast with Gary's mutism. Between spicy dishes, shared laughter and complicit eyes, Erin is surprised to feel increasingly attracted by this man whose simplicity and human warmth deeply affect her.

programme.title: Christmas with a heart
programme.desc: Christmas in Crawleigh has never been so emotionally charged. After years of climbing the ranks of a prestigious and exhausting New York career, Sam returned to his small hometown, with a heavy heart and a slender soul. Her existence, which she thought was perfectly controlled, has just collapsed like a castle of cards, leaving her destabilized and in search of comfort. Between the glittering garlands and the snowy streets of this village, where everything seems unchanged, she hopes to find some of the family warmth she has so missed. His mother, who is always as welcoming, opens her arms, but it is another meeting that will upset his stay: Noah's, his youthful love, remained anchored in this picturesque setting as a living memory. Noah never left Crawleigh. He is always as generous and committed as he is, and he devotes his time to helping the poorest in the community, organizing collections, hot meals and events to give the smile back to those who have been abused by life. When Sam saw him at work, she rediscovered this part of herself that she had buried under the records and meetings: this desire to make a difference, this simple joy of sharing and giving. Gradually, she gets dragged into her projects, regaining the pleasure of small things – a shared laugh, an accomplice look, the happiness of seeing eyes light up through a thoughtful gesture. While they work side by side to organize the village's great Christmas party, the old sparks between them are reviving, brighter than ever. Snow walks, conversations in front of a hot chocolate, memories that go back to the surface... Everything seems to bring them back to what they once were, and to what they might have become. Yet Sam cannot help but wonder whether this enchanted parenthesis is just a sweet lure, or whether Crawleigh – and Noah – might well be the port of attachment that she has never stopped looking for.

programme.title: At the scene of the crime
programme.desc: Back to the Gaston Moysset case, an old man brutally murdered by a boxing champion who almost committed the perfect crime.
programme.desc-more: On June 3, 1994, a carer who was responsible for providing care to an old couple living in Bezons, Val-d'Oise, discovered a horror spectacle when she arrived at their home. Gaston Moysset, 89, lies in a pool of blood, with his skull broken. He died four days later at the hospital. His wife, witness to the tragedy, was never able to help the police with Alzheimer's disease. After a long investigation, the PJ still hasn't solved the murder. The victim's grandson is suspected and then cleared. But the automated fingerprint file, which was only in its early stages, finally revealed that the fingerprint found in the victim's home was Pierre Lorcy, a boxing champion who almost committed the perfect crime.

programme.title: At the scene of the crime
programme.desc: On June 3, 1994, a carer who was responsible for providing care to an old couple living in Bezons, Val-d'Oise, discovered a horror spectacle when she arrived at their home. Gaston Moysset, 89, lies in a pool of blood, with his skull broken. He died four days later at the hospital. His wife, witness to the tragedy, was never able to help the police with Alzheimer's disease. After a long investigation, the PJ still hasn't solved the murder. The victim's grandson is suspected and then cleared. But the automated fingerprint file, which was only in its early stages, finally revealed that the fingerprint found in the victim's home was Pierre Lorcy, a boxing champion who almost committed the perfect crime.

programme.desc-more: In a sunny afternoon in Los Angeles, a brutal execution shakes the city: three members of the East Side Catorces, a feared gang, are shot dead in a park. Inspector Brenda Leigh Johnson (Kyra Sedgwick) and her team from the Priority Investigations Unit are called to the scene of the drama in an emergency. Faced with this widely publicized murder, Brenda must navigate between public pressure and the complexities of a case that reveals broader issues than expected. As she begins her investigation, Brenda notes the disturbing presence of a man at the crime scene: Colonel Walter (Robert Gossett), a former military instructor who claims to know the identity of the shooter. Although his knowledge seems valuable, there is growing mistrust at Brenda's. She wondered about the colonel's real intentions, as tensions, secrets and gang rivalries resurfaced, complicating an already delicate investigation.

programme.desc-more: In a sunny afternoon in Los Angeles, a brutal execution shakes the city: three members of the East Side Catorces, a feared gang, are shot dead in a park. Inspector Brenda Leigh Johnson (Kyra Sedgwick) and her team from the Priority Investigations Unit are called to the scene of the drama in an emergency. Faced with this widely publicized murder, Brenda must navigate between public pressure and the complexities of a case that reveals broader issues than expected. As she begins her investigation, Brenda notes the disturbing presence of a man at the crime scene: Colonel Walter (Robert Gossett), a former military instructor who claims to know the identity of the shooter. Although his knowledge seems valuable, there is growing mistrust at Brenda's. She wondered about the colonel's real intentions, as tensions, secrets and gang rivalries resurfaced, complicating an already delicate investigation.

programme.title: Pyramids: The Mysteries Revealed
programme.sub-title: Kheops and the tomb of secrets
programme.desc: The Kheops pyramid has led to a colossal construction project that lasted for at least 25 years. How did the builders of the time manage to realize this feat?
programme.desc-more: Among the Seven Wonders of the World, the pyramid of Kheops, in Egypt, is the only one still visible in its original state. The building is 146.5 metres high, 230-wide and consists of more than 2 million blocks - some weighing up to 63 tons - and is now in full swing. Egyptologists and archaeologists have a new tool using aerial images and satellites to analyze soil anomalies and invisible parts. They hope to elucidate the puzzles that remain on this titanium site.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.desc: The Kheops pyramid, built around 2,650 B.C. on the Giza plateau, a few kilometres south of Cairo, peaks at 146 meters high. Its structure is the result of the assembly of more than 2 million limestone blocks! Archaeologists have not yet pierced all its secrets, but their latest findings suggest that Egyptians have used ramps, one on each side of the pyramid. Built by the vizier Hemiounou, it is the presumed tomb of Kheops, Pharaoh of the Fourth Dynasty and son of Snefrou.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.desc: The famous great Sphinx of Giza, which represents a lion with a human head, was built during the Fourth Dynasty, around - 2600. As high as a six-storey building, this gigantic statue – 73 metres long by 14 metres wide and 20 metres high – came out of a single block of limestone, except for the forelegs, probably shaped whole in masonry. Egyptians long thought that Pharaoh Khéphren would have ordered his construction. The great Sphinx could also be the work of Jedefre, the other son of Kheops and brother of Khéphren, who preceded him on the throne.

programme.title: The secrets of pyramid builders
programme.sub-title: The end of the giant pyramids
programme.desc: King of the Fourth Dynasty of the Old Empire and grandson of Kheops, Mykerinos built the third and smallest pyramid on the Giza plateau: it rises to 63 meters high, representing only one tenth of the volume of the largest, the Kheops pyramid, and dominates a complex composed of two temples. Many signs of incompletion show that the sovereign died before the construction was completed. His successor, Chepseskaf, will be building a gigantic mastaba-shaped grave in Saqqarah. The pyramid tradition ends.

programme.title: Pyramids: The Mysteries Revealed
programme.sub-title: Kheops and the tomb of secrets
programme.desc: Among the Seven Wonders of the World, the pyramid of Kheops, in Egypt, is the only one still visible in its original state. The building is 146.5 metres high, 230-wide and consists of more than 2 million blocks - some weighing up to 63 tons - and is now in full swing. Egyptologists and archaeologists have a new tool using aerial images and satellites to analyze soil anomalies and invisible parts. They hope to elucidate the puzzles that remain on this titanium site.

programme.title: Face to face
programme.desc: The guardian of a chemical factory, studying law master, reviews during his service. He hears unusual noises and sees a group of people coming in and trying to get into the factory. He recognizes one of them. Then, one hears a shot, suggesting that one of them killed the young man. The next day, we find his body. Upon arriving the police must pass through a chanting demonstration: "no future without nature". The investigation reveals that they were environmental activists, and assumes that they were not amateurs who had managed to enter a very secure place without breaking into.
programme.desc-more: In the cold world of courts and police stations, where truths often hide behind deceptive appearances, Justine Rameau embodies success: a judge of inquiry feared for her relentless rigor, devoted mother and wife fulfilled. Yet this carefully constructed life turns the day when a revelation explodes like a charge. A half-sister, Vanessa Tancelin, a police commander as determined as she was impulsive, landed in Strasbourg with a personal mission: to reconnect with this older sister whose existence she had never known. The shock is immediate. For Vanessa, raised in the shadow of a carefully buried family secret, this meeting is the result of a quest for identity started since childhood. But for Justine, the news is an earthquake that shakes his certainty, awakening questions about his past and the lies that have shaped him. Between distrust and fascination, the two women, whom everything seems to oppose – one anchored in the world of justice, the other in the urgency of field investigations – find themselves forced to cohabit and then to collaborate. As their fates intertwine, a series of criminal cases will put them in the face of a corneal dilemma: can they team up despite their abyssal differences, or will their antagonistic methods lead them to confrontation? Between explosive family revelations, professional tensions and high-risk investigations, each will have to choose between loyalty to blood and the principles that have always guided their lives. One thing is certain: in this face to face where the wounds of the past reappear, nothing will be as before.

programme.title: The secret life of the Pharaohs

programme.desc-more: On 26 November 1922, near Luxor, Egyptologist Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamon's grave, one of the last descendants of a family that had led Egypt for eight generations. Under the aegis of this eighteenth dynasty, the Egyptian kingdom became the richest and most powerful in the world. This series is interested in the life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti, and the enigmatic Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Edward in the hands of silver
programme.desc: Edward is the creature of an old inventor who died before he could implant his hands. As fingers, the young man has sharp blades, which have left many scars on his face very pale. He lives in a huge half-in-church castle where Peg Boggs, the beauty representative of the neighborhood, discovers it one day. The latter, taking pity, decided to welcome him to his family, raising the emotion of the neighbourhood. But Edward, who does wonders of his hand-scissors, becomes the pertussis of the neighborhood.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: In the thick mist of an isolated campaign, where the shadows of trees seem to hide more threats than secrets, detectives Freddy Watson and Cal infiltrate an abandoned farm, identified as a den for a network of drug traffickers. The operation, supposed to be quick and discreet, turns into a nightmare from the first exchanges of fire. A shooting bursts, brutal and chaotic. Watson, hit by a bullet, sank into the dust, his blood mixing with the cold earth. Despite the pain and urgency, he found the force to order Cal to prosecute the fugitive criminals, even leaving him behind. For this hardened cop, failure is not an option – but this time, the rules of the game have changed. Suspects, hunted like wounded animals, find refuge in a cottage lost in the heart of an impenetrable forest, a place where silence is only broken by the wind in the branches. It is a coincidence – or perhaps fate – that this cottage belongs to Robert Michaels (Bruce Willis), a veteran of the army with reflexes as sharp as his sense of survival. When Cal, with all the strength and ammunition, knocks on his door, Michaels does not hesitate for long. Man has seen enough wars to recognize a just fight. Together, they prepare a counterattack, but time is short. The situation is changing when the gang leader, a man as cunning as he is dangerous, appears at the cottage, holding Watson hostage. The stakes have never been so high: saving a brother from weapons, dismantling a criminal network, and surviving a night when every decision could be the last. Cal and Michaels, despite their differences, have no choice but to trust their instincts and their training. Between improvised traps, chase races in the woods and end-to-end clashes, they will have to draw from their last resources to reverse the situation. But in this forest where every noise can betray their position, a question persists: who among them is really ready to do anything to get out of it?

programme.title: Mont-Saint-Michel: the last riddles of the abbey
programme.desc: Mont-Saint-Michel fascinates both by its beauty and its mysteries. Behind the facades that everyone knows is another Mount, unknown to the general public.
programme.desc-more: A millenary monument, Mont-Saint-Michel fascinates both its beauty and its mysteries. Perched on its rocky island, it culminates at 150 meters high, and is the result of an extraordinary architectural challenge. High place of pilgrimage, abbey, fortress remained undefeated during the Hundred Years' War, then a state prison, the Mount is a gigantic stone millefeuille built over the centuries. But behind the facades that everyone knows is another Mont-Saint-Michel, unknown to the general public. Guided tour.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.sub-title: In the footsteps of World War I, trenches and battlefields
programme.desc: The document reveals unknown World War II stories that left traces still visible in the country. For example, the city of Saint-Germain-en-Laye, in the Yvelines, was transformed into a German headquarters during the occupation. About 20 shelters were built to protect this strategic site. Located in Pas-de-Calais, the fortress of Mimoyecques was built between 1943 and 1944. This German bunker was home to a V3 gun battery targeting London. Finally, the resistancemen built an incredible network of galleries in Dieppe, Normandy, in early 1940.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: In 1940, German troops had just invaded France. The Nazis then set up gigantic construction sites and appropriate prestigious sites.
programme.desc-more: It was with the Armistice of 22 June 1940 that the occupation of France by German troops began. The latter then implement gigantic construction sites, build sites to serve their ideology and appropriate prestigious places. The document proposes to go to discover these places where the Nazis worked in the greatest secrecy. The opportunity to discover what they were looking for in Montsegur, Ariège, or what happened in the imposing concrete complex of the discreet commune of Margival, in Aisne.

programme.title: Hostage Game
programme.desc: An ex-Navy finds himself in the heart of a hostage-taking with his daughter and stepfather. Despite his post-traumatic disorders, he must protect them.
programme.desc-more: In a world of ubiquitous tension, Hostage Game plunges spectators into the troubled universe of Kyle Snowden (Tyrese Gibson), a former navy whose traumas of the past haunt him. As he tries to rebuild his life after a difficult separation with his wife, he finds himself taking over the custody of his young daughter, Angel. Their daily lives take a dramatic turn when they find themselves held hostage in a grocery store, alongside Sam (John Malkovich), Kyle's stepfather and an influential member of Congress. Their abductor, driven by a desire for revenge, targets Sam for personal reasons, holding him responsible for the arrest of his father, currently incarcerated. In this crisis situation, Kyle must draw on his military skills and protective instincts to save his daughter and face his inner demons. As hours pass, tensions intensify, and every decision could have fatal consequences. Between the struggle for survival and that of his family, Kyle must navigate through a real game of cat and mouse, where the slightest false step could be tragic. The outcome of this confrontation will depend not only on his physical abilities, but also on his emotional resilience to a ruthless opponent.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: A retired CIA agent is forced to resume service when he is found in his ultra-secret residence by a group of criminals.
programme.desc-more: In the thick mist of an isolated campaign, where the shadows of trees seem to hide more threats than secrets, detectives Freddy Watson and Cal infiltrate an abandoned farm, identified as a den for a network of drug traffickers. The operation, supposed to be quick and discreet, turns into a nightmare from the first exchanges of fire. A shooting bursts, brutal and chaotic. Watson, hit by a bullet, sank into the dust, his blood mixing with the cold earth. Despite the pain and urgency, he found the force to order Cal to prosecute the fugitive criminals, even leaving him behind. For this hardened cop, failure is not an option – but this time, the rules of the game have changed. Suspects, hunted like wounded animals, find refuge in a cottage lost in the heart of an impenetrable forest, a place where silence is only broken by the wind in the branches. It is a coincidence – or perhaps fate – that this cottage belongs to Robert Michaels (Bruce Willis), a veteran of the army with reflexes as sharp as his sense of survival. When Cal, with all the strength and ammunition, knocks on his door, Michaels does not hesitate for long. Man has seen enough wars to recognize a just fight. Together, they prepare a counterattack, but time is short. The situation is changing when the gang leader, a man as cunning as he is dangerous, appears at the cottage, holding Watson hostage. The stakes have never been so high: saving a brother from weapons, dismantling a criminal network, and surviving a night when every decision could be the last. Cal and Michaels, despite their differences, have no choice but to trust their instincts and their training. Between improvised traps, chase races in the woods and end-to-end clashes, they will have to draw from their last resources to reverse the situation. But in this forest where every noise can betray their position, a question persists: who among them is really ready to do anything to get out of it?

programme.desc-more: The temple of Karnak was the largest building site in ancient Egypt. programme.title: Egypt: Pharaoh Treasures · Global Voices
programme.sub-title: Hidden tombs of the Valley of Kings
programme.desc: Diving behind the scenes in the Valley of Kings, with a zoom on the spectacular engineering of this underground yard, unique in the history of humanity.
programme.desc-more: After a thousand years of pyramids, the Pharaohs radically changed their funeral strategy to dig their graves in the rock. In the Valley of Kings, an invisible necropolis unfolds under the mountain, with kilometers of galleries carved in limestone. For five centuries, thanks to the meticulous work of the country's best artisans, more than 60 graves were dug there, including those of Tutankhamon, Ramses II and Thutmosis III, pharaohs who came to realize their dream of immortality. This film reveals the spectacular engineering of this underground construction site, unique in the history of humanity.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: The FBI is investigating the disappearance of a former deputy prosecutor. Allen Davis, his former boyfriend, is questioned by Jack and his team.
programme.desc-more: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.

programme.title: The 10 most mythical roads
programme.desc: Route des Grandes Alpes, Basque cornice, gorges du Verdon, Passage du Gois, Nationale 7, or route du Tour de Corse: heading for the discovery of ten mythical routes.
programme.desc-more: Cut to cliffside, suspended above the void or submerged by tides, some French roads challenge all obstacles. From the route of the Great Alps to the Basque cornice, from the gorges of the Verdon to the Passage du Gois, through the Nationale 7 and the route of the Tour de Corse, heading for the discovery of ten mythical routes. Behind these spectacular landscapes is the ingenuity of the builders, which has opened roads where it seemed impossible. Roads that have become over time real symbols of their territory, fascinating both in their history and in the technical challenges they have demanded.

programme.title: The 10 most stunning castles
programme.desc: Through ten emblematic sites, this documentary tells the ingenuity of the builders of castles, who have pushed the limits of defence ever further.
programme.desc-more: How did the castles become the most stunning fortresses of the Middle Ages? Through ten emblematic sites, from Haut-Kœnigsburg, fortress of the Vosges peaks, to Castelnaud, citadel of the Hundred Years War, passing through Fougères, one of the largest medieval fortresses in Europe, or Beaufort, lock of the Alps, this documentary tells the incredible ingenuity of the builders who have pushed ever further the limits of defence. Designed to monitor territories, protect people and resist the most formidable sieges, these castles have constantly evolved to cope with the progress of the art of war.

programme.title: The 10 most daring bridges
programme.desc: From Roman arches from the Pont du Gard to the vertiginous bays of the Viaduct de Millau, this documentary explores ten bridges that have brought French territories closer together.
programme.desc-more: From Roman arches from the bridge of the Gard to the vertiginous haubans of the Millau viaduct, from the rising bridge Jacques-Chaban-Delmas, the largest in Europe, to the 3,800 tons of steel of the Viaduct du Viaur, this documentary explores ten bridges that have brought the French territories closer together. These non-standard works bear witness to the same ambition throughout the centuries: to cross the impossible. By crossing rivers, gorges or valleys, they tell more than 2,000 years of innovation, technical challenges and human exploits.

programme.title: The 10 most ingenious Roman buildings
programme.desc: From Pont du Gard to Maison Carrée de Nîmes, through the Arles arenas or the Orange Theatre, ten masterpieces of Roman architecture in France are discovered.
programme.desc-more: The Romans not only conquered territories, they imposed a way of life, whose traces continue to shape French landscapes. programme.title: Jean-Philippe
programme.desc: After being knocked off by one of his neighbors, a man wakes up in a world where his idol, Johnny Hallyday, is just an illustrious stranger.
programme.desc-more: Fabrice (Fabrice Luchini), a disillusioned quadrennial, stifled in the dull decor of her pavilionary suburbs, between a wife whose routine has blunted dreams and a teenage girl in the midst of revolt. The only flash in his morose daily life is his unconditional adoration of Johnny Hallyday, a timeless icon whose tubes are rhythmic and soften his disillusionment. Posters, records and loop concerts are his last escape, his only reason to get up every morning. But when a watered evening turns into a nightmare after a neighbor overtakes the assemblé to silence him, Fabrice wakes up in a parallel world where his idol never existed. More than I love you, more than L'Envie, nothing. Just a sidereal void, a rewritten popular culture, and an obsessive question: how to live when what made you vibrate disappeared? Decided to restore the order of things, Fabrice embarked on a quest as crazy as it was impossible: to find Jean-Philippe Smet, the man who should have become Johnny, and make him the legend he deserved. But the reality is cruel: the real Smet is only a modest bowling manager, far from the spotlights and crowds of them. Worse, he seems to be content with this unglorious existence, indifferent to the destiny of glory that Fabrice destines him. Between scepticism and polite amusingness, Jean-Philippe resists the grandiose plans of his most determined " fan". Yet, despite the failures, the doors closing and the unbelieving gaze, Fabrice persists, convinced that Smet's raw talent only demands to explode.

programme.title: Like a leader
programme.desc: A keen amateur cook crosses the path of a starred chef without ideas. Both men decided to team up to face adversity.
programme.desc-more: In "As a Chef", a gastronomic comedy released in 2012, we follow the tumultuous journey of Jacky Bonnot (Michaël Youn), a young chef passionate about cooking who is eagerly dreaming of succeeding in the highly competitive world of gastronomy. Despite his undeniable talent, Jacky often faced failures in the small restaurants where he worked, eventually getting fired each time because of his impulsivity and his difficult character to manage. This series of misadventures prompted him to accept a job that was un gratifying in a canteen, far from his starry ambitions. Jacky's destiny took an unexpected turn when he crossed the road of Alexandre Lagarde (Jean Reno), an ultra-mediatic chef who was on the brink of the abyss. Lagarde, once starred and admired, lost his inspiration in cooking and faced a serious threat: the big financial group that owns its establishments is considering firing him if his restaurant loses even one Michelin star. In despair, Alexandre sees in Jacky a potential that could help her revive her passion for gastronomy. The two men, despite their differences in character and status, decided to join forces to counter this terrible threat. Jacky brings Lagarde a breath of freshness and innovation, and together they explore bold and creative recipes to give Lagarde's cuisine back its d Whilstantan shine.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: Anne breaks up with Jack while Danny starts an affair with Elena. It was then that the former husband of the latter, Carlos Aguilar, began to make talk about him. He is willing to do anything to get custody of their daughter, including taking the child away. In this season, it's Jack's turn to be investigated, after being abducted by a psychopath who does not hesitate to torture him. While the team is overwhelmed, especially because of a man who turns out to be a real serial kidnapper, Carlos is redoing his own and threatening the very life of his ex-wife. The writers give a real thickness to the character of Elena, whose daily life becomes a hell.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

But the one who opens the door to him is Philippe Duflos, his former father-in-law.

programme.title: We have some info.
programme.desc: We have news, it's every night Monday to Friday at 8:45. With Martin Cangelosi from Rennes, and the whole band of We have news, we wonder how the day went! A shift in the news... At the end of the street and at the end of the world. All in 19 minutes on NOVO19!

programme.title: Eyjafjallajökull
programme.desc: Valérie and Alain, a divorced couple who have not been able to get along for a long time, find themselves forced to join forces on a plane trip to Greece, where they must attend their daughter's wedding. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when the eruption of the Icelandic volcano Eyjafjallajökull causes a change of destination, forcing their flight to land thousands of kilometres from their original goal. Now stuck together, Valérie and Alain have to drive over 2,000 kilometres to reach the wedding venue. Their journey is expected to be tumultuous, marked by tensions and disputes, as they are confronted with their common past and their accumulated grudges. The road quickly becomes a real verbal battlefield, where insults and humiliations are coming along, revealing the still sharp wounds of their separation. Throughout this journey, the two former spouses will have to navigate through their confrontational emotions and discover whether, despite their differences, there is a glimmer of hope for reconciliation.

programme.title: Jean-Philippe
programme.desc: Fabrice (Fabrice Luchini), a disillusioned quadrennial, stifled in the dull decor of her pavilionary suburbs, between a wife whose routine has blunted dreams and a teenage girl in the midst of revolt. The only flash in his morose daily life is his unconditional adoration of Johnny Hallyday, a timeless icon whose tubes are rhythmic and soften his disillusionment. Posters, records and loop concerts are his last escape, his only reason to get up every morning. But when a watered evening turns into a nightmare after a neighbor overtakes the assemblé to silence him, Fabrice wakes up in a parallel world where his idol never existed. More than I love you, more than L'Envie, nothing. Just a sidereal void, a rewritten popular culture, and an obsessive question: how to live when what made you vibrate disappeared? Decided to restore the order of things, Fabrice embarked on a quest as crazy as it was impossible: to find Jean-Philippe Smet, the man who should have become Johnny, and make him the legend he deserved. But the reality is cruel: the real Smet is only a modest bowling manager, far from the spotlights and crowds of them. Worse, he seems to be content with this unglorious existence, indifferent to the destiny of glory that Fabrice destines him. Between scepticism and polite amusingness, Jean-Philippe resists the grandiose plans of his most determined " fan". Yet, despite the failures, the doors closing and the unbelieving gaze, Fabrice persists, convinced that Smet's raw talent only demands to explode.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: Anne breaks up with Jack while Danny starts an affair with Elena. It was then that the former husband of the latter, Carlos Aguilar, began to make talk about him. He is willing to do anything to get custody of their daughter, including taking the child away. In this season, it's Jack's turn to be investigated, after being abducted by a psychopath who does not hesitate to torture him. While the team is overwhelmed, especially because of a man who turns out to be a real serial kidnapper, Carlos is redoing his own and threatening the very life of his ex-wife. The writers give a real thickness to the character of Elena, whose daily life becomes a hell.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Nausicaá, the aquarium of all challenges
programme.desc: In Boulogne-sur-Mer, facing the English Channel, Nausicaá is the largest aquarium in Europe. Its 20-metre-long, five-metre-high bay window offers a stunning view of a reconstituted ocean. But behind this prowess of engineering, women and men are working tirelessly to support this fragile ecosystem and to care for more than 58,000 marine animals. Along with technical teams, caretakers and veterinarians, discover the behind the scenes of this giant of the seas, where every technological challenge is put at the service of a single ambition: to discover the oceans to better protect them.

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: How do hurricanes form and why? Every year, from June to November, the French Antilles are watching the Atlantic. These out-of-standard cyclones can shave entire neighborhoods in a few hours, and no one can stop them. The film follows those who track them: pilots who are...
programme.desc-more: Every year, the French Antilles fear the arrival of devastating cyclones. Faced with these phenomena, many specialists are mobilizing. Pilots crossing the eye of the cyclone to the drone-equipped oceanographers, all track these storms to Miami. Their aim is to anticipate precisely the place and strength of the impact, a crucial challenge because the climate is warming.

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: Currents, giant waves, cyclones, underwater volcanoes: thanks to 3D reconstructions and images generated by IA, this series reveals the colossal forces that animate the French seas. She goes to meet scientists and sailors who try to understand them and to understand them.
programme.desc-more: Although the Channel seems peaceful between France and England, it hides one of the most powerful marine mechanics on the globe. Its gigantic tides and spectacular currents shape the landscape. The sea is also the scene of extreme events, such as storms capable of breaking ships, or rare weather tsunamis that arise in good weather.

programme.title: Bonifacio Falaise: Inevitable Erosion?
programme.desc: Perched on its limestone cliffs more than 80 meters above the Mediterranean, Bonifacio has been fascinated since the 12th century. Behind this picture of postcard is a real threat. The cliffs, subjected to the constant assaults of the sea and weakened by rainwater infiltrations, are gradually eroding. In 2022, the danger rose by a step: several houses were targeted by prefectural orders because of the risk of collapse. On the spot, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of this phenomenon and to anticipate future collapses. Through their research, the city, originally conceived as a stunning fortress, reveals its extreme fragility. How far could erosion endanger Bonifacio's future?

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: The bad spell seems to be hounding at some places in France. In Tévennec, Brittany, for example, a lighthouse would have been the scene of sordid events, while in the Black Perigord, a troglodytic house would have been haunted by a machiavelic and bloody character who had lived there in the past. In the Cevennes, an area, "the triangle of the Burle", holds the French record of air disasters. And in Loudun, in the department of Vienna, the Devil would have taken possession of nuns under very mysterious circumstances.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: A secret and mysterious discipline, alchemy developed in the Middle Ages all over Europe. In hiding, his practitioners then multiply the experiments to find the philosopheral stone, which would be able to offer eternal life and turn lead into gold. In France, some places like Bourges, capital of alchemy, or the castle of Plessis-Bourré, in Maine-et-Loire, still retain the imprint of this story. In the Marais district of Paris, the bookseller Nicolas Flamel was considered the most famous of the alchemists.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: Discovery of unknown places, dug by man: secret passages, underground churches or hidden caves. In the forest of Fontainebleau (Seine-et-Marne), a extinct civilization left enigmatic engravings in a mysterious cave. These could date from 6,000 years before J.C. Then, in the direction of Dénezé-sous-Doué, in Maine-et-Loire, where a cave houses an amazing series of statues engraved in the rock. Protestants or 16th-century Catholics could be the authors.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.

programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. programme.title: 2012: Ice Age
programme.desc: In Iceland, a cataclysmic volcanic eruption triggers a series of events threatening humanity. A thick cloud of ashes extends across the globe, causing radical climate change and plunges North America and the rest of the world into a new ice age. The fall of temperatures is brutal, transforming familiar landscapes into an ice desert. In this apocalyptic context, the Hart family finds itself at the heart of chaos, struggling for their survival in the face of extreme conditions and invisible threats. Meanwhile, a team of scientists, determined to reverse the course of events, is mobilizing to find a solution to this unprecedented climate crisis. As time is running out and the extinction of humanity seems imminent, Harts and scientists must join forces to face the ice storm that threatens to swallow everything.

programme.title: Hostage Game
programme.desc: In a world of ubiquitous tension, Hostage Game plunges spectators into the troubled universe of Kyle Snowden (Tyrese Gibson), a former navy whose traumas of the past haunt him. As he tries to rebuild his life after a difficult separation with his wife, he finds himself taking over the custody of his young daughter, Angel. Their daily lives take a dramatic turn when they find themselves held hostage in a grocery store, alongside Sam (John Malkovich), Kyle's stepfather and an influential member of Congress. Their abductor, driven by a desire for revenge, targets Sam for personal reasons, holding him responsible for the arrest of his father, currently incarcerated. In this crisis situation, Kyle must draw on his military skills and protective instincts to save his daughter and face his inner demons. As hours pass, tensions intensify, and every decision could have fatal consequences. Between the struggle for survival and that of his family, Kyle must navigate through a real game of cat and mouse, where the slightest false step could be tragic. The outcome of this confrontation will depend not only on his physical abilities, but also on his emotional resilience to a ruthless opponent.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region

The investigation will last years before moving towards a man who is particularly manipulative. - "The killer lovers." programme.title: Jacqueline Sauvage: it was him or me
programme.desc: 10 September 2012. Three shots were fired at a house in the Creuse. Norbert Marot, a 72-year-old man, collapses, fatally hit in the back. Behind the weapon, his wife, Jacqueline Sauvage (Muriel Robin), 65, after 47 years of marriage. This brutal gesture ended decades of silence, but opened one of the most cleavage trials of the decade. For behind this murder is a much darker story: that of a woman who claims to have suffered domestic violence, rape and kidnapping for almost half a century, in general indifference. Before the judges, Jacqueline described a domestic hell – a tyrannical, alcoholic husband who had no reason to beat his daughters, humiliated them and treated them as slaves. Children, now adults, confirm his words: they grew up in terror, powerless witnesses of beatings and abuse. Yet when the verdict falls, it is the astounding: sentenced to 10 years in prison, Jacqueline is convicted, without the mitigating circumstances sufficient to exonerate her. How can a woman broken by years of torture be judged as an ordinary criminal? As she appeals, the case takes on a media and political turn. Thousands of French people, shocked, signed petitions, intellectuals committed, and a question divided the country: did self-defence exist for victims of domestic violence? Between the walls of the court and the traumatic memories that reappear, Jacqueline must relive her ordeal in public, under the eyes of the cameras and judges. His lawyer is trying to make the state of necessity recognised – She had no choice, it was either him or her. But the French justice system, often criticized for its severity towards women victims of violence, hesitates. Meanwhile, in the shadow of legal debates, the fate of a broken but not submissive woman is being played out, whose struggle could change the law. Between resignation and revolt, Jacqueline Sauvage embodies the face of all those who once said, "Enough."

programme.title: Overexpenditure
programme.desc: Brian (Nicolas Cage) and Angela (Gina Gershon) are the happy parents of little Cora, who they had thanks to an anonymous egg donation. Angela would like to have another child, unfortunately miscarriages follow each other. She's calling the same anonymous donor again. She chose Katie (Nicky Whelan) as a surrogate, a single mother with whom she had a friendship. Katie is very fond of this little family and especially Cora. Probably too much. Angela suspects she's hiding something from her.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In the summary, "A journey to hell." Susanna Zetterberg, a young Swedish student, came to Paris to discover French culture and language. On April 18, 2008, she spent a night in a discotheque with her friends. But the taxi that takes her home doesn't bring her back to the safe harbour. - "The stage rapist." Between August 2008 and March 2009, a series of rapes and sexual assaults on young boys created psychosis in Paris and Seine-Saint-Denis. The events take place in similar places: public parks and football fields. - "A murdering stepfather." On November 13, 2008, Jennifer Vimeux, 22, separated from her boyfriend Nicolas for a year, decided to go home to pick up personal belongings. But the one who opens the door to him is Philippe Duflos, his former father-in-law.

programme.title: Versailles: The birth of a masterpiece
programme.desc: 30,000 workers, nearly a century of work on a marshy land: behind its luxury and grandeur, the Palace of Versailles is above all an extraordinary construction site. A technical feat of which many secrets remain to be discovered. The greatest specialists in Versailles try to understand how the palace of Louis XIV has changed over the centuries. Why were the marbles of the Glaces gallery changed during the construction? What do the traces left by the builders reveal in the hidden parts of the castle? Thanks to exceptional access to spaces closed to the public, this documentary tells the story of a monument that has never stopped evolving.

programme.title: Chambord: the last treasures of a stone giant
programme.desc: With its bold architecture, its immense domain and the mysteries surrounding its construction, the Château de Chambord embodies the very essence of the French Renaissance. 440 rooms, 77 stairs, 282 fireplaces and thousands of sculptures: Chambord is the architectural masterpiece of King Francis I. Today, the achievements of 500 years ago continue to question historians and scientists who are trying to break the last secrets of the building of the castle. Because behind his geometric perfection, Chambord conceals strange anomalies. Thanks to exceptional access to unknown and closed spaces for the public, as well as 3D reconstructions of the monument, this documentary reveals the hidden face of the royal palace that fascinates the world.

programme.title: Mont-Saint-Michel: the last riddles of the abbey
programme.desc: A millenary monument, Mont-Saint-Michel fascinates both its beauty and its mysteries. Perched on its rocky island, it culminates at 150 meters high, and is the result of an extraordinary architectural challenge. High place of pilgrimage, abbey, fortress remained undefeated during the Hundred Years' War, then a state prison, the Mount is a gigantic stone millefeuille built over the centuries. But behind the facades that everyone knows is another Mont-Saint-Michel, unknown to the general public. Guided tour.

programme.title: Sisteron: citadel of all challenges
programme.desc: The fortress with a unique silhouette, the citadel of Sisteron is one with the rock. A guardian of a natural door with titanium proportions, it is built on both sides of a particularly steep rocky ridge. How did the builders manage to turn this constraint into an asset? What techniques have they used to build on the steep slopes of colossal platforms? On what remains of the past did they rely on to shape this wonder of military architecture? This documentary reveals the secrets of building the fortress.

programme.title: The Knights of Heaven
programme.desc: At the Farnborough International Aeronautics Exhibition in England, a Mirage 2000 mysteriously disappeared from radar screens. The French military control centre sent Captains Marchelli and Vallois in reconnaissance over the North Sea. They see the aircraft immediately in the combat position. Despite orders from his staff, Marchelli shot down the plane.

programme.title: 60 seconds time
programme.desc: Memphis Raines (Nicolas Cage) likes cars. He loved them so much that at the time he stole them to drive them. But that time is over and Memphis has settled. His younger brother Kip (Giovanni Ribisi) burns with the same passion, but does not have the caution of his elder. His life is in the hands of a dangerous evil man. The price of survival? Fifty exceptional cars to fly in one night.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: By investigating an engineering student, found dead in the city's water tower, Goren and Eames bring back sad memories.
programme.desc-more: Can we leave two sexual predators at liberty on the grounds that they must testify soon against a mafia godfather? Is it permissible to take cells from a woman in a coma, even in the interests of medicine? Should we excuse the transgender victim of rape if she kills her assailant? Several cases of conscience torment the team of the special unit. The hearings did not end for this fourth season, in which Sherilyn Fenn, Pam Grier, Rob Estes and Fred Savage participated, impressive in the role of a rapist who himself defended and stood up to prosecutor Cabot.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who didn't ask anyone to marry
programme.desc: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.
programme.desc-more: "Friends", cult series, follows the adventures of six young New York singles. Monica, who lives in Manhattan, finds Rachel, a childhood friend who fled her marriage. They move in together and Rachel joins the circle of friends: Phoebe, Monica's ex-coloc, Chandler and Joey, their neighbors, and Ross, Monica's brother, who has been in love with Rachel since high school. The band often finds themselves at Central Perk. For ten seasons, spectators follow their careers and love stories.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: In this poignant episode of the series, Josephine (Mimie Mathy) travels to Belgium to accomplish a new humanitarian mission. She met Véronique (Olivia Brunaux), a single mother who was overwhelmed by overwhelming debts and determined to support her two daughters. In a moment of despair, Véronique made a flight to the supermarket where she worked, a decision that cost her her job and plunged her into a spiral of precariousness. To survive, she plans to prostitute herself, a reality she would never have imagined. However, her destiny changes when she crosses the road to Wadeck (Patrick Catalifo), a committed journalist who is investigating the motivations of women turning to prostitution. Touched by Véronique's heartbreaking narrative, Wadeck finds himself confronted with disturbing truths about society and the status of women. Together, they will try to break the cycle of distress and stigma.
programme.desc-more: Josephine Delamarre (interpreted by Mimie Mathy) is much more than just a mortal; She is a guardian angel whose mission is to bring love, comfort and solutions to people in distress. With its invisible wings and heart overflowing with empathy, Josephine has magical powers that allow her to intervene in the lives of those who need her most. Whether it is to restore peace to a couple in crisis, save a company in disarray or support a young person in difficulty, Josephine always gives herself a lot of time in every situation she encounters. As the episodes progress, Josephine finds herself facing a variety of characters. She crossed the road of Shirley Bousquet, Bruno Debrandt and Jeremy Banster, each of whom, in their own way, embodied beings who were in the throes of personal dilemmas and trials. Each meeting is an opportunity for Josephine to deploy a cascade of strategies to bring a solution, while juggling the challenges of her own existence. She appeals to her wisdom, humour and creativity to give hope back to lost souls. Each episode illustrates how, even in the most desperate situations, a little magic and a lot of empathy can transform lives.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: Josephine comes to the aid of Geneviève Beaumont, a depressed woman who has been living on the street since she lost her job. Josephine discovers the daily lives of the homeless. She learns that Patricia, Geneviève's youngest daughter, committed suicide a few years earlier, after a disappointment in love. Lise, her eldest daughter, blames her mother for this tragedy, accusing her of not being present enough. Josephine is trying to reconcile them.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Michael Gardner, a golden boy, is accused of rape by three young women. As the trial approached, he decided to defend himself.
programme.desc-more: Can we leave two sexual predators at liberty on the grounds that they must testify soon against a mafia godfather? Is it permissible to take cells from a woman in a coma, even in the interests of medicine? Should we excuse the transgender victim of rape if she kills her assailant? Several cases of conscience torment the team of the special unit. The hearings did not end for this fourth season, in which Sherilyn Fenn, Pam Grier, Rob Estes and Fred Savage participated, impressive in the role of a rapist who himself defended and stood up to prosecutor Cabot.

programme.title: Little secrets between neighbours
programme.desc: Each episode tells an incredible story of neighbours: neighbourhood conflicts, forbidden love, secrets, jealousies... We frequent them every day. We exchange with them polishes in the building yard or over the hedge. We can imagine their intimacy by looking at them out the window. The lives of our neighbors seem perfectly normal... But appearances are deceptive and behind their walls, often hide incredible stories... And you, do you really know your neighbors?

programme.title: Little secrets between neighbours
programme.desc: Each episode tells an incredible story of neighbours: neighbourhood conflicts, forbidden love, secrets, jealousies... We frequent them every day. programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who didn't ask anyone to marry
programme.desc: Joey finds Ross's grandmother's ring by chance. He's standing in front of Rachel to pick her up, and the young woman thinks he's proposing.
programme.desc-more: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: A guardian angel steals from a mother who is the victim of cascade spells, abandoned by a husband whose debts she has to pay.
programme.desc-more: In this poignant episode of the series, Josephine (Mimie Mathy) travels to Belgium to accomplish a new humanitarian mission. She met Véronique (Olivia Brunaux), a single mother who was overwhelmed by overwhelming debts and determined to support her two daughters. In a moment of despair, Véronique made a flight to the supermarket where she worked, a decision that cost her her job and plunged her into a spiral of precariousness. To survive, she plans to prostitute herself, a reality she would never have imagined. However, her destiny changes when she crosses the road to Wadeck (Patrick Catalifo), a committed journalist who is investigating the motivations of women turning to prostitution. Touched by Véronique's heartbreaking narrative, Wadeck finds himself confronted with disturbing truths about society and the status of women. Together, they will try to break the cycle of distress and stigma.
programme.desc: In this poignant episode of the series, Josephine (Mimie Mathy) travels to Belgium to accomplish a new humanitarian mission. She met Véronique (Olivia Brunaux), a single mother who was overwhelmed by overwhelming debts and determined to support her two daughters. In a moment of despair, Véronique made a flight to the supermarket where she worked, a decision that cost her her job and plunged her into a spiral of precariousness. To survive, she plans to prostitute herself, a reality she would never have imagined. However, her destiny changes when she crosses the road to Wadeck (Patrick Catalifo), a committed journalist who is investigating the motivations of women turning to prostitution. Touched by Véronique's heartbreaking narrative, Wadeck finds himself confronted with disturbing truths about society and the status of women. Together, they will try to break the cycle of distress and stigma.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: The guardian angel Josephine comes to help a woman about fifty years old whose daughter committed suicide, and who now lives on the street.
programme.desc-more: Josephine comes to the aid of Geneviève Beaumont, a depressed woman who has been living on the street since she lost her job. Josephine discovers the daily lives of the homeless. She learns that Patricia, Geneviève's youngest daughter, committed suicide a few years earlier, after a disappointment in love. Lise, her eldest daughter, blames her mother for this tragedy, accusing her of not being present enough. Josephine is trying to reconcile them.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Can we leave two sexual predators at liberty on the grounds that they must testify soon against a mafia godfather? Is it permissible to take cells from a woman in a coma, even in the interests of medicine? Should we excuse the transgender victim of rape if she kills her assailant? Several cases of conscience torment the team of the special unit. The hearings did not end for this fourth season, in which Sherilyn Fenn, Pam Grier, Rob Estes and Fred Savage participated, impressive in the role of a rapist who himself defended and stood up to prosecutor Cabot.
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: Little secrets between neighbours
programme.desc: Each episode tells an incredible story of neighbours: neighbourhood conflicts, forbidden love, secrets, jealousies... We frequent them every day. We exchange with them polishes in the building yard or over the hedge. We can imagine their intimacy by looking at them out the window. The lives of our neighbors seem perfectly normal... But appearances are deceptive and behind their walls, often hide incredible stories... And you, do you really know your neighbors?

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who didn't ask anyone to marry
programme.desc: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.
programme.desc-more: "Friends", cult series, follows the adventures of six young New York singles. Monica, who lives in Manhattan, finds Rachel, a childhood friend who fled her marriage. They move in together and Rachel joins the circle of friends: Phoebe, Monica's ex-coloc, Chandler and Joey, their neighbors, and Ross, Monica's brother, who has been in love with Rachel since high school. The band often finds themselves at Central Perk. For ten seasons, spectators follow their careers and love stories.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: In this poignant episode of the series, Josephine (Mimie Mathy) travels to Belgium to accomplish a new humanitarian mission. She met Véronique (Olivia Brunaux), a single mother who was overwhelmed by overwhelming debts and determined to support her two daughters. In a moment of despair, Véronique made a flight to the supermarket where she worked, a decision that cost her her job and plunged her into a spiral of precariousness. To survive, she plans to prostitute herself, a reality she would never have imagined. However, her destiny changes when she crosses the road to Wadeck (Patrick Catalifo), a committed journalist who is investigating the motivations of women turning to prostitution. Touched by Véronique's heartbreaking narrative, Wadeck finds himself confronted with disturbing truths about society and the status of women. Together, they will try to break the cycle of distress and stigma.
programme.desc-more: Josephine Delamarre (interpreted by Mimie Mathy) is much more than just a mortal; She is a guardian angel whose mission is to bring love, comfort and solutions to people in distress. With its invisible wings and heart overflowing with empathy, Josephine has magical powers that allow her to intervene in the lives of those who need her most. Whether it is to restore peace to a couple in crisis, save a company in disarray or support a young person in difficulty, Josephine always gives herself a lot of time in every situation she encounters. As the episodes progress, Josephine finds herself facing a variety of characters. She crossed the road of Shirley Bousquet, Bruno Debrandt and Jeremy Banster, each of whom, in their own way, embodied beings who were in the throes of personal dilemmas and trials. Each meeting is an opportunity for Josephine to deploy a cascade of strategies to bring a solution, while juggling the challenges of her own existence. She appeals to her wisdom, humour and creativity to give hope back to lost souls. Each episode illustrates how, even in the most desperate situations, a little magic and a lot of empathy can transform lives.

programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: "The flamber" Goren and Eames investigate the murder of a respectable man, found dead in a river. His death is apparently related to a gambling debt.
programme.desc-more: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.
