programme.title: Summit Fever
programme.desc: Between the Giant Dent, the mythical Matterhorn and the dreadful northern face of the Eiger, three giants who haunt the dreams of the climbers, two friends are preparing to face their demons as well as the elements. Michael (Freddie Thorp), a former tragically-marked climbing enthusiast, turned his back on the mountain after his sister disappeared in an accident. But today, alongside his childhood friend JP (Michel Biel), he tries to overcome his fears to fulfill this long-refused dream. Their journey begins in Chamonix, where they join a group of young, daring mountaineers. If their energy is communicative, their carelessness and their taste for risk are quickly worrying Michael, whose instinct of prudence sages at every climbing meter. The first two ascents, the Dent de Géant and the Matterhorn, confirm his fears: unforeseen cracks, precipitated decisions, underestimated equipment... Tensions are rising in the group, between those who see the mountain as a playground and those who respect the danger. But it is on the ice slopes of the Eiger, nicknamed "the Wall", that the expedition is tilting. A storm of unprecedented violence is taking hold on them, turning their last challenge into a desperate struggle for survival. Cut off from the world by screaming gusts and blinding snow, rescues become an illusion. Now every decision, every movement, can seal their fate. Between the vertical walls of the adrenaline and the introspection of the nights in tent, where ghosts of the past reappear, Summit Fever explores the limits of friendship, trust and resilience. How far will they go to go to go down alive? And at what cost? Will the mountain, indifferent and sublime, give them a final lesson, or will it become their tomb?

programme.title: Team explores
programme.desc: Revealed to Valenciennes, then to FC Bruges, Jean-Pierre Papin and one of the most emblematic French attackers of the 80s-90s. Born in 1963 in Boulogne-sur-Mer, "JPP" really exploded under the colours of the Olympique de Marseille, where he became five times the best scorer in the French championship between 1988 and 1992. In 1991, he won the Ballon d'Or, becoming the first Frenchman to receive the trophy after Michel Platini. After Marseille, Jean-Pierre Papin joined the Milan AC, with whom he won a Champions League in 1994, before finishing his career at Bayern Munich. He also scored 54 teams in France, for which he scored 30 goals.

programme.desc: In this season's iconic series, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) are called upon to investigate a troubling case involving military veterans engaged to eliminate mafia leaders. In parallel, they meet with Quinn Liu, a sergeant of the military police, whose methodical approach and efficiency quickly impress the team. Recognizing his talent, Steve invited him to join the famous 5-0 group of investigators, thereby strengthening their ability to solve increasingly complex cases, ranging from kidnappings to murders to drug trafficking networks. This tenth season is marked by the return of iconic characters and captivating intrigues, not to mention a long-awaited crossover with "Magnum". Tensions are rising as the team faces ever more dangerous threats while navigating the personal and professional challenges ahead.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.

When a balloon's engine is fired, Athena and 118 must rescue victims inside and outside a crowded stadium.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Laura offers her friendship to a child who is being repulsed by Nellie Oleson. She also discovers that Amos Pike is not the dangerous fool that is claimed.
programme.desc-more: Driven by a challenge from Nellie Oleson (Alison Arngrim), Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) decided to venture into the isolated house of Mr. Pike (Richard Bull), a hermit whom the rumor presents as a madman. As Laura enters this mysterious place, she discovers an elderly man, haunted by the memory of his late wife, whose loss plunges him into deep melancholy. Mr. Pike, although considered strange by the Walnut Grove residents, reveals to Laura poignant stories about his lost love and the life they shared. As she spends time with him, Laura realizes that true madness may lie in the judgment of others. This encounter upsets his prejudices and allows him to understand the importance of empathy and compassion towards those living in the shadow of their pain. As this adventure unfolds, Laura learns essential life lessons about loss, love and loneliness.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Laura Ingalls is sure to have discovered a gold deposit. She then starts dreaming of offering a new life to her whole family...
programme.desc-more: In the rural atmosphere of the American Midwest, Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and her friend Jonah, fearless pioneer children, discover what they believe to be a golden line in an isolated valley. This revelation ignites Laura's imagination, which begins to dream of a life of opulence and comfort, far from the daily struggles that her family endures. The visions of a flamboyant house, luxurious clothes and a carefree life haunt her, while she aspires to make her loved ones discover the pleasures that wealth can bring. However, this golden dream is not without consequences. By stepping in this quest for fortune, Laura and Jonah must navigate through the dangers of greed and disproportionate ambitions. The relationship between friends will be tested, and they will have to learn that true wealth lies not only in gold, but also in the family ties and love that unite them.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: The Ingalls failed a few months ago in their attempt to marry Mr. Edwards to widow Snider, but they haven't said their last word yet.
programme.desc-more: In the effervescence of spring, Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and Grace Snider find themselves facing a dilemma: they have no rider for the long-awaited ball. The preparations are in full swing, but the lack of partners to dance is a source of enthusiasm. While the other girls are walking with their suitors, Grace feels particularly neglected by Mr. Edwards (Richard Bull), who seems to be noticing his efforts to attract his attention. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), Laura's mother, is watching the situation empathically and decides to intervene. She proposed to Grace a bold strategy to arouse Mr. Edwards' interest: flirting with another young man. This approach could awaken Mr. Edwards' jealousy and push him to realize his feelings for Grace. In an atmosphere of camaraderie and discovery, the two girls embark on this adventure full of promises and twists, revealing the complexities of the emerging love relationships.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: The unfortunate widow Julie Anderson has an incurable illness. Before she dies, she must find a home for her three children...
programme.desc-more: After receiving a devastating diagnosis from Dr. Baker, who told him that he had only a few weeks left to live, Sanderson found himself confronted with the anguish of his young children's future. In her desperate quest to ensure their well-being, she turns to Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), a trusted friend, to help her find a loving couple ready to adopt her children. As Julie strives to manage her emotions and prepare her children for separation, Charles and his wife Caroline (Karen Grassle) are deeply involved in this delicate mission. They meet several potential couples, each with their own stories and motivations. Through encounters, bonds are forged and moral dilemmas arise, testing the strength of family relations and the importance of unconditional love. This tragic situation raises poignant questions about parenting, sacrifice and hope in the darkest moments.

The 118 works once again during the most frightening night of the year. Buck's Halloween decorations are more scary than he hoped.
programme.desc-more: Members of the Los Angeles Emergency Response Unit 118 are confronted with chaotic situations and scenarios worthy of action films. This season begins with an unusual incident: a traffic accident results in the release of millions of bees, immerse the city in a real frenzy. Firefighters, first aid workers and other stakeholders must demonstrate cold blood and expertise to deal with this environmental disaster while ensuring the safety of citizens. At the heart of this dynamic, the team must also learn to navigate the organizational transition following the retirement of Captain Bobby Nash. This change brought the new captain, Gerrard, to the fore, whose tyrannical leadership style tested the cohesion and team spirit of the unit 118. Tensions are rising as each member adapts to this new hierarchy while continuing to carry out their crucial work. In parallel to these professional challenges, Bobby finds himself juggling his real responsibilities with his role as technical advisor on the stage of the drama series "Hotshots". This series, which offers a fictional look at the challenges of everyday life in a fire station, will highlight the realities of emergency response.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Fifth century, island of Brittany. The kingdom of Kaamelott is organized around its ruler, King Arthur. Surrounded by his faithful knights of the Round Table, he strives for the mission entrusted to him by the gods: to seek the Holy Grail!
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.desc-more: Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), an exemplary student of the small prairie house, is going through a difficult period, marked by an unexpected fall on the stairs. His father, Charles Ingalls (Scottie McCreery), concerned about his recent school failures, decided to consult a doctor. During this visit, the doctor discovers that Mary's problems with concentration and academic performance are related to visual impairment. To help her overcome this challenge, he prescribed a pair of glasses, an accessory that, although common to some, represented Mary as a symbol of change and challenge. In parallel, her mother, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), and her sister, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), are fighting to support her in this transition, exploring the themes of family, support and resilience. This new obstacle leads Mary to rediscover her inner strength and fight for her academic future, while learning to accept her new equipment.

programme.desc-more: In the small town of Walnut Grove, the atmosphere is in full swing with the inauguration of the first local bank, an event that arouses many expectations among the inhabitants. Mr Sprague, the new director of the bank, is greeted with enthusiasm, but also with some distrust. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), always concerned about the well-being of his community, strives to create friendly ties with Mr. Sprague, multiplying the gestures of kindness towards him. Meanwhile, her daughter Laura (Melissa Gilbert) discovers a new unexpected friend during a fishing game, developing an complicity with Mr. Sprague who might well change their perception of life in the city. However, as the bank became the centre of Walnut Grove's social life, tensions and conflicts of interest began to emerge, testing the relations between the inhabitants and the values of solidarity that united them.

programme.desc-more: After a devastating loss the previous year, Walnut Grove's baseball team was determined to get the lead straight. Nels Oleson, the team's launcher, no longer meeting expectations, raises concern among players and supporters. As the team desperately seeks a replacement capable of restoring hope, the arrival of Mr.Mumfort, a new passionate and experienced coach, turns out to be a boon. With his rigorous method and team spirit, he re-edynamizes the players, instilling strategies and a sense of collective. Young talents, such as Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), are beginning to shine under her tutelage. However, the team must also overcome the internal rivalries and tensions that threaten their cohesion. Between intense training and decisive games, Walnut Grove's team must learn to fight together to hope for victory and prove that they can overcome the obstacles of the past.

programme.desc-more: Driven by a challenge from Nellie Oleson (Alison Arngrim), Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) decided to venture into the isolated house of Mr. Pike (Richard Bull), a hermit whom the rumor presents as a madman. As Laura enters this mysterious place, she discovers an elderly man, haunted by the memory of his late wife, whose loss plunges him into deep melancholy. Mr. Pike, although considered strange by the Walnut Grove residents, reveals to Laura poignant stories about his lost love and the life they shared. As she spends time with him, Laura realizes that true madness may lie in the judgment of others. This encounter upsets his prejudices and allows him to understand the importance of empathy and compassion towards those living in the shadow of their pain. As this adventure unfolds, Laura learns essential life lessons about loss, love and loneliness.

programme.title: The Tournesol case
programme.desc: Professor Tournesol, a leading scientist, has just developed a revolutionary invention: an ultrasonic weapon capable of destroying glass objects. Although initially conceived as a research project, this weapon has alarming destructive potential if it is perfected to target other materials. Only Professor Bretzel, his former colleague, has the knowledge to activate this machine. Tintin, accompanied by his faithful dog Milou, Captain Haddock and Professor Tournesol, set out to find Bretzel and warn him of the dangers of invention. However, they quickly discover that Bretzel was abducted by syldave agents. Shortly thereafter, Professor Tournesol's turn was to be kidnapped. Tintin and his friends then raced against the clock to find the missing scientists, thwart the malicious plans of the kidnappers and prevent this technology from falling into bad hands, while facing the obstacles that stand in their way.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: After receiving a devastating diagnosis from Dr. Baker, who told him that he had only a few weeks left to live, Sanderson found himself confronted with the anguish of his young children's future. In her desperate quest to ensure their well-being, she turns to Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), a trusted friend, to help her find a loving couple ready to adopt her children. As Julie strives to manage her emotions and prepare her children for separation, Charles and his wife Caroline (Karen Grassle) are deeply involved in this delicate mission. They meet several potential couples, each with their own stories and motivations. Through encounters, bonds are forged and moral dilemmas arise, testing the strength of family relations and the importance of unconditional love. This tragic situation raises poignant questions about parenting, sacrifice and hope in the darkest moments.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the small town of Walnut Grove, Julie Sanderson's tragic death left a void in the community and especially in the heart of Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon). Shortly after the funeral, Charles was approached by potential adoptive parents, who wished to welcome John, Carl and Alicia, three orphaned young people who lived temporarily with Grace (Charlotte Stewart) and Mr. Edwards (Karl Swenson). In the face of this delicate situation, Charles must navigate between his own emotions of loss and the responsibility to find a loving home for these children in search of stability. Tensions are rising as the candidates for adoption are examined, each with its own motivations. Meanwhile, children, lost and disembodied, have to face their new reality, learning to open up to the idea of a new family. This touching narrative addresses themes of mourning, hope and the power of family ties, even in the darkest moments.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Miss Beadle's students, who are passionate about nature, are responsible for a school project on different types of foliage. Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson) and her sister Laura (Melissa Gilbert), eager to learn, rejoice at the idea of going camping with family to explore the surrounding flora. With the help of their parents, Charles (Michael Landon) and Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), they prepare their excursion, eager to discover the beauty of the Midwest landscapes. The Oleson, the family often disagreed with the Ingalls, decided to join this adventure, bringing a particular dynamic to this journey. As they explore, tensions between the two families are revealed, but also unexpected moments of comradeship. This excursion is transformed into a real life lesson, where children learn not only about nature, but also about the importance of friendship and solidarity in the face of the challenges of everyday life.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the small village of Walnut Grove, the atmosphere is at the feast as the inhabitants prepare to celebrate the inauguration of the new church, symbol of unity and renewal. However, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), injured in the leg, decided not to join the festivities and preferred to stay alone at home. Over the hours, the pain she feels becomes more intense, plunged into a state of vulnerability. While her children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), as well as their father Charles (Michael Landon), are involved in the preparations for the celebration, Caroline struggles against her dark thoughts and isolation. His memories and reflections on family life, love and faith are beginning to emerge, illustrating the emotional challenges of physical suffering. This moment of personal crisis becomes a revealing ordeal, both for her and for those around her.

Members of the Los Angeles Emergency Response Unit 118 are confronted with chaotic situations and scenarios worthy of action films. This season begins with an unusual incident: a traffic accident results in the release of millions of bees, immerse the city in a real frenzy. Firefighters, first aid workers and other stakeholders must demonstrate cold blood and expertise to deal with this environmental disaster while ensuring the safety of citizens. At the heart of this dynamic, the team must also learn to navigate the organizational transition following the retirement of Captain Bobby Nash. This change brought the new captain, Gerrard, to the fore, whose tyrannical leadership style tested the cohesion and team spirit of the unit 118. Tensions are rising as each member adapts to this new hierarchy while continuing to carry out their crucial work. In parallel to these professional challenges, Bobby finds himself juggling his real responsibilities with his role as technical advisor on the stage of the drama series "Hotshots". This series, which offers a fictional look at the challenges of everyday life in a fire station, will highlight the realities of emergency response.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: After the Armstrong case broke, John Nolan was blamed and his training period extended for a month. This sanction is accompanied by a visit to a disciplinary commission and may well ruin his chances of becoming an inspector or joining a specialized unit. Promote investigator, Lopez prefers to keep her pregnancy quiet, fearing that she will be treated differently if she knows. Shortened by the pandemic, this third season is the shortest of the series with only 14 episodes.
programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: 9-1-1 - Season 8

programme.title: 9-1-1 - Season 8

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0 - Season 7
programme.desc: Five-0 investigates the death of one of the last survivors of the USS Arizona tragedy during World War II. This veteran was killed in a car accident during a burglar escape offence. McGarrett discovers that the victim knew his grandfather well...

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0 - Season 7
programme.desc: Two investigations were carried out in front of the 5-0 after the discovery of two bodies in the marina: that of a tourist, who was hunting wild animals, and that of a thirty-year-old with the same tattoo as his grandfather, an Auschwitz survivor. Kamekona's employees strike...

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0 - Season 7
programme.desc: The body of a dead man is found in a garbage dump in the early morning. The day before, the victim had spent a watered evening in a discotheque where he had flirted with a splendid young woman. At the same time, Steve and Danny discover that their respective girlfriends prepared them a surprise for Valentine's Day...

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: When asked about a case of veterans recruited to shoot mafia chiefs, Steve and Danny meet Quinn Liu, a sergeant of the military police who is conducting a parallel investigation. His formidable efficiency encourages Steve to propose to join the 5-0 team for their next missions. With this new recruit, the team continues to solve increasingly dangerous cases of kidnapping, murder, cartels to be dismantled, theft and accidents. This tenth season, which marks the end of the series, sees many notable figures returning, not to mention a crossover with "Magnum", remake of the eponymous series of the 1980s.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: Steve and Danny leave the hospital and go back to work: a murder investigation is waiting for them. Small peculiarity: the victim's body was discovered in the 5-0's premises. Later, the officers worked with a MI-6 member to track down a terrorist who had already been in action against the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case solved, McGarrett and Alicia became prey to a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. The rest of the team is trying to get them out of this bad step. A 7th season marked by multiple twists and the participation of Lou Diamond Phillips ("La Bamba") as guest of episode 14.

programme.title: A dream life
programme.desc: Istanbul. Sanem Aydın dreams of becoming a novelist, but is forced to work in the family grocery store. To escape an arranged marriage, she accepted a position in an advertising agency, where she met the boss Can Divit, a barouder photographer who had recently returned to the city. Alchemy is immediate, but the obstacles are numerous.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Walnut Grove's life continues to evolve. The installation of a banker upsets relations between villagers and fueled many tensions. Without Laura's help, the newcomer is unlikely to be accepted. Walnut Grove's participation in a baseball tournament and Mary's participation in a mathematics contest are also a source of passion. Isaiah Edwards, for his part, is considering getting married. Adapted from Laura Ingalls Wilder's novel, a sentimental evocation of the life of the nineteenth-century American pioneers.

programme.title: Lauren's strange Christmas
programme.desc: In his home, Lauren Brunell was looking for a surgeon position in a prestigious Boston hospital, the capital of Massachusetts. But his candidacy was rejected. The doctor then has no choice but to go to a remote town in Alaska, where residents have only rarely seen a doctor for a year now. Lauren soon falls under the charm of Andy Holliday, one of the inhabitants of this warm little town. With her reindeer, her elves in the garden and her transport company, Frank, father d'Andy, is surprisingly like Santa Claus...

In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: A family for rent
programme.desc: In a bitter sweet comedy, the universe of "A family for rent" presents Paul-André (Benoît Poelvoorde), a man of forty years old, both rich and hopelessly alone. Although wealthy, he has a deep boredom and lack of human connection in his life. It is then that he comes to realize that what he really misses is a family, a real one, that would bring meaning to his monotonous existence. On the other hand, Violette (Virginie Efira), a four-year-old mother, finds herself in an inextricable situation: threatened with expulsion and desperate, she fears losing custody of her two children, which exacerbates her vulnerability. In this context, Paul-André and Violette will cross their paths unexpectedly. In search of a solution to find a semblance of normality, they engage in a singular pact: Paul-André will "lease" a family to discover the affection and responsibilities to which he aspires, while Violette finds in him a precious support to overcome his trials. However, their arrangement, although initially pragmatic, slowly transforms into an emotional journey where laughter and tears, friendship and disillusionment mix. As their lives interlace, each of them will face his own demons while rediscovering what truly means to love and to be loved.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: Diffazur is a company capable of shaping custom creations for its customers throughout France thanks to a projected concrete system. The company's team is heading for southern France, more precisely in Provence, for the realization of a project that is literally out of the ordinary. The new owner of a sumptuous and spectacular house built on a hill wants a swimming pool just as unusual. The head of the agency and his two employees will face unimaginable challenges, between the risk of collapse of the terrace and the need to bring construction equipment by air.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: Diffazur is one of the largest French builder of free-form swimming pools. The company is able to shape custom creations for its customers throughout France thanks to a particular system of concrete projected. In this episode, the Diffazur team in Montpellier will take care of the project of a young couple: Claire and Leo. They decided three years ago to renovate an old swimming pool on their property, but it went very badly. So they called a team of renowned professionals to find a solution to finally get the pool of their dream.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Full eyes
programme.desc: Carole Rousseau and Jacques Legros are back for a second issue of "Full Eyes". Always as moving, spectacular or unusual, each story is analyzed and accurately decrypted by experts, in order to understand what really happened behind often impressive images. In summary, about twenty new stories, all of which have in common to end positively, despite extreme situations and striking images.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: A shield, a modem and an anti-ulcer
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper's 9-year-old parents decide to enrol him in high school: a good idea for such an early child, a bad idea for such an inadequate child.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: A spectacular house set on a hill just found buyer and its owner dreams of a pool in total harmony with this extraordinary house.
programme.desc-more: Diffazur is a company capable of shaping custom-made creations for its customers throughout France thanks to a planned concrete system. The team takes the direction of the Var in Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, for the realization of a waterfall swimming pool in an exceptional natural environment. A site so remarkable that there is almost no access to the ground, which will seriously complicate things, and force the team to innovate so that this ultra-technical challenge can be met. He must carry out waterfalls, walls of enhancement, overflows and bobbins.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon does everything to overcome her sick fear of birds. Leonard and Penny, on their side, are trying to date like mere friends...
programme.desc-more: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Frédéric and Audrey bought a traditional motorhome. With their children Leo and Liliou, holidays are an opportunity to satisfy their passion for nomadism. This time, they decided to go to Germany for a getaway. Near Montélimar, Eric and Sylvie's vehicle does not go unnoticed, a Wanderlodge of the 80s. The couple of quinquennials offered themselves their brand new mobile home on a trip to the United States. Camille and Oliver travel aboard a T3 combi, vintage and unusual, but a little small, close to nature and ocean beaches. At the age of 20 and 23, Alix and Jeanne decided to give a second youth to their old motorhome, going to discover the world for a six-month journey through eight countries to the Balkans.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: For many French people who are thirsty for freedom and adventure, the nomadic journey is a dream solution. They therefore look at the latest trends in the sector. With a price of around €60,000 for a new vehicle, the happy owners of these equipped vans and other motorhomes give to heart joy in order to take full advantage of their investment. Sales exceeded 100,000 such vehicles in 2023 and 1.5 million French people threw themselves into the water. For smaller exchanges, the rental is also growing.

programme.title: That's France!
programme.desc: Through different topics and several headings, "C'est c'est c'est c'est c'il la France!" promotes living together and highlights the diversity of France. Surrounded by his columnists, Julie Mamou-Mani, alias "Mamuz", Anthony Babkine and Nadège Mongerard, alias "Nadège 100 Gêne", Yasmine Oughlis promotes living together and orchestra, with the good mood that characterizes it, this program that focuses on highlighting the social, economic and cultural issues of French society. To follow, moments of escape, lively debates and constructive information, while keeping a positive perspective.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Aix-en-Provence, in the Bouches-du-Rhône, a department with two million inhabitants, and where it is good to live. Yet behind these postcard landscapes is a daily life that is not always of all rest. For several weeks, a team followed the women and men of the Aix-en-Provence company. Assault, alcohol, prostitution: to combat these abuses the 1,100 gendarmes of the group are demining daily and have to manage more than 8,000 interventions each year. Between madness, disturbing disappearance or conflict over alcohol.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Normandy is appreciated for its beautiful landscapes, monuments and long beaches. But in recent years the calm and serenity of this region have been increasingly disturbed by incivilities and crime. In fact, in the area the gendarmes have a lot to do. Drug users are growing in number and younger, causing problems in the streets and on the roads. Close-up of the daily lives of law enforcement personnel who are trying to guarantee the safety of all.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Near La Rochelle, Royan, a popular seaside resort in Charente-Maritime, is stormed every summer. For the city's 55 police officers, the season is not a rest: fighting, accidents and burglaries. Men and women like Cathy, guardian of peace. These policemen also very much present on the road, where 41 people still died in the department in 2025.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: A shield, a modem and an anti-ulcer
programme.desc: A NASA high school representative visiting high school doesn't take Sheldon seriously. But the latter is determined to show his science.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: Diffazur has an appointment in the Var to build a complex swimming pool: waterfall, wall of uplift, overflow, bordeaux. Will the pool see the day in time?
programme.desc-more: Diffazur is a company capable of shaping custom-made creations for its customers throughout France thanks to a planned concrete system. The team takes the direction of the Var in Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, for the realization of a waterfall swimming pool in an exceptional natural environment. A site so remarkable that there is almost no access to the ground, which will seriously complicate things, and force the team to innovate so that this ultra-technical challenge can be met. He must carry out waterfalls, walls of enhancement, overflows and bobbins.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard and Penny like to relive their romance from the beginning. Meanwhile, Sheldon is trying unsuccessfully to buy a souvenir from Star Trek.
programme.desc-more: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Traditional motorhomes, Wanderlodge of the 80s, T3 combi or old renovated motorhomes, several families travel the world on board their mobile homes.
programme.desc-more: Frédéric and Audrey bought a traditional motorhome. With their children Leo and Liliou, holidays are an opportunity to satisfy their passion for nomadism. This time, they decided to go to Germany for a getaway. Near Montélimar, Eric and Sylvie's vehicle does not go unnoticed, a Wanderlodge of the 80s. The couple of quinquennials offered themselves their brand new mobile home on a trip to the United States. Camille and Oliver travel aboard a T3 combi, vintage and unusual, but a little small, close to nature and ocean beaches. At the age of 20 and 23, Alix and Jeanne decided to give a second youth to their old motorhome, going to discover the world for a six-month journey through eight countries to the Balkans.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Gaëlle and Franck leave in a van, Fanny and Laëtitia travel in a renovated motorhome, and Eric and Zabou take the road south on their old truck.
programme.desc-more: For many French people who are thirsty for freedom and adventure, the nomadic journey is a dream solution. They therefore look at the latest trends in the sector. With a price of around €60,000 for a new vehicle, the happy owners of these equipped vans and other motorhomes give to heart joy in order to take full advantage of their investment. Sales exceeded 100,000 such vehicles in 2023 and 1.5 million French people threw themselves into the water. For smaller exchanges, the rental is also growing.

programme.title: That's France!
programme.desc: Through different topics and several headings, "C'est c'est c'est c'est c'il la France!" promotes living together and highlights the diversity of France. Surrounded by his columnists, Julie Mamou-Mani, alias "Mamuz", Anthony Babkine and Nadège Mongerard, alias "Nadège 100 Gêne", Yasmine Oughlis promotes living together and orchestra, with the good mood that characterizes it, this program that focuses on highlighting the social, economic and cultural issues of French society. To follow, moments of escape, lively debates and constructive information, while keeping a positive perspective.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: For several weeks, a team followed the women and men of the gendarmerie company in Aix-en-Provence during their daily missions.
programme.desc-more: Aix-en-Provence, in the Bouches-du-Rhône, a department with two million inhabitants, and where it is good to live. Yet behind these postcard landscapes is a daily life that is not always of all rest. For several weeks, a team followed the women and men of the Aix-en-Provence company. programme.title: Attentate of Charlie Hebdo, 10 years old: terror in Paris
programme.desc: In 2015, from Charlie Hebdo's killing to Bataclan's, France was hit by a wave of attacks. Testimonies of victims and political figures.
programme.desc-more: In 2015, from the killing of Charlie Hebdo to the massacres of the coffee terraces and the Bataclan, France was hit by a wave of attacks. These attacks, perpetrated by the jihadists of Al-Quaida and Daesh, plunge the nation into blood, fear and grief. The authorities knew the imminent threat, but the police and intelligence services could not defeat it. President François Hollande confides in how he experienced the trial of power in the face of this violence. Bernard Cazenuve, Anne Hidalgo, the prosecutor François Molins, as well as General Denis Favier and Jean-Michel Fauvergue, the boss of RAID, mix their voices with the testimonies of the victims of Islamist fanaticism.

programme.title: Attacks of 13 November 2015: the heroes of chaos
programme.desc: Through the accounts of firefighters, police officers or doctors who intervened on the evening of November 13, a look back on the discreet heroism of these anonymous people and the imprint left on their lives.
programme.desc-more: Ten years after the November 13 attacks, the first responders testify. Police, firefighters and doctors tell of the vital urgency and chaos of this night of horror. They entered the carnage scene, until Bataclan, rescued the victims and secured the scene, often without preparation. Their stories reveal the heroism of these anonymous people and the indelible imprint left on their lives.

programme.title: September 11, 2001: the day when everything changed
programme.desc: Using testimonies from those on the scene this day of 2001, a detailed review of the attacks of 11 September. In what is considered the largest terrorist attack in the history of the United States, four regular aircraft were hijacked to crash on symbolic buildings in the country, including the World Trade Center in New York. A precise reconstruction of events and relevant interventions will help to better understand the mechanisms that came into play on this day that marks the history of the United States.

programme.title: September 11th, seen from the World Trade Center, witnesses of chaos
programme.desc: On September 11, 2001, American Airlines 11 struck the North Tower of the World Trade Center, just a few moments later, United Airlines 175 struck the South Tower. The glass washers, bank employees, security guards and rescue workers, who were inside, tell us what they saw, heard, and how they came out. Six hundred and thirty-seven people remained trapped. That morning, 17,400 people were present in both towers, nearly nine out of ten managed to get out of them. The attacks killed 2,977 people, including 343 firefighters in New York City.

programme.title: The wrath of the Titans
programme.desc: Ten years after triumphing over the fearsome Kraken and saving the city of Argos, Perseus (Sam Worthington) turned his back on his divine heritage. Living as a humble fisherman, he tries to escape the shadow of his past, while raising his son alone. But the gods did not forget its existence. While the balance of power on the Olympic wave, Hades (Ralph Fiennes), thirsty for domination, orchestrate a bold blow: he captures Zeus (Liam Neeson), the king of the gods, and locks him in the depths of the Hells. Deprived of its protection, the world of mortals finds itself at the mercy of chaos, and the signs of divine anger are multiplying. The oceans are unleashing, the earth is shaking, and the legendary creatures, freed from their chains, are sowing terror. For Perseus, the retirement time is over. Forced to take up arms, he must face not only Hades forces, but also his own demons.

programme.title: The Titans' Shock
programme.desc: Perseus (Sam Worthington), a young man raised by a couple of fishermen, has long lived away from the conflicts between gods and mortals. His peaceful life was brutally interrupted when Hades (Ralph Fiennes), the god of Hell, attacked his home, killing his adoptive parents in front of him. This tragedy leaves Perseus deeply marked, driven by a desire for revenge against those who devastated his life.Captured and brought to Argos, Perseus discovers a disturbing secret: he is in reality the son of Zeus (Liam Neeson), which propels him into the heart of an unlikely heroic destiny. While Hades, eager for power, demanded the sacrifice of the beautiful Andromeda (Alexa Davalos) to appease the gods, Perseus was entrusted with a quest of an epic scale. To save the princess and subdue the dark forces that threaten her kingdom, he must bring together a team of fearless warriors. During this perilous adventure, he confronts formidable mythological creatures and gradually discovers his own divine powers. As he sails between courage and fear, Perseus must learn to embrace his divine heritage and overcome those that might prevent him from fulfilling his destiny. In this confrontation between light and darkness, every decision he makes will have decisive consequences for the future of mortals and gods.

programme.title: Fringe

In every world, the constraints and differences are becoming increasingly apparent, as well as the plans of the Minister of Defence, Walter Bishop's alter ego. A strange war machine is also at the heart of the story. Fringe's third season is clearly focused on a tone close to science fiction. Blue or red credits indicate the world of action.

programme.desc: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Trauma Center
programme.desc: A dark and stormy night on Puerto Rico Island, Madison Taylor (Nicky Whelan) finds herself at the heart of a tragedy when, witness to a brutal murder of a police officer, she is injured in the leg in panic. After giving her testimony to Steve Wakes (Bruce Willis), the deceased officer's partner, she is placed under protective custody in an isolated floor of the hospital, where she hopes to find refuge. However, things are turning dramatic when murderers, determined to eliminate the troublesome witness, enter the medical facility. Madison was then trapped, surrounded by deadly dangers, while Wakes, aware of the threat he was facing, was desperately trying to discover the identity of the criminals and arrest them before it was too late. A race against the clock is underway, transforming a simple hospital night into a real nightmare.

programme.title: The 10 most dangerous sects on the planet
programme.desc: Psychological capture, group suicides, sexual abuse, extortion, violence or murder: sects regularly make headlines for very dark reasons. Some of them have gables on the street, while others are much more discreet for obvious reasons. The Interministerial Mission for Vigilance and Fight against Sectarian Deviations (Miviludes) currently has 500 sectarian groups in France and nearly 500,000 followers. Here, a zoom is made on the ten most dangerous sects across the globe.

programme.title: The world's 10 most dangerous prisons
programme.desc: Extreme living conditions characterize the most formidable prisons. Isolated in remote areas, these fortresses like Florence or Guantanamo expose their occupants to dangerous situations. Scuba diving behind the scenes of these institutions or between abuse, systemic violence and ruthless environment, survival becomes a daily challenge.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: Alex no longer hides his attraction for Leonard and tries to seduce him. Sheldon, who does not understand that her assistant thinks of anything other than her work, decides to clarify the situation. But the conversation is going wrong, and Alex complains to human resources...

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: Boys go to the Comics Convention in Bakersfield. They stop on their way to take a picture of the filming site of the famous "Star Trek" series. They're getting their car stolen. Dressed like fictional characters, they wander in the desert. Girls try to decipher the universe of comics...

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: Sheldon, forced to work with Barry Kripke, is trying to put an end to their collaboration. He ends up inventing lies that could put him in an embarrassing situation. Howard and Raj spend a huge amount of money on making figurines of themselves...

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: Leonard is mad at Sheldon, who told her about the end of the Harry Potter novels. He then decided to leave the apartment and move in with Penny. Amy jumps on the occasion and offers her boyfriend to take Leonard's place. But Sheldon is not convinced...

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell - Season 4
programme.desc: In Nice, 72-year-old Marie-Hélène and 74-year-old Benoît thought they would enjoy their retirement peacefully. But the installation of padel fields a few meters from their garden is changing their daily lives. In Haute-Goulaine, 60-year-old Anissa, her house has deteriorated since the construction of the neighbouring building. For four years, she has been conducting a judicial fight that has exhausted her, and has not yet been resolved.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell - Season 3
programme.sub-title: My neighbor's parking at my house.
programme.desc: The neighbourhood can become a source of conflict and daily life can then turn into a nightmare, especially when neighbours are squatters who occupy a house or apartment and make a living hell for families living nearby without respect. Faced with these tensions between neighbours, the first to be deployed to try to calm things down are the forces of law and order.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My life is hell - Season 1
programme.desc: Violence, insults, broken dialogue: zooming in on neighbours who rot their lives and between whom the dialogue is completely broken. Between physical and verbal violence, the neighbourhood disputes are settled with the help of a mediator. Others can go to the courts.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Inside Burger King: Behind the Scenes of a Fast Food Giant
programme.desc: In a few years, Burger King has become a major player in fast food in France. The American brand, born in Miami in 1954, has long disappeared and has signed a return that was noticed in 2012. Since then, its development has been accelerating. Bold advertising campaigns, your staggered pace, technological innovations, ambitious investments: the strategy is clear and taken care of. Franchised and employees evoke the backstage of a growing network. With more than 600 restaurants and nearly 50 new openings each year, the brand continues its conquest of the territory. An immersion in the wheels of a success that has become inevitable.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
That's France!
programme.desc: Through different topics and several headings, "C'est c'est c'est c'est c'il la France!" promotes living together and highlights the diversity of France. Surrounded by his columnists, Julie Mamou-Mani, alias "Mamuz", Anthony Babkine and Nadège Mongerard, alias "Nadège 100 Gêne", Yasmine Oughlis promotes living together and orchestra, with the good mood that characterizes it, this program that focuses on highlighting the social, economic and cultural issues of French society. To follow, moments of escape, lively debates and constructive information, while keeping a positive perspective.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: The Ain near Lyon is experiencing an increase in crimes. The gendarmes of Trevoux are on constant alert. The PSIG specializes in night missions.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.title: A candlelit Christmas
programme.desc: As the end of the year approaches, Juliet, an ambitious wellness expert, finally sees the opportunity to make her talent recognized. His idea? For her, this project is not only a question of creativity, but a chance to get the much-awaited promotion in her company. Yet his enthusiasm is quickly met with a major obstacle: Tom, the owner of a small craft candle shop, as talented as he is skeptical. He believes that the welfare industry is just an illusion machine, and he categorically refuses to collaborate on what he considers to be a marketing operation that is devoid of sincerity. But Tom is hiding a secret that could make things go wrong. Behind his apparent coldness is a father ready to do anything to fulfill his daughter's Christmas vow. When he realizes that the income generated by this project could offer him this opportunity, he reluctantly accepts to associate with Juliet.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, the team of the Unsolved Business Section, led by Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), is committed to reopening long forgotten investigations, confronting the ghosts of the past. The season opens with a tragic case: a massacre in a large area in 1995, where a possible third accomplice emerges, questioning the version of events. In another episode, the death of a policeman, suspected of corruption in 1968, revives investigations into a troubled past. The discovery of a teenager's remains in a garbage dumpster raises questions about the young man's identity and the circumstances of his disappearance. Each case is intertwined with poignant cultural references, such as the Columbine shooting and controversial doctor Jack Kevorkian. With a rich soundtrack, mixing artists like Bob Dylan and Coldplay, this Cold Case season plunges the spectator into an emotional exploration of the consequences of unsolved crimes.

programme.title: Ovnis: What is the White House hiding from us?
programme.desc: From Truman to Trump's, many secrets and theories have been kept secret about UFOs and aliens. Do the heads of state deliberately hide the truth? Presidents Eisenhower, Nixon, Carter, and Reagan were reported to have had direct contact. Unless the heads of state are kept out of the way...Scientists, researchers and historians share their knowledge on the subject and try to shed light on this mystery.

programme.title: UFO: The Secret Technologies of the Aliens
programme.desc: Researchers, scientists and other journalists are recaping the theory that the greatest inventions of the 20th century are actually inventions of alien origin. Small green men are believed to be the source of technological advances of this century. That is what Richard Dolan, Dwight Equitz, Leslie Kean and Jason McClellan, all specialists in alien theories, believe. Using archival records and gaps in official versions, they are recaptured into the history of modern technologies of questionable origins.

programme.title: Zone 51: The secret base that intrigues the planet
programme.desc: Flying saucers recovered by the American government, an extraterrestrial body analyzed in the greatest secret: Zone 51, in the middle of Nevada desert, northwest of Las Vegas, has been feeding theories for decades. "Independence Day" and "X-Files" have helped make it famous around the world. For nearly sixty years, the authorities refused to officially recognize its existence until the CIA did so in 2013. This documentary decrypts the declassified archives, collects the words of the whistleblowers and updates the latest developments.

programme.title: Roswell: The latest revelations
programme.desc: In July 1947, in the Roswell area of New Mexico, a farmer discovered debris scattered over nearly 200 metres. On 8 July, the neighbouring military base announced that it had recovered a "flying record". A few hours later, the army retracted: it was only a weather balloon. The case reappeared some 30 years later, when a former intelligence officer claimed that the debris was nothing of a balloon. Since then, Roswell has become the symbol of UFOs and state secrets. Back to one of the most famous mysteries in the United States: what really crashed in Roswell in 1947?

programme.title: Ovnis: the secret defence files
programme.desc: This program explores fascinating and sometimes disturbing accounts of UFO observations around the world. Based on evidence from pilots, scientists and civilians, the program examines the evidence available and attempts to demystify these unidentified aerial phenomena. The show also explores the different theories about the origin of these flying objects, ranging from rational scientific theories to the most farfetched hypotheses, involving even alien civilizations. An informative and entertaining approach to a subject that continues to intrigue the whole world.
