programme.title: Marseille, the Tapie Revolution
programme.desc: In 1986, while the Olympique de Marseille was again bankrupt, Gaston Deferre met Bernard Tapie at the Russian embassy. Everything is going very quickly: a revolution will upset OM and the whole of French football. Tapie took power on 12 April 1986. Three years later he made one of the club's greatest achievements: the double Coupe de France and the Championship, with the two "mots" Gérard Gili and Eric Di Meco, but also the one who will become one of the greatest French scorers: Jean-Pierre Papin. It is this three-year adventure that this film tells with forgotten archives and testimonies from leaders, players, fans and iconic personalities of Marseille.

programme.title: France-Cambodia: So far, so close
programme.desc: How did Cambodia, ravaged less than fifty years ago by one of the most deadly genocides of the twentieth century, become the host of the 20th Summit of La Francophonie? And what remains, more than 160 years after the protectorate chosen by King Norodom I in 1863, of the singular bond between Phnom Penh and Paris? The common history of the two countries is that of a passionate relationship: a protectorate requested rather than impossibly, an independence obtained without confrontation by Norodom Sihanouk in 1953, and then the collapse under Pol Pot's regime. Peace is negotiated in Paris at the 1991 Conference. Those who have lived it from the inside tell behind the scenes. Cambodian officials are talking about reconstruction, the delicate balance between China, Vietnam and the West, and the place France can still hold.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: On a captivating journey through France, "Mothers to..." plunges spectators into the heart of regions rich in history and culture, where every murder revealed is intimately linked to a local legend or a landmark event. Each episode highlights a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, whose skills are not always limited to those of the law enforcement agencies. These characters, sometimes from a variety of backgrounds, mix their talents and perspectives to solve complex puzzles that shake local communities. As investigations, tensions and affinities develop, adding a romantic and human dimension to their investigations. Between police intrigues and cultural discoveries, this series will seduce polar lovers while immersing them in the French heritage, making each murder a mystery to be deciphered, and a story to tell.
programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: While Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are continuing their investigations in New York, their collaboration is being tested by unexpected reunions. Joan crosses the path of Shinwell Johnson, a former patient whose tumultuous journey leads him to seek his help. Determined to help her, she finds herself immersed in a complex world of loyalties and difficult choices. At the same time, Holmes faces an unexpected return from Kitty Winter, her former partner, who gives her a crucial warning about an imminent threat. In this climate of tension, Captain Gregson (Aidan Quinn) seeks to have the contributions of the two detectives recognized, adding a political dimension to their efforts. This fifth season, which celebrates the 100 episodes, further deepens the dynamics between Holmes and Watson, while exploring themes of redemption, danger and the impact of past choices.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: In New York, Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), an exceptionally brilliant but arrogant detective, is trying to reintegrate into the world of investigation after a difficult period of detoxification. Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), the famous genius detective, faces a new challenge as he emerges from a period of detoxification. His willingness to resume service is complicated by his arrogance and unconventional methods. To help her navigate this delicate phase of her life, her father hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had taken a radical turn in her career. Joan, initially reluctant, is forced to follow Sherlock in his investigations, while juggling with his own demons and the pressure of a complex criminal world. Together, they form an unexpected duo, where Sherlock's relentless logic confronts Joan's intuition and sensitivity. As they resolve mysterious affairs in New York, their relationship evolves, mixing tension, respect and a touch of friendship, while revealing each other's flaws and wounds.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: A decade after Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) disappeared from the CIA radars, leaving behind his turbulent past as a murderer. After spending ten years fleeing his old life and the demons accompanying him, Bourne strives to regain peace and understand the mysteries of his identity. However, his former mentor, Robert Dewey, director of the CIA, cannot help but consider him a residual threat and, eager to bring him back to order, hires Heather Lee, a hacker and counter-insurgency specialist, to find Bourne. As information on Bourne's past began to emerge, he found himself trained in a real game of cat and mouse, with CIA agents on his tracks determined to neutralize him. Tension rises as those who have formed it still consider it one of their most dangerous creations, while Bourne begins to make disturbing discoveries about the hidden truths that link his past to secret CIA operations.

programme.title: Jason Bourne: The Legacy
programme.desc: The Treadstone program, which made Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) a formidable secret agent, was only the facade of a much more complex machination. As the ramifications of this government conspiracy spread, another project emerges: "Outcome". At the heart of this new initiative is Aaron Cross (Jeremy Renner), one of six agents created not to be mere murderers, but to carry out isolated high-risk missions with formidable efficiency. However, when Jason Bourne starts revealing the truths hidden behind Treadstone, it triggers a chain reaction that endangers all the agents of "Outcome". Aaron, conscious of the imminent danger, must navigate a world where loyalty and survival are luxuries, while seeking to understand his own heritage. In this struggle to escape a system that wants to eliminate it, Aaron Cross discovers the limits of his planned existence and the search for his identity.

programme.desc: In this new season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque landscapes of France become the scene of captivating criminal mysteries, where every investigation is intimately linked to the cultural heritage and local traditions. The protagonists, Fauve Hautot and Aurelien Wiik, find themselves immersed in the heart of sordid business that reveal the buried secrets of their region. Every murder is anchored in a legend or a building full of history, thus revealing the dark facets of French heritage. The spectators follow these experienced investigators as they navigate between folklore and criminal investigation, digging up sometimes disturbing truths. The appearances of iconic figures such as Line Renaud, Samuel Labarthe, Francis Huster and Olivier Marchal add dramatic depth to the intrigues, enriching the story of their talent and charisma. This season promises a fascinating exploration of local mysteries, between dramatic tensions and unexpected revelations.

programme.title: Capucine
programme.desc: In a world where freshness and authenticity reign as masters, Capucine (Barbara Bolotner) stands out for her sparkling personality and her sense of humor. Equipped with her Airpods, she navigates modern life with unarming daring, sharing her thoughts and anecdotes through a series of colorful phone calls. Every conversation becomes an opportunity to reveal its unique vision of the world, mixing extravagance and frankness. Through exchanges with friends and family, Capucine addresses a variety of themes, ranging from interpersonal relationships to the little nonsense of everyday life, while keeping a light and impertinent tone. Her touching and feminine approach to daily life invites viewers to reflect on their own existence while offering a dose of laughter and comfort. This first episode thus lays the foundations of a promising series, where authenticity and joy of life are in the spotlight.

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.
programme.desc-more: In a school where the ordinary meets the extraordinary, the daily life takes place between laughter and tears. Teachers, like Mr. Moreau (Rayane Bensetti), try to maintain order in a class of schoolboys who are disinclined and dreaming. Outside the classroom, parents, stressed by the demands of education, struggle to give their children the best while facing their own doubts. Students, represented by characters such as Clara (Caroline Anglade) and Hugo (Morgan Bontemps), navigate between tumultuous friendships and first love emodies, while facing the challenges of adolescence. In the corridors and in the canteen, the intrigues are formed and concluded, revealing unexpected alliances and palpable rivalries. Every day at school is a microcosm of the joys and sorrows of life, where each interaction can lead to significant discoveries about oneself and others.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: The bodies of a firefighter and his wife are found in their house. They were brutally murdered. A team immediately goes to the site.
programme.desc-more: While the big finance and dirty politicians cases are still on the agenda for Lupo and Bernard, the two police officers also regularly find themselves in the New York lowlands: a polygamous sect, clandestine street fighting, an illegal adoption route, the Russian mafia and a serial killer who is elusive: these are the cases the team is facing this year. programme.title: Capucine
programme.desc: A bubble of humour, feminine, touching and impertinent, discover Capucine. Airpods well-buried in the ears, Capucine shares her frankness, extravagance and freshness with each call.
programme.desc-more: In a world where freshness and authenticity reign as masters, Capucine (Barbara Bolotner) stands out for her sparkling personality and her sense of humor. Equipped with her Airpods, she navigates modern life with unarming daring, sharing her thoughts and anecdotes through a series of colorful phone calls. Every conversation becomes an opportunity to reveal its unique vision of the world, mixing extravagance and frankness. Through exchanges with friends and family, Capucine addresses a variety of themes, ranging from interpersonal relationships to the little nonsense of everyday life, while keeping a light and impertinent tone. Her touching and feminine approach to daily life invites viewers to reflect on their own existence while offering a dose of laughter and comfort. This first episode thus lays the foundations of a promising series, where authenticity and joy of life are in the spotlight.

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: Depressive teachers, stressed parents and school children in the moon try to survive the horrors and joys of daily life in school. Relationships intertwine for the best and often for the worst!
programme.desc-more: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.

programme.desc-more: In a school where the ordinary meets the extraordinary, the daily life takes place between laughter and tears. Teachers, like Mr. Moreau (Rayane Bensetti), try to maintain order in a class of schoolboys who are disinclined and dreaming. Outside the classroom, parents, stressed by the demands of education, struggle to give their children the best while facing their own doubts. Students, represented by characters such as Clara (Caroline Anglade) and Hugo (Morgan Bontemps), navigate between tumultuous friendships and first love emodies, while facing the challenges of adolescence. In the corridors and in the canteen, the intrigues are formed and concluded, revealing unexpected alliances and palpable rivalries. Every day at school is a microcosm of the joys and sorrows of life, where each interaction can lead to significant discoveries about oneself and others.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: While the big finance and dirty politicians cases are still on the agenda for Lupo and Bernard, the two police officers also regularly find themselves in the New York lowlands: a polygamous sect, clandestine street fighting, an illegal adoption route, the Russian mafia and a serial killer who is elusive: these are the cases the team is facing this year. As the next season, this 19th season is one of the few to stage an unchanged distribution: an opportunity to change the relationships between the characters and to deepen exciting legal controversies.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.
programme.desc-more: In a school where the ordinary meets the extraordinary, the daily life takes place between laughter and tears. Teachers, like Mr. Moreau (Rayane Bensetti), try to maintain order in a class of schoolboys who are disinclined and dreaming. Outside the classroom, parents, stressed by the demands of education, struggle to give their children the best while facing their own doubts. Students, represented by characters such as Clara (Caroline Anglade) and Hugo (Morgan Bontemps), navigate between tumultuous friendships and first love emodies, while facing the challenges of adolescence. In the corridors and in the canteen, the intrigues are formed and concluded, revealing unexpected alliances and palpable rivalries. Every day at school is a microcosm of the joys and sorrows of life, where each interaction can lead to significant discoveries about oneself and others.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Captain Montgomery died, and Beckett, shot and wounded, underwent a major operation. She's safe and sound, but a priori amnesia because she doesn't remember Castle telling her she's a flame. Her health is improving from day to day and she eventually returns to the service, without immediately feeling able to return to the field. With Castle, she is still retracing her mother's killer, Castle's great dam, who is worried about her. In the fourth season, Lanie and Esposito split up, as did Alexis and his boyfriend, Ashley, while Ryan married his fiancée, Jenny. And Alexis, who grew up, is about to enter college, and is more interested in his father's work with the police.
programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.title: MI-5: Infiltration
programme.desc: In London, an alert is sounded as Adem Qasim, a dangerous terrorist, manages to escape during a planned transfer to the CIA. In the midst of urgency and panic, US agent June Keaton, working for MI-5, is engaged in a frantic hunt for this criminal and his accomplices. Their operation takes a tragic turn when the American agent is killed, allowing Qasim to disappear again in the shadows. As tensions escalate and London is now under growing terrorist threat, Harry Pearce, the head of the secret service, finds himself at the heart of a scandal and mysteriously disappears. To resolve this crisis, Will Holloway, a former MI-5 agent tormented by his past and weary of the quiet life he chose, is recruited to find Harry and neutralize Qasim. In a game of cat and mouse, loyalty, sacrifice and the need for redemption come at the heart of a thrilling plot.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: In the vibrant city of Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon) is distinguished by her direct approach and unwavering determination to resolve complex criminal cases. Working closely with Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), a brilliant and resourceful forensic doctor, they form an unexpected yet complementary duo. While Jane uses her sharpened instinct and field experience, Maura brings a scientific perspective essential to every investigation. Together, they face a series of disturbing murders, revealing buried secrets and obscure motivations. Their investigations plunge them into the darkest corners of the human psyche, while exploring the challenges of their friendship. Through thrilling twists and unexpected revelations, Jane and Maura must navigate between their intense professional life and their personal life, building an unfailing bond in a world where death and truth intertwine.
programme.desc-more: Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), a well-dipped detective, is called to the rescue when the wife of a former teammate entrusts her with a desperate affair: her daughter has just been abducted in a car. programme.desc-more: In the peaceful and seemingly idyllic Wisteria Lane Street, located in the chic suburbs of Fairview, four housewives find themselves at the heart of a whirlwind of unexpected events. Susan Meyer (Teri Hatcher), a single mother with a tender heart, aspires to true love while juggling the challenges of motherhood. Lynette Scavo (Felicity Huffman), a former dynamic advertising environment, sacrificed her career to raise her children, but has to face the tumult of a chaotic family life. Bree Van de Kamp (Marcia Cross), a perfectionist and methodical, strives to maintain a control facade, while Gabrielle Solis (Eva Longoria), a capricious and seductive model, struggles with the demands of his flamboyant lifestyle. As friendships strengthen and test each other, each character must navigate through the obstacles imposed by their desires, ambitions and hidden truths, highlighting the complexity of life in the suburbs. programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.sub-title: All the gold of the Rhine
programme.desc: A young man is found dead, dressed in an authentic SS uniform. This student was doing research on "The Gold of the Rhine", a mythical Nazi treasure.
programme.desc-more: The body of a young man is discovered in the middle of a wasteland. Captain Caesar Wagner, compulsive hypochondriac, and his team find that the deceased, dressed in a real SS officer uniform, was killed with a bullet in his head. Thanks to Flora Salvi, a professor of military history, they learn that the uniform belonged to Nazi officer Wolfgang Hartmann, who founded the SS Ruins section in 1943 in Strasbourg. Thanks to a tattoo on the victim, the victim is identified as a student in history, close to a neo-Nazi circle.

programme.title: Snooker : Open from England
programme.sub-title: Open England. Final. Ali Carter / Mark Williams. Home Nations Series.
programme.desc: The 2026 Open of England finals are between Englishman Ali Carter and Welshman Mark Williams at the Brentwood Centre. This World Tour Veterans' duel, whose combined age is close to 100, promises a tactical and historic confrontation, at the best of 17 frames. Ali Carter has the opportunity to re-enter the top 16 world elite in the tournament at 25th place in the world. For his part, if he won, Mark Williams, a triple world champion, would improve his own record at 51 years of age as the oldest winner of a ranked tournament in the history of the snooker.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: The body of a 3-year-old girl was found in a cardboard box, in a parking lot. Catherine, moved, takes this matter very seriously.
programme.desc-more: The Las Vegas criminal experts team is confronted with a particularly disturbing case when they discover the corpse of a little girl hidden in a cardboard box in a parking lot. The victim's identity remains a mystery, plunging the team into a complex and emotionally charged investigation. Catherine Willows (Marg Helgenberger), deeply affected by this tragedy, invested body and soul in the matter, determined to do justice to this innocent child. Along with her colleagues, she analyses each clue, questions witnesses and explores the meanderings of a world where cruelty can hide under innocent appearances. As the investigation progresses, shocking revelations emerge, confronting the team with disturbing truths about the vulnerability of children. Tensions are mounting within the team, each struggling with their own emotions in the face of this tragedy, making this investigation even more personal.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: Langston testified in the trial of a prominent member of Congress. Following a turnaround, the experts are responsible for reopening the investigation.
programme.desc-more: In a climate of political tension, a member of Parliament finds himself at the heart of a resounding trial for the murder of his mistress. Langston (Laurence Fishburne), a representative of the Public Prosecutor's Office, relied on overwhelming evidence that seemed to confirm the Member's guilt. As the trial turns dramatic, an unexpected event occurs: the deputy member of the MP commits suicide on the witness bench, with the weapon that was used to commit the crime. This tragic gesture, accompanied by a letter left on site, reveals that the deputy is the sole responsible for the victim's death. In this atmosphere full of emotions and revelations, investigators must navigate through a complex network of lies and manipulations, questioning the version of events. While well-kept secrets are resurfaced, the truth about this case is more disturbing than expected, immerse all the protagonists in a profound moral dilemma.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: New York journalist found dead in a Las Vegas driveway. Langston knew her well, so he was out of the investigation.
programme.desc-more: In a dark alley, a woman's body is discovered, strangled, leaving the police in a state of disarray. The investigation is quickly led by Dr. Langston (Laurence Fishburne), who identifies the victim as a renowned journalist, known for his audacity and integrity. What makes this case even more disturbing is that the journalist had already investigated a similar case a few years earlier, involving mysterious Dr. Jekyll, a criminal who is elusive and whose crimes remain unresolved. By searching his bag, the team discovers disturbing photographs of all the victims of this insidious killer. The situation is taking an unexpected turn when the journalist's husband, a publisher with a temperament, accuses Langston of murder, endangering the investigation and the relationship of trust within the team. programme.desc: Inspector Columbo (Peter Falk), with his crippled raincoat and his disdainful air, is walking the streets of Los Angeles solving complex murders, often committed by criminals of respectable appearance. programme.desc-more: Columbo is a police series that follows Lieutenant Frank Columbo's investigations, performed by Peter Falk. Recognising its worn raincoat and its casual look, Columbo embodies an archetype of detective who hides a sharp mind under a modest appearance. Each episode opens up to the crime itself, often a carefully orchestrated murder, allowing the viewer to know the identity of the victim and the perpetrator from the outset. This unconventional narrative choice highlights the intellectual challenge that awaits Columbo: to expose the culprit despite his prior knowledge. The series is distinguished by its methodical approach to criminal investigation. Columbo does not rely on spectacular investigative techniques or dramatic confrontations. On the contrary, he adopts a patient and insidious interrogation method, focusing on the anodized details that often escape the suspects. Through his apparently innocent exchanges, he manages to create an atmosphere of tension that causes criminals to make mistakes. This subtle way of sitting down his authority makes each episode a character study and a demonstration of intelligence. The episodes also feature a variety of characters, often performed by renowned actors such as Patrick McGoohan, Shera Danese and Bruce Kirby.

programme.desc-more: In a climate of political tension, a member of Parliament finds himself at the heart of a resounding trial for the murder of his mistress. Langston (Laurence Fishburne), a representative of the Public Prosecutor's Office, relied on overwhelming evidence that seemed to confirm the Member's guilt. As the trial turns dramatic, an unexpected event occurs: the deputy member of the MP commits suicide on the witness bench, with the weapon that was used to commit the crime. This tragic gesture, accompanied by a letter left on site, reveals that the deputy is the sole responsible for the victim's death. In this atmosphere full of emotions and revelations, investigators must navigate through a complex network of lies and manipulations, questioning the version of events. While well-kept secrets are resurfaced, the truth about this case is more disturbing than expected, immerse all the protagonists in a profound moral dilemma.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: After being stabbed with a knife, Langston fights death. Psychopath Nate Haskell will be facing federal justice.
programme.desc-more: After suffering serious injuries in a confrontation with psychopath Nate Haskell, investigator Langston (Laurence Fishburne) is in a critical condition in the hospital. Meanwhile, members of his team of forensics, including Catherine Willows (Marg Helgenberger) and Nick Stokes (George Eads), are gathering to pay tribute to their late colleague Clark. However, the ceremony took a tragic turn when three bombs exploded, sowing panic and desolation among the participants. The perpetrator of the attacks seems to be an unbalanced individual, driven by a desire for revenge against the law enforcement forces. The investigators, in search of answers, are heading to a community centre where they hope to find clues about the identity of this terrorist. As the investigation progresses, tensions rise and secrets buried threaten to resurge, testing the team's determination and resilience.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: During Michael Fife's trial, the investigators bring evidence that is considered inadmissible by the defence: the case is likely to be closed.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the "Experts" series, Las Vegas investigators find themselves confronted with a complex case when Michael Fife is suspected of being involved in Rachel Lyford's rape and murder. The evidence seems overwhelming: a murder weapon and a blood-stained towel are found in Fife's vehicle, reinforcing the team's suspicions. However, at the trial, the defence questioned the legitimacy of the evidence, arguing that the search by Warrick Brown (Gary Dourdan) was illegal. This reversal creates palpable tension within the team, while investigators must navigate through the judicial system and investigative techniques. As evidence multiplys, the episode raises crucial questions about justice, truth and how evidence can be interpreted in a legal framework.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: A photographer accuses himself of murdering a model before he comes back to his statements. Catherine agrees to play the game of man to discover the truth.
programme.desc-more: The mysterious disappearance of Julie Waters, an ambitious dancer who aspires to become a model, plunges Las Vegas into a wave of anxiety and media attention. As the case draws the attention of the press, investigators of the scientific police quickly focus on Howard Delhomme, a photographer with a troubled past, who becomes the main suspect. Despite the intensity of the investigation, Howard refused to cooperate with the authorities, leaving the investigators in a deadlock. However, he agreed to speak to Catherine Willows (Marg Helgenberger), a key member of the team, who was then entrusted with the delicate task of convincing him to reveal crucial information. As she entered into a tense dialogue with him, Catherine gradually discovered disturbing elements of Howard's past and his relationship with Julie. Her determination to find the young woman pushes her to navigate in a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where every revelation could be the key to solving this disturbing mystery.

programme.title: The blood of the vine
programme.desc: Benjamin Lebel, a prominent oenologist, has increased travel on the largest terroirs. He works on the writing of a guide, meets his wine-growers and is immersed in the atmosphere of contemplation linked to the manufacture of the great wines. When Major Barbaroux, a police officer, asks him to cooperate in a criminal investigation, he accepts the challenge. An old man was murdered. His death was staged. A glass of wine and eleven other empty glasses were arranged around the corpse. Once this case is resolved, Benjamin takes care of his daughter, just back from New York. The young woman fell in love with the director of communication of a large wine house. Lebel doesn't trust the belltress. A golden role for Pierre Arditi, sometimes tricky, sometimes in restraint.
programme.desc-more: Benjamin Lebel (Pierre Arditi), a prominent and passionate oenologist, travels through the largest wineries to write a prestigious guide. His quest led him to meet his wine-growers and to soak up the atmosphere of recollection surrounding the manufacture of the great wines. However, his life took an unexpected turn when Commander Barbaroux, a seasoned police officer, sought his expertise to elucidate a mysterious murder. An old man was murdered in disturbing circumstances, his body surrounded by a glass of wine and eleven empty glasses, suggesting a macabre ritual. While Benjamin is immerse himself in this complex investigation, he must also manage the return of his daughter, newly returned from New York, and his relationship with an attractive communication director of a large wine house, a man in whom he sees no good intentions. Between mystery, family tensions and passion for wine, Benjamin navigates a world where appearances are deceptive.

programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: The files are piled up on the office of the investigating judge Alice Nevers: abuse of power, victims of murders found drowned in the Seine, crooked in a small week closely watched in a casino, body of a model found in a vague terrain, as much investigation as the young woman who works in tandem with the police must carry out on the front. The police station is undergoing a major turnover, which is not making it easier. Fortunately, Alice is assisted daily by her faithful clerk, Lemonnier. Alice also tries to live her relationship with Mathieu Brémont, her companion, whose son she will have. This series, which is widely popular, has already 12 seasons. It has been marketed worldwide.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: Sara was kidnapped by the miniature killer, who abandoned her in the desert: the whole team is mobilizing to find her before it's too late. Barely recovered from their emotions, the experts look at the death of a teenager passionate about karting. A dark rivalry story could have caused her loss. Then it was the murder of a horror actress, found an axe planted in her back, that bothered the investigators. The film community does not collaborate with them to help them solve this puzzle. Grissom is also very intrigued by the case of a man, who seems to have caught fire spontaneously. Harold Perrineau Jr, who plays Michael's role in the "Lost" series, made a notable appearance in episode 3 of this season 8, "A Family in Hell".
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series, Grissom's team (William Petersen) is confronted with a disturbing murder: that of the wife of a wealthy businessman. As detectives dive into the investigation, they discover a dark and ruthless universe, that of illegal dog fighting, where cruelty and greed mix in a sordid setting. As they try to unravel the sons of this complex affair, each member of the team faces their own challenges. At the same time, Warrick (Gary Dourdan) is fighting to prove his innocence in another drama: the murder of a dancer, an event that plunges him into a spiral of doubts and tensions. As investigations deepen, the links between the two cases become increasingly evident, revealing deep-seated secrets and testing the loyalty and integrity of each of the investigators.

programme.desc-more: In the early morning in Las Vegas, the peaceful atmosphere was quickly disturbed by a desperate radio call from a patrol car. The injured police officer appealed for help in the ears of Gil Grissom (William Petersen), who was nearby. On his way to the scene, he discovers with horror that a member of his team, seriously affected, lies in a pool of blood. This emotional shock not only shakes Grissom, but also the entire forensics team. programme.desc: Raymond Langston, seriously wounded by Dick and Jane's killer, was rescued by a narrow margin. He lost a kidney and walked with a cane for the moment. The work is not waiting: a woman was attacked by a tiger shark in the pool of a casino. A very bad publicity for the institution, which seeks to understand what might have happened. Langston is not at the end of his surprises: he must investigate the death of a man, murdered according to a macabre ritual. The authors seem to think they're vampires. A drama never arriving alone: Langston's ex-wife and her husband are targeted by Nate Haskell, the psychopath killer. A season enhanced by the participation of singer Justin Bieber and actress Katee Sackhoff in several episodes.
programme.desc-more: After suffering serious injuries in a confrontation with psychopath Nate Haskell, investigator Langston (Laurence Fishburne) is in a critical condition in the hospital. Meanwhile, members of his team of forensics, including Catherine Willows (Marg Helgenberger) and Nick Stokes (George Eads), are gathering to pay tribute to their late colleague Clark. However, the ceremony took a tragic turn when three bombs exploded, sowing panic and desolation among the participants. The perpetrator of the attacks seems to be an unbalanced individual, driven by a desire for revenge against the law enforcement forces. The investigators, in search of answers, are heading to a community centre where they hope to find clues about the identity of this terrorist. As the investigation progresses, tensions rise and secrets buried threaten to resurge, testing the team's determination and resilience.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: D.B. Russell, the new head of the laboratory, takes up his duties and supervises the investigation into the death of two people. The victims were killed in a tram that connected two hotels. Later, it is a whole family that is assassinated by one or more criminals. Morgan Brody joins the team to support the police's efforts. Catherine, who was injured in an intervention, owes Russell his life, who did everything possible to protect her from bullets. A large operation, led jointly by law enforcement and experts, finally tackles a problem that gangens the gambling city: corruption. Ted Danson ("Damages") replaces Laurence Fishburne in a season that favours action.
programme.desc-more: While Russell, Sara and Greg are going to a crime scene in the desert, Nick and Jim face double murder. While Sara takes the helicopter with a rescuer to take him to the hospital, he diverts the vehicle and takes the passengers hostage. Very quickly, experts understand that both cases are linked. Morgan is trying to control the man who loses his temper and threatens with a weapon.

programme.title: Research Section
programme.desc: In this captivating fourth season of the series, Carole Leroy (Virginie Caliari) finds herself at the heart of a disturbing investigation after a tragic incident: a poker blow left her unconscious in the middle of her boxes. As the Research Section resumes service, the team finds itself facing a series of violent crimes. They must first elucidate the murder of an ostrian farmer, who was found beaten to death, whose peaceful life was brutally interrupted. At the same time, a woman is shot down on the court of the church, preventing her final confession. The tension rises as another victim stabbed in the night sees his way to Compostela stopped net. The investigators, led by Carole, plunge into a spiral of intrigues and secrets, revealing a complex network of motivations and relationships. Each episode promises a twist, captivating a wide audience, faithful to the series.
programme.desc-more: In the dynamic city of Bordeaux, Captain Martin Bernier (Xavier Deluc) is the rigorous and determined leader of the Homicides group of the Research Section, an elite police unit responsible for solving serious crimes. Their investigations plunge them into cases as disturbing as they are varied, ranging from the mysterious murder of a mother, initially perceived as a model of virtue, to the murder of a tetraplegic man with the tumultuous past. Each episode highlights Martin's hard work and his team, faced with moral dilemmas and disconcerting mysteries. A particularly poignant abduction of children test the limits of their professionalism and humanity, while a burglary that goes wrong reveals unexpected and dangerous ramifications. Over the course of this first season, the Research Section has been asserting itself as a team, ready to face the horror and complexity of human nature, while navigating in the troubled waters of justice and truth.

programme.title: Research Section
programme.desc: Ghemara's life, wounded by a bullet in the chest, is suspended from a wire. Chief Warrant Officer Claire Linski (Linda Hardy), recently promoted, takes over the lead of the investigation, determined to solve this mystery that plunges the police into uncertainty. As the murders multiply and anxiety grows, police officers begin to take a close interest in Inspector Bernier (Xavier Deluc), placing him under scrupulous surveillance. The evidence is accumulated, revealing a parachute that does not open and two bodies sharing one identity, testing the skills of the Research Section (SR). Each new discovery reinforces the pressure on Linski and his team, who must navigate through a maze of clues and false-semblings. In this third season, tensions are rising, and the entry of Claire Linski brings a new breath to a series already appreciated by the public, promising thrilling turns and a high-fly investigation.

programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: After seeing her assailant released from prison for lack of evidence, Gisèle, a teenage girl, fled the mother's home to live with Wendy. She was also the victim of rape, but for which she never filed a complaint. The two girls decided to hunt for paedophiles spotted on the Internet.
programme.desc-more: In a world where justice and truth intertwine, "The judge is a woman" plunges viewers into the heart of a poignant and complex investigation. At the centre of this intrigue, Judge Anne Vignaud (Marine Delterme) teamed up with Commander Marquand (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) to clarify the mystery surrounding the tragic death of Loïc Lardenois, whose body was discovered in a forest, the skull shattered and a weapon in hand. As the investigation progresses, Loïc's couple, Nadège (Medina Diarra), is immersed in a whirlwind of emotions. She still has not overcome the loss of their child, who died at birth, and accuses Dr. Lemaréchal (Guillaume Carcaud) of medical misconduct. This charge becomes a central element of the investigation, questioning the competence of the gynecologist and revealing latent tensions within the medical community. Investigators quickly discover that a break-in took place in the doctor's office on the night of the crime, adding a layer of mystery to this already complex case. As the pieces of the puzzle begin to assemble, pressure rises and unexpected revelations may well upset the fragile balance between justice and revenge. In this game of power and manipulation, the quest for truth is sown with tangles, where each character hides secrets and obscure motivations.

On board a motor-powered cutting, Nicolas Hulot meets dolphins from Irrawaddy. Near the lake are the temples of Angkor and Angkor Vat.

Then he takes a train to Skye Island, full of history and mysteries. Finally, head for Edinburgh, the capital, with its millennial castle and 700 pubs before finishing its journey at the Loch Ness.

programme.title: At the Nazi table
programme.desc: Throughout the six years that separate their accession to power from the 39-45 War, how were the Nazis perceived in the world?
programme.desc-more: Investigation of the six-year period between the Nazis' accession to power until the beginning of the war in 1939 and how they were perceived in the world. During the investigation, the reason why the world tolerated the Nazis and did not anticipate the worst was questioned.

programme.title: The amazing history of the Romans
programme.desc: This story follows the epic of Lucius, a merchant of the first century BC, and explores the workings of the Roman economy between prosperity and risk. His journey led him to Gaul, at the heart of the conflict between Vercinetorix and a ruthless Julius Caesar. The adventure continues in Egypt with the meeting of Cleopatra, before a final return to Rome to admire the majesty and symbolism of the Pantheon.

programme.title: Front line: 39-45 women
programme.desc: During World War II, women challenged clichés and joined the Resistance in order to fight Nazi Germany. Josephine Baker, a famous artist from the 1930s Paris, joined French military intelligence.

programme.title: Front line: 39-45 women
programme.desc: During the Second World War, women pilots marked the history of military aviation. Some joined the allied forces against fascism, carrying out strategic missions of transport and reconnaissance, while two airwomen put their talents at the service of the German Blitzkrieg. These pioneers have proven their value in perilous air operations.

programme.title: Front line: 39-45 women
programme.desc: Women have changed military codes during the Second World War by engaging in strategic operations. In command of combat aircraft, infiltrated resistance networks or collected vital information, they excelled in high-risk missions. Their clandestine actions, from sabotage to spying, weakened enemy positions on all fronts.

programme.title: Front page
programme.desc: Access to information has changed considerably over the 20th century, and war reports are a perfect illustration of this. From newspaper articles during the First World War to live testimonies from journalists on the ground today, this section explores the transformation of media coverage and its profound impact on modern conflicts.

programme.title: Historically show
programme.desc: Jean-Christophe Buisson received Thierry Lentz for "The Myths of Napoleon" (Perrin) and Maxime d'Aboville for his show "Napoléon" every Monday at 7pm at the Théâtre de Poche Montparnasse. Eugenie Bastie chronicle " La Chute. France, 1940 " by Julian Jackson (Seuil).

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.desc: A member of the Secret du roi, an organization led by Louis XV, the knight of Eon is the most fantastic figure of the eighteenth century. To gain high responsibilities, he was able to seduce the monarchy. But he also managed to shake the kingdom, notably by living one day in man's clothes and another in women's clothes. The period documents and historians' testimonies allow us to lift the veil on the tumultuous life of this atypical spy.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: Ladies' War in the Court of the Sun King
programme.desc: A look back at the fate of the Marquise de Montespan and Madame de Maintenon, two women of influence in the court of the Sun King. Arriving at the Château de Versailles in the autumn of 1666, the Marquise de Montespan became very soon one of Louis XIV's favourites. Passionate about the arts and luxury, she is dreaded by all for her sarcasm and her scathing distribution. But in 1680, Madame de Maintenon, widow of the poet Paul Scarron, encouraged the sovereign to move away from it and took advantage of it to impose himself.

programme.title: The mythical battles of the Second World War
programme.desc: In the summer of 1940, British air forces confronted the powerful Luftwaffe in the English sky. Equipped with a modern defensive device, the RAF is responding with determination, relying on exceptional airmen like Ginger Lacey and a Polish squadron. This British triumph destroyed Hitler's invasion plans and became a pivotal moment in World War II.

programme.title: The mythical battles of the Second World War
programme.desc: During World War II, Nazi Germany heavily bombed Britain during the Blitz for eight months. To counter this offensive, the RAF launched Operation Corona, employing German-speaking controllers to disorient the Luftwaffe pilots. In the affected cities, children are involved in the rescue of the victims. The British population maintained its determination to face the raids.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: The Romanovs, investigation into the death of the Tsar and his family
programme.desc: On the night of July 16-17, 1918, in Ekaterinburg, the Tsar Nicholas II, his wife Alexandra and their five children were executed by the Bolsheviks. But in the 1970s, British journalists Antony Summers and Tom Mangold questioned the official version. According to them, the five women of the imperial family would have survived thanks to an agreement between Lenin and Emperor William II. More recently Olga's diary, the eldest daughter of the imperial couple, was reportedly discovered. Meeting with researchers who are returning to this file and testimonies.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.desc: Rasputine is one of the most enigmatic characters in contemporary history. After he aroused passions at the Russian court, Rasputine ended up assassinated on 16 December 1916. Franck Ferrand investigates the reasons for his murder.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.desc: During the Second World War, a million young Soviet women were said to have fought in the Russian army. These female regiments were reportedly formed in Podolsk, and were very present during the Battle of Stalingrad. But it was in the air that women distinguished themselves. The Night Witches led by Marina Rakova or the mysterious disappearance of the aviator Lily Litvyak remain surrounded by mystery. Meeting with the last survivors who share their memories of fighting to illustrate this unknown period of history.

programme.title: Vampire Earth
programme.desc: In Poland, an international team of scientists investigates an amazing archaeological discovery: a field of about thirty bodies of "vampires".

programme.title: Knut, Emperor Viking
programme.sub-title: The birth of a Viking warrior

programme.title: Under the threat of the Khmer Rouge, the fall of the French embassy
programme.desc: During three weeks of spring 1975, the French embassy in Phnom Penh, surrounded by the Khmer Rouge, was the refuge of nearly a thousand Cambodians.
programme.desc-more: On 17 April 1975, the Khmer Rouge took control of Phnom Penh, the capital of Cambodia. A thousand five hundred Westerners and frightened Cambodians take refuge in the French Embassy. France is at the heart of a diplomatic crisis, while Pol Pot's troops refuse to leave the Embassy until the refugees have been delivered. Between Phnom Penh and Paris, France must make a choice between its diplomatic interests and its duty to protect refugees. Fifty years later, archives and witnesses told the story of these three weeks of tension.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: Petiot: Dr. Satan of the Occupancy
programme.desc: On March 11, 1944, in the 16th arrondissement of Paris, pestilential smells from the fireplace of a private hotel intriguing. In the cellar, the firefighters discover the unimaginable: human corpses defiled and ready to be incinerated in a boiler as well as a pit of living lime mixed with pieces of body. On the spot, a man, Dr. Marcel Petiot, claims that the corpses are those of collabos and gestaps eliminated by the Resistance. The police let him go. Two years later, on 4 April 1946, the doctor was sentenced to death by the Seine d'Assizes court for 24 murders. He was guillotined on May 25, 1946. Back on the path of the one whom he nicknamed "Dr. Satan".

programme.title: Julius Caesar, the factory of a dictator
programme.desc: Before becoming consul of Rome, Julius Caesar was an ambitious young man ready to do anything to achieve the highest political office in the Republic. By using threat and corruption to achieve its ends, he also made dangerous enemies.

programme.title: Julius Caesar, the factory of a dictator
programme.desc: Caesar has entered into a difficult alliance with the other two most powerful men of the Republic, Pompey and Crassus. They both dominate the political system and Caesar seems untouchable. He left Rome to take the governorate of Gaul, France of today, in order to conquer his people and gain even more power and prestige. But events beyond his control threaten to fail his plans and leave him isolated. He was at the foot of the wall and made a decision that would forever change the course of the republic.

programme.title: Julius Caesar, the factory of a dictator
programme.desc: As Caesar took control of Rome and consolidated his grip on the republic, he granted himself increasingly important powers. Appointed dictator for a year to restore peace, he soon passed to ten years and then dictator for life. Caesar has become untouchable, and Rome is now, in the modern sense of the term, a dictatorship. Caesar's ambition has become tyranny. A handful of senators, including some of his closest allies, plot to end his reign in the only way possible: by taking his life. But will it be enough to save the republic?

programme.title: The amazing history of the Romans
programme.desc: In the second century, under the reign of Emperor Commodus, a prisoner of war was forced to become a gladiator. His journey reveals the backstage of the arena, where glory is gained in blood. While he struggles for his survival, the emperor's sister, Lucilla, conspires to overthrow the tyrant, illustrating the intrigues of a Rome fascinated by violence and spectacle.

programme.title: The mythical battles of the Second World War
programme.desc: In the summer of 1940, British air forces confronted the powerful Luftwaffe in the English sky. Equipped with a modern defensive device, the RAF is responding with determination, relying on exceptional airmen like Ginger Lacey and a Polish squadron. This British triumph destroyed Hitler's invasion plans and became a pivotal moment in World War II.

programme.title: The mythical battles of the Second World War
programme.desc: During World War II, Nazi Germany heavily bombed Britain during the Blitz for eight months. To counter this offensive, the RAF launched Operation Corona, employing German-speaking controllers to disorient the Luftwaffe pilots. In the affected cities, children are involved in the rescue of the victims. The British population maintained its determination to face the raids.

programme.title: The mythical battles of the Second World War
programme.desc: At the beginning of World War II, the British Expeditionary Force and other Allied troops were rescued from the French seaport of Dunkirk and taken to the other side of the English Channel. Nick Mavroidakis reveals the secrets of this evacuation, the encircling of French troops by the Germans, and the history of the 38,000 men who were abandoned. He also tries to understand why Hitler ordered the Nazi tanks to stop advancing on the Allies.

programme.title: The mythical battles of the Second World War
programme.desc: On December 7, 1941, during the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, two American sailors distinguished themselves by their exceptional courage. Joe George disobeyed orders to save six fellow compatriots trapped on a burning ship. Dorie Miller, without prior training, took control of an anti-aircraft machine gun and managed to shoot down several enemy aircraft during the assault on the naval base.

programme.title: Nazi Megastructures

programme.desc: Thanks to science and unheard of excavations, experts reconstruct the Palais de la Cité, the first residence of the kings of France, at its peak in the 14th century.
programme.desc-more: The first residence of the kings of France, the Palais de la Cité, stood in the Middle Ages on the most prestigious island of Paris, the historic cradle of France, facing Notre-Dame. Over the centuries, this masterpiece of architecture has almost completely disappeared. For the first time, a trio of experts will resurrect him, in 3D. Thanks to science and unreleased excavations, Yves Ubelmann, architect, Marjorie Coulin, photographer and drone pilot, and Bastien Varoutsikos, archaeologist, will track down the pieces of the puzzle to reconstruct it at its peak in the 14th century, and bring life to those who have populated it.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.sub-title: Game of money, game of time
programme.desc: Bobby's putting 25 years of his life at stake in a poker tournament against a witch. Unfortunately, he lost the game and immediately turned into an old man.
programme.desc-more: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.sub-title: The amazing adventures of Sam and Dean
programme.desc: Dean and Sam Winchester, two brothers, grew up without their mother, died in troubled circumstances when they were only children. While Dean spent a lot of time with his father, obsessed with the struggle against the forces of evil, Sam left the family world very early. After their father's disappearance, they both meet to try to follow his lead. Is an occult force behind her abduction? The Winchester brothers set off on American roads and conducted the investigation, crossing at every stage with disturbing creatures. A mysterious series, partly headed by Kim Manners, executive producer, already occasional director on the mythical series "X-Files".
programme.desc-more: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.

programme.title: The college years
programme.sub-title: At the edge of the abyss
programme.desc: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Les ans fac", Clarisse (Camille Raymond) confides to her best friend Laetitia (Virginie Desarnauts) about the tumults of her love life. It reveals the growing tensions between Justine (Rebecca Hampton) and Anthony Dupray, two characters with contrasting personalities who struggle to conquer Clarisse's heart. As rivalries intensify, Laetitia becomes the privileged witness of secrets and unsaid that may well change the course of their friendship. Emotional issues arise as young adults navigate the complexities of love and friendship on campus. Between betrayals and revelations, each character has to face his own desires and uncertainties. This new episode plunges viewers into a whirlwind of emotions, highlighting the challenges of student life, while exploring the fragile ties that bind these young adults in search of identity.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Laure managed to reason with a forceful man who took a class of the school that Clara attended hostage. A victim of a heart attack, Alain decides to sell the clinic. Romances, breakups and betrayals are always on the rendezvous.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.desc: The Doctor continues his spatiotemporal journey, surrounded by Amy, his boyfriend Rory and the archaeologist River Song. The crew members of the Tardis are faced with a multitude of new enemies, including the Gangers, clones created by humans, the religious order of Silence and Hitler himself. But a terrible taraudic secret the Doctor's three companions, who cannot reveal to him the nature of it. Steven Moffat, who has been in charge of the series since the start of Russel T. Davies, has been putting his foot on this beautiful sixth season, but perhaps a bit disconcerting for fans.
programme.desc-more: Amy, Rory and the Doctor, still looking for Melody Pound, came back in their own time. But under the threat of Mels, a childhood friend of Amy and Rory pursued by the police, the team was forced to board the Tardis again. Mels uses his gun and damages the device. In 1938, the Tardis crashed in Berlin in Hitler's office, and was invaded by toxic smoke.

programme.title: The Lawkeepers League: New Generation
programme.desc: Driven and always under the supervision of the world's greatest superheroes, Robin, Aqualad, Kid Flash and Miss Martian are preparing to join the League of Justiceers until they realize that seniors actually have no intention of treating them as equals in their fight against crime. They then join forces to fight evil according to their own methods.
programme.desc-more: In a world where superheroes reign as masters, Robin (Khary Payton), Aqualad (Jesse McCartney), Kid Flash (Crispin Freeman) and Miss Martian (Danica McKellar) are preparing to prove themselves to the Justice League. Driven by iconic figures such as Batman and Superman, these young heroes aspire to join their mentors. However, they quickly discover that seniors do not intend to consider them equal in the fight against crime. Frustrated by this lack of recognition, they decide to take charge and act according to their own methods. Together, they face threats that threaten peace in the world, while learning to navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and responsibility. Together, they redefine what it means to be a hero in a universe where expectations are high and dangers ubiquitous.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In this new season of Rick and Morty, the two crazy heroes, Rick Sanchez (voice of Chris Parnell) and his grandson Morty Smith (voice of Spencer Grammer), are embarking on even more crazy and unpredictable interdimensional adventures. As they navigate through alternative realities, they find themselves face to face with Unity, a collective entity with ambiguous intentions, and Rick Prime, an alternative version of Rick whose motivations remain mysterious. During their journey, they must rescue aliens tragically transformed into spaghetti after their death, while trying to help a Water-T overcome by complex mathematical dilemmas. This season promises a gallery of colourful characters, with prestigious guest stars such as Hugh Jackman, Christina Hendricks, Ice-T and Liev Schreiber, who come to enrich this already extravagant universe. The stakes are higher than ever, while Rick and Morty face their own demons while exploring the limits of the imagination.
programme.desc-more: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, has reunited with his family after years of absence. His grandson Morty (Spencer Grammer), an anxious teenager, became his companion despite himself in extravagant and often perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through space and explore alternative realities, where they meet strange creatures and quirky situations that challenge logic. However, these getaways only add to the stress already present in Morty's life, both at home and at school. Family dynamics are also complicated by the presence of Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), who struggles with her own demons and her desire to please her father, while seeking to protect her son.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.desc: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Green Lantern: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: While Hal Jordan (voice of Christopher Meloni), a daring pilot, is training in a flight simulator, he is suddenly transported in an alien dimension. There he crossed the path of Albin Sur, a seriously wounded Green Lantern, who entrusted him with his ring, designating him as his successor. Hal, a man with deep doubts, faces a counsel of Guardians of the universe who wonder about his abilities. To help him master his new skills, they entrust his training to Sinestro (voice of Victor Garber), an ambitious and manipulatory Green Lantern. Sinestro, however, has secret ambitions and is considering creating a new galactic order under his control. While Hal learns how to handle the ring and embrace his hero destiny, he discovers conspiracies that threaten not only the Earth, but the balance of the entire universe. His determination to prove his worth will be tested in this struggle between good and evil.
