programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In the 99th district of New York, the morale of the troops was at the lowest, with the inhabitants losing all confidence in the police. Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher), determined to correct the situation, finds himself facing an eccentric and often disorganized team, composed of Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant but immature detective, Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), a formidable investigator, Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), a sergeant both muscular and sensitive, and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), a perfectionist with a great heart. While the team needs to rethink its investigative methods, the investigations are going to be a little bit of a problem. Jake, with his sense of humour and sometimes awe-inspiring ideas, offers unexpected solutions to revive team spirit. This sixth season, marked by a strong fan mobilization after the Fox canceled, promises thrilling intrigues and hilarious moments of camaraderie.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Millionaire Bruce Wayne borrowed the name of Batman to protect Gotham City from Joker, Penguin and other criminals, who are seeking to reveal the identity of the mysterious hero.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but deeply unstable scientist, has returned to his family after a long absence. His main accomplice is his grandson Morty Smith (Justin Roiland), a naive and anxious teenager, who finds himself trained in perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through unknown galaxies and alternative realities, encountering strange creatures and absurd situations that test their family ties. Meanwhile, Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), tries to maintain a semblance of normality in their chaotic home, while her father, Jerry (Chris Parnell), struggles with his own insecurities. These unbridled getaways exacerbate the stress already present in Morty's life, confronting him with moral dilemmas and unimaginable dangers. Through black humour and reflections on human nature, this series depicts a dysfunctional and endearing family dynamic.
programme.desc-more: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, has reunited with his family after years of absence. His grandson Morty (Spencer Grammer), an anxious teenager, became his companion despite himself in extravagant and often perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through space and explore alternative realities, where they meet strange creatures and quirky situations that challenge logic. However, these getaways only add to the stress already present in Morty's life, both at home and at school. Family dynamics are also complicated by the presence of Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), who struggles with her own demons and her desire to please her father, while seeking to protect her son.

programme.title: DC Team France
programme.desc: Will you survive the chaotic world of Joker? Join the DC Team France and explore the meandering of the disturbed spirit of this iconic enemy of Batman, known for sowing anarchy. Rediscover its obscure origins through the anecdotes, debates and quizzes of our columnists. Will you dance with the devil in the moonlight? Special guest: Carole Quintaine.
programme.desc-more: Along with the DC Team France, rediscover the life of Gotham's vigilante Bruce Wayne, the man behind Batman's mask. From its story origin through comics to recent film adaptations. The DC Team France gives you as much information as possible about the enemies and the legacy of this iconic vigilante. Special guest: Carole Quintaine.

programme.title: The Lawkeepers League: New Generation
programme.desc: In a world where superheroes reign as masters, Robin (Khary Payton), Aqualad (Jesse McCartney), Kid Flash (Crispin Freeman) and Miss Martian (Danica McKellar) are preparing to prove themselves to the Justice League. Driven by iconic figures such as Batman and Superman, these young heroes aspire to join their mentors. However, they quickly discover that seniors do not intend to consider them equal in the fight against crime. Frustrated by this lack of recognition, they decide to take charge and act according to their own methods. Together, they face threats that threaten peace in the world, while learning to navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and responsibility. Together, they redefine what it means to be a hero in a universe where expectations are high and dangers ubiquitous.
programme.desc-more: Under the supervision of the world's greatest superheroes, Robin (Jesse McCartney), Aqualad (Khary Payton), Kid Flash (Jason Spisak) and Miss Martian (Danica McKellar) have been trained since their childhood to become full heroes. As they prepare to join the prestigious Ligue des Justiciers, they quickly discover that their mentors do not intend to consider them equal in the fight against crime. Disappointed by the lack of recognition and opportunities offered to them, these young heroes decide to unite to face evil in their own way. By developing their own strategies and using their unique skills, they are embarking on a series of thrilling adventures that challenge their elders' methods. Through epic fighting and unexpected alliances, they will have to prove that they are worthy of being righteous, while facing threats that could endanger the entire world.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In this new season of Rick and Morty, the two crazy heroes, Rick Sanchez (voice of Chris Parnell) and his grandson Morty Smith (voice of Spencer Grammer), are embarking on even more crazy and unpredictable interdimensional adventures. As they navigate through alternative realities, they find themselves face to face with Unity, a collective entity with ambiguous intentions, and Rick Prime, an alternative version of Rick whose motivations remain mysterious. During their journey, they must rescue aliens tragically transformed into spaghetti after their death, while trying to help a Water-T overcome by complex mathematical dilemmas. This season promises a gallery of colourful characters, with prestigious guest stars such as Hugh Jackman, Christina Hendricks, Ice-T and Liev Schreiber, who come to enrich this already extravagant universe. The stakes are higher than ever, while Rick and Morty face their own demons while exploring the limits of the imagination.
programme.desc-more: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, has reunited with his family after years of absence. His grandson Morty (Spencer Grammer), an anxious teenager, became his companion despite himself in extravagant and often perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through space and explore alternative realities, where they meet strange creatures and quirky situations that challenge logic. However, these getaways only add to the stress already present in Morty's life, both at home and at school. Family dynamics are also complicated by the presence of Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), who struggles with her own demons and her desire to please her father, while seeking to protect her son.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny announces to Leonard that Justin, one of his guitarist and former lover friends, is coming to sleep at her house for a few days. He misrepresents the news and expresses his discontent. Penny and Leonard are fighting all the time. Sheldon feels very uncomfortable in this situation and thinks that their relationship is coming to an end...
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Green Lantern: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: While Hal Jordan (voice of Christopher Meloni), a daring pilot, is training in a flight simulator, he is suddenly transported in an alien dimension. There he crossed the path of Albin Sur, a seriously wounded Green Lantern, who entrusted him with his ring, designating him as his successor. Hal, a man with deep doubts, faces a counsel of Guardians of the universe who wonder about his abilities. To help him master his new skills, they entrust his training to Sinestro (voice of Victor Garber), an ambitious and manipulatory Green Lantern. Sinestro, however, has secret ambitions and is considering creating a new galactic order under his control. While Hal learns how to handle the ring and embrace his hero destiny, he discovers conspiracies that threaten not only the Earth, but the balance of the entire universe. His determination to prove his worth will be tested in this struggle between good and evil.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Jake, Holt and the whole team are trying to distract Terry, very stressed as he approaches his lieutenant exam. The 99 decides to move the great annual Halloween party to a new date, the Mexican Cinco Day of Mayo...
programme.desc-more: In the 99th district of New York, the morale of the troops was at the lowest, with the inhabitants losing all confidence in the police. Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher), determined to correct the situation, finds himself facing an eccentric and often disorganized team, composed of Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant but immature detective, Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), a formidable investigator, Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), a sergeant both muscular and sensitive, and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), a perfectionist with a great heart. While the team needs to rethink its investigative methods, the investigations are going to be a little bit of a problem. Jake, with his sense of humour and sometimes awe-inspiring ideas, offers unexpected solutions to revive team spirit. This sixth season, marked by a strong fan mobilization after the Fox canceled, promises thrilling intrigues and hilarious moments of camaraderie.

programme.desc-more: In the 99th district of New York, the morale of the troops was at the lowest, with the inhabitants losing all confidence in the police. Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher), determined to correct the situation, finds himself facing an eccentric and often disorganized team, composed of Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant but immature detective, Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), a formidable investigator, Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), a sergeant both muscular and sensitive, and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), a perfectionist with a great heart. While the team needs to rethink its investigative methods, the investigations are going to be a little bit of a problem. Jake, with his sense of humour and sometimes awe-inspiring ideas, offers unexpected solutions to revive team spirit. This sixth season, marked by a strong fan mobilization after the Fox canceled, promises thrilling intrigues and hilarious moments of camaraderie.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Millionaire Bruce Wayne borrowed the name of Batman to protect Gotham City from Joker, Penguin and other criminals, who are seeking to reveal the identity of the mysterious hero.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Reconquered by the new commissioner, Madeline Wuntch, Holt is forced to return to the field where he will have to team up with a new partner, Debbie Fogel. Jake, on the other hand, is going to take command of a real manhunt after the attempted assassination of a city councillor...
programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but deeply unstable scientist, has returned to his family after a long absence. His main accomplice is his grandson Morty Smith (Justin Roiland), a naive and anxious teenager, who finds himself trained in perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through unknown galaxies and alternative realities, encountering strange creatures and absurd situations that test their family ties. Meanwhile, Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), tries to maintain a semblance of normality in their chaotic home, while her father, Jerry (Chris Parnell), struggles with his own insecurities. These unbridled getaways exacerbate the stress already present in Morty's life, confronting him with moral dilemmas and unimaginable dangers. Through black humour and reflections on human nature, this series depicts a dysfunctional and endearing family dynamic.
programme.desc-more: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, has reunited with his family after years of absence. His grandson Morty (Spencer Grammer), an anxious teenager, became his companion despite himself in extravagant and often perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through space and explore alternative realities, where they meet strange creatures and quirky situations that challenge logic. However, these getaways only add to the stress already present in Morty's life, both at home and at school. Family dynamics are also complicated by the presence of Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), who struggles with her own demons and her desire to please her father, while seeking to protect her son.

programme.title: Snatch, you're gonna be a little bit of a go-go or you're gonna be a little bit of a go-go.
programme.desc: London. Franky, a malfrat, works for Avi, an American Jew. On his orders, he steals a huge diamond, but gets rid of the rock before he can hand it over to whom he can. Two criminals, the Turk and Tony, are starting to fight fake boxing.
programme.desc-more: At the heart of this joyful mess is Franky Quatre-Doigts (Benicio del Toro), a small malfrat as clumsy as it is unlucky, who works for Avi (Dennis Farina), a dreadful New York diamondmaker with fast-paced methods. When Avi gave him the mission of stealing a diamond of invaluable value, Franky believed he was holding on to his career. But it's not counting on his incredible talent to attract trouble: barely the jewel in his pocket, he makes him subtly chew it by a pickpocket, thus diving into a frantic race to find the precious rock before Avi makes him pay dearly for his incompetence. At the same time, two other grassy crooks, the Turk (Jason Statham) and Tony (Vinnie Jones), set up a ploy around fake boxing, with foal Mickey O-Neil (Brad Pitt), an unpredictable and charismatic gypsy. Problem: Mickey, far from playing the game, sends valdinguer his opponents with a disconcerting ease, sabotaged without wanting the bets carefully orchestrated by his employers. When Avi arrives in London, furious and determined to recover his diamond, the fates of these budding robbers cross in as explosive a way as they are unexpected. The diamond, meanwhile, resurfaces in the hands of Sol (Lennie James), a unscrupulous dealer, before disappearing again in circumstances to say the least... unusual.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: The animal protection brigade, a team led by Frank, is facing sometimes unusual situations, such as Shred, who is facing a weasel.
programme.desc-more: In an urban environment where wildlife often bursts, Shred (Joel McHale), an animal control officer, faces an unexpected challenge when he discovers a mischievous weasel hidden in the attic of a house. While he tries to capture this cute and malicious animal, he quickly realizes that the situation is more complex than he thought. Far from being a mere incident, this meeting triggered a series of unforeseen events that would test Shred's skills and sense of humour. Accompanied by his colleagues, including the dynamic Vella Lovell and the pragmatic Ravi Patel, he navigates through nasty situations and hilarious misunderstandings, while learning to manage the challenges of cohabitation between humans and animals. As this episode unfolds, the characters discover the importance of understanding and empathy towards urban wildlife, while embarking on an adventure that promises laughter and surprises.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: Frank runs an animal protection squad. If animals are easy to manage, humans are a problem, like that neighbor who has rabbits.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale), a well-dimmed animal control agent, finds himself facing an unexpected situation. A desperate local informs him that his adorable rabbits, known for their cute and harmless behavior, have targeted his precious chocolate bars, known for their secret and special recipe. By investigating this surprising phenomenon, Frank discovers that these rabbits are not just candy thieves, but they are also at the heart of a series of strange events in the neighbourhood. As he tries to unravel this messy situation, he finds himself being dragged into a series of hilarious and unpredictable misadventures, where animals seem to play a more important role than he imagined. Between the rabbit rebellion and the concerns of the inhabitants, Frank will have to show ingenuity and humour to restore order in his neighbourhood.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: The animal protection brigade, headed by eccentric Frank, is faced with a wandering puma and people who are not easy to manage.
programme.desc-more: Animal Control's team is on alert after a stray puma has been reported in a residential area. The passionate veterinarian, Frank (Joel McHale), and his team, composed of the hustle and clumsy, Tom (Michael Rowland), as well as the pragmatic and determined Emily (Vella Lovell), are preparing for a delicate intervention. As they try to locate the animal, internal tensions are beginning to emerge within the team, exacerbated by differences in methods and approaches to this unforeseen situation. Meanwhile, the puma, frightened and disoriented, ventures closer and closer to the homes, causing panic among residents. The team must not only manage the capture of this wild animal, but also restore trust and communication among its members. As the situation gets complicated, they realize that their work requires not only animal control skills but also harmonious cooperation and mutual understanding.

programme.desc: Suspecting that the Virginia population has joined a sect, President Andre Curtis called Rick and asked him to accompany him to the scene to investigate. The President also wanted Helen Wong, her therapist, to be present. When they arrive, the three acolytes discover that the whole state fell under Unity's control...
programme.desc-more: In this new season of Rick and Morty, the two crazy heroes, Rick Sanchez (voice of Chris Parnell) and his grandson Morty Smith (voice of Spencer Grammer), are embarking on even more crazy and unpredictable interdimensional adventures. As they navigate through alternative realities, they find themselves face to face with Unity, a collective entity with ambiguous intentions, and Rick Prime, an alternative version of Rick whose motivations remain mysterious. During their journey, they must rescue aliens tragically transformed into spaghetti after their death, while trying to help a Water-T overcome by complex mathematical dilemmas. This season promises a gallery of colourful characters, with prestigious guest stars such as Hugh Jackman, Christina Hendricks, Ice-T and Liev Schreiber, who come to enrich this already extravagant universe. The stakes are higher than ever, while Rick and Morty face their own demons while exploring the limits of the imagination.

programme.title: Krapopolis
programme.desc: Tyrannis and his family go to the Forest Festival. At the party, he is seduced by Daphne, a nymph of the woods. Usually boring at parties, it is completely carried away by the atmosphere and thus convokes Dionysos. Schlub and Deliria explore their free relationship at this party.
programme.desc-more: In a mythological world filled with fantastic gods and creatures, Tyrannis (Richard Ayoade) is preparing to experience an unexpected experience at the Forest Festival. Accompanied by his family, he expects an ordinary celebration, but he is quickly captivated by Daphne, a nymph of wood with enchanting charm. While he is being carried away by the festive atmosphere, Tyrannis summons Dionysos, the god of wine and party, which leads to a series of unpredictable and hilarious events. Meanwhile, his friends Schlub (Matt Berry) and Deliria (Pam Murphy) explore their free relationship, adding a touch of madness to the party. As the interactions progress, the characters must navigate between the love intrigues, family rivalries and the whims of the gods, while discovering the true meaning of celebration and community. The adventures of Tyrannis and his companions promise humor and emotions in a mythical setting.

programme.title: Krapopolis
programme.desc: Tyrannis begins to date the goddess Demeter, but Deliria gets involved; Phénomèna and Hippocampus go to Hades to visit Prack the unstoppable.
programme.desc-more: In a mythological world where gods and mortals coexist, Tyrannis, a hero with undeniable charm, begins a tumultuous romance with the goddess Demeter (Hannah Waddingham), the personification of agriculture and fertility. However, their idyllic is quickly being undermined by Deliria, a capricious and manipulative entity, who does not hesitate to sow chaos in their relationship. Meanwhile, two other characters, Phénomèna and Hippocampus, decided to go to Hell for an unusual visit. They seek to meet Prack the unstoppable, a mythical figure whose power is feared and respected throughout the kingdom of the dead. As Tyrannis struggles to keep his love in the face of the machinations of Deliria, Phénomèna and Hippocampus find themselves dragged into a perilous adventure that could well upset the balance of forces between gods and men. This mixture of humour, drama and mythology promises an exciting exploration of the complex relationships within this modern pantheon.

programme.title: Krapopolis
programme.sub-title: Between the hippo and the anvil
programme.desc: As Hippocampus is often discriminated against because of his appearance, Tyrannis takes him to a technological convention, where his intellect is appreciated to its full value.
programme.desc-more: In a world where mythological creatures coexist with humans, Hippocampus, a young anthropomorphic seahorse, often feels rejected because of its atypical appearance. Unfortunately, society's prejudices isolate it and prevent it from realizing its potential. His loyal friend, Tyrannis (Richard Ayoade), a tyrannosaur full of charm and assurance, decides to take charge of things. He takes Hippocampus to an innovative technological convention, an event where creative minds gather to share their ideas and inventions. During this memorable day, Hippocampus discovers an environment where his intelligence and creativity are finally recognized and celebrated. This experience opens his eyes to his unique abilities and encourages him to embrace who he really is. Along the way, they will meet colorful characters such as brilliant inventor Gilda (Hannah Waddingham) and charismatic entrepreneur Glim (Steve Buscemi), who will help shape their adventure.

programme.title: Krapopolis
programme.desc: Tyrannis is faced with a dilemma when a citizen is driven out of a tavern for wearing a new garment: pants. Deliria is sowing the mess in the secret quest of Phenomena before having to face a titan. Hippocampus, on the other hand, teamed up with a nymph of the forest.
programme.desc-more: In the mythical city of Tyrannis, the daily lives of the inhabitants are upset when a citizen is expelled from a tavern for daring to wear trousers, an act considered scandalous. Tyrannis, the city leader, finds himself facing a moral dilemma, which must choose between respect for traditions and the defence of individual rights. Meanwhile, Deliria, a mischievous figure, causes chaos in her secret quest for Phenomena, a mysterious entity whose intentions remain unclear. As she plunges into increasingly tumultuous adventures, she will have to face a formidable titan, thus testing her bravery and determination. Hippocampus, an adventurous character, joins with a nymph of the forest, engaging in a quest that will lead them to explore the depths of their mythological world. Together, they will have to navigate through unexpected trials and surprising revelations, while juggling the challenges of the tyrannical society around them.

programme.title: Krapopolis
programme.desc: After a spell cast by the witch of his late grandfather, Tyrannis has a scorpion tail when he wakes up and becomes like his elder by making reign terror around him. Schlub will do everything to get his son back to his true personality. Hippocampus and Phénomèna disobey their parents and free their pegasus, which will lead them into a bloody adventure.
programme.desc-more: In a world where Greek mythology blends with contemporary humour, Tyrannis (Richard Ayoade), a young prince with tragic destiny, wakes up one morning with a scorpion tail, an unexpected legacy of his late grandfather, a dreaded sorcerer. This physical change gives him a terrifying aura, pushing him to make fear reign over his kingdom. However, his father, Schlub (Matt Berry), refused to let his son sink into this new personality and undertook a desperate quest to help him find his true self. At the same time, Hippocampus and Phénomèna, two intrepid teenagers, decided to brave parental authority and to release a mythical pegasus, triggering a series of chaotic and bloody events. Their rebellion leads them into a perilous adventure, where they will have to face legendary creatures and dark forces, while discovering the true essence of friendship and courage.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: As the Earth is on the brink of extinction, a final battle is being fought between humans and the dreadful Esphenis aliens. Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, returns from a mysterious captivity aboard an alien ship, more determined than ever to defend his species. Upon his return, he discovered that the situation had changed considerably, as the alien forces had taken control of several regions. In parallel, the 2nd Massachusetts Regiment, led by charismatic Weaver (Will Patton), is organizing to conduct a desperate offensive to release prisoners held in the alien ghettos. Meanwhile, young fighters, like Ben Mason (Drew Roy) and Matt Mason (Maxim Knight), must navigate through the confusion and fear that reign among the survivors. In this exciting season of Falling Skies, the stakes are higher than ever, and every decision could change the fate of humanity.
programme.desc-more: In a world devastated by an alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Within a few days, infrastructure was destroyed and 90% of the human population disappeared, leaving survivors in a desperate struggle for their survival. In Boston, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a history teacher, finds himself alongside his sons in this fierce struggle against the invaders. While the alien forces capture and enslave the still alive teenagers, Mason becomes the leader of a group of resistors determined to regain their planet. Together, they try to decipher the motivations and strategies of these hostile creatures. By exploring family dynamics and human resilience to adversity, "Falling Skies" plunges spectators into an odyssey of survival, hope and sacrifice, while questioning the very nature of humanity in the face of the unknown.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the ball in the blind spot

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, just emerged from a detoxification cure, determined to regain control of her chaotic life. As she tries to rebuild her daily life, her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic whose she has not heard from in years, is resurfaced with the intention of getting closer to her daughter. This unexpected intrusion complicates the situation, for Bonnie, with her often immature attitude and inappropriate moral lessons, does not facilitate Christy's task. At the same time, Christy's life is also disturbed by the challenges associated with her teenage daughter, Violet (Sadie Calvano), who is facing her own rebellions and trials. By juggling her work as a waitress with family tumults, Christy discovers that the road to redemption and mutual understanding is strewn with pitfalls, but it is also full of moments of tenderness and unexpected laughter.

programme.title: Scrubs
programme.desc: Two medical students, and also roommates, JD Dorian and Christopher Turk, began their boarding school at the Sacred Heart Hospital. Turk is sensitive to the charm of the energetic chief nurse, Carla Espinosa, while JD would gladly fall for another freshly arrived intern, Elliot Reid. JD has a difficult relationship with Dr. Cox, whose arrogance is equal only to the competence, and even more so with the concierge, who becomes his sworn enemy. Between humour and gravity, a collection of characters and situations that have been staggered in the hospital universe. From his first season, "Scrubs" pulled his pin from the game and was able to win.
programme.desc-more: In the frantic and often comic world of the Sacred Heart Hospital, young intern Elliot Reid (Sarah Chalke) is convinced that she has identified the voice of Dr. Bob Kelso (Ken Jenkins) singing "Tuscaloosa Heart" on a tape left by a patient. Convinced that this discovery could reveal a hidden aspect of Dr. Kelso's personality, she embarked on a humorous and touching investigation, bringing her friends and colleagues into her quest. J.D. (Zach Braff), his best friend and an intern often in the midst of his own emotional dilemmas, finds himself juggling his support for Elliot with his own love complications. Meanwhile, Turk (Donald Faison), his inseparable friend, tries to find a balance between his professional life and his relationship with Carla (Judy Reyes). Through the baffling situations and moments of sincere camaraderie, the characters navigate the challenges of hospital life while exploring their own identities.

JD has a difficult relationship with Dr. Cox, whose arrogance is equal only to the competence, and even more so with the concierge, who becomes his sworn enemy. Between humour and gravity, a collection of characters and situations that have been staggered in the hospital universe. From his first season, "Scrubs" pulled his pin from the game and was able to win.
programme.desc-more: In the frantic and often comic world of the Sacred Heart Hospital, young intern Elliot Reid (Sarah Chalke) is convinced that she has identified the voice of Dr. Bob Kelso (Ken Jenkins) singing "Tuscaloosa Heart" on a tape left by a patient. Convinced that this discovery could reveal a hidden aspect of Dr. Kelso's personality, she embarked on a humorous and touching investigation, bringing her friends and colleagues into her quest. J.D. (Zach Braff), his best friend and an intern often in the midst of his own emotional dilemmas, finds himself juggling his support for Elliot with his own love complications. Meanwhile, Turk (Donald Faison), his inseparable friend, tries to find a balance between his professional life and his relationship with Carla (Judy Reyes). Through the baffling situations and moments of sincere camaraderie, the characters navigate the challenges of hospital life while exploring their own identities.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 2 of the Superstore series
programme.desc-more: In the suburbs of Saint-Louis, the Cloud 9 supermarket is the scene of the colourful daily life of its employees. Amy (America Ferrera), a clever saleswoman, juggles her professional responsibilities with her personal life, while navigating in the often hilarious dynamics of her colleagues. At his side, Dina (Lauren Ash), the manager's assistant, imposes an authoritarian management style that leaves no room for challenge. Garrett (Colton Dunn), a paraplegic and micro ad person, brings a unique perspective on the world of work, while Cheyenne (Nichole Bloom), a naive teenager, brings a dose of innocence and enthusiasm to the team. Through the daily drama and bumpy situations, the series explores the challenges of modern working life and consumer culture, offering a satirical and touching look at human relations and solidarity in a often chaotic working environment.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In the 99th district of New York, the morale of the troops was at the lowest, with the inhabitants losing all confidence in the police. Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher), determined to correct the situation, finds himself facing an eccentric and often disorganized team, composed of Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant but immature detective, Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), a formidable investigator, Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), a sergeant both muscular and sensitive, and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), a perfectionist with a great heart. While the team needs to rethink its investigative methods, the investigations are going to be a little bit of a problem. Jake, with his sense of humour and sometimes awe-inspiring ideas, offers unexpected solutions to revive team spirit. This sixth season, marked by a strong fan mobilization after the Fox canceled, promises thrilling intrigues and hilarious moments of camaraderie.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: The Lawkeepers League: New Generation
programme.desc: In a world where superheroes reign as masters, Robin (Khary Payton), Aqualad (Jesse McCartney), Kid Flash (Crispin Freeman) and Miss Martian (Danica McKellar) are preparing to prove themselves to the Justice League. Driven by iconic figures such as Batman and Superman, these young heroes aspire to join their mentors. However, they quickly discover that seniors do not intend to consider them equal in the fight against crime. Frustrated by this lack of recognition, they decide to take charge and act according to their own methods. Together, they face threats that threaten peace in the world, while learning to navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and responsibility. Together, they redefine what it means to be a hero in a universe where expectations are high and dangers ubiquitous.
programme.desc-more: Under the supervision of the world's greatest superheroes, Robin (Jesse McCartney), Aqualad (Khary Payton), Kid Flash (Jason Spisak) and Miss Martian (Danica McKellar) have been trained since their childhood to become full heroes. As they prepare to join the prestigious Ligue des Justiciers, they quickly discover that their mentors do not intend to consider them equal in the fight against crime. Disappointed by the lack of recognition and opportunities offered to them, these young heroes decide to unite to face evil in their own way. By developing their own strategies and using their unique skills, they are embarking on a series of thrilling adventures that challenge their elders' methods. Through epic fighting and unexpected alliances, they will have to prove that they are worthy of being righteous, while facing threats that could endanger the entire world.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, returns to his family after years of absence. By training his grandson Morty (Justin Roiland) in interdimensional adventures, Rick exposes him to strange and often dangerous worlds. These journeys, which range from journeys to distant galaxies to encounters with exotic creatures, are also learning opportunities for Morty, but they also come with their lot of chaos and risks. While Morty juggles his family responsibilities with his school obligations, Rick's adventures disrupt his daily life, leading to increasing tension within the family. Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), struggles to maintain a semblance of normality, while her father, Jerry (Chris Parnell), struggles with his own insecurities. Through stories of absurdity and satire, the series explores family ties and the consequences of each person's choices.
programme.desc-more: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, has reunited with his family after years of absence. His grandson Morty (Spencer Grammer), an anxious teenager, became his companion despite himself in extravagant and often perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through space and explore alternative realities, where they meet strange creatures and quirky situations that challenge logic. However, these getaways only add to the stress already present in Morty's life, both at home and at school. Family dynamics are also complicated by the presence of Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), who struggles with her own demons and her desire to please her father, while seeking to protect her son.

programme.desc: New absurd missions and delusional and unpredictable adventures await Rick, the scientific cynical, always accompanied by Morty, often overwhelmed by the turn of events. programme.desc-more: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, has reunited with his family after years of absence. His grandson Morty (Spencer Grammer), an anxious teenager, became his companion despite himself in extravagant and often perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through space and explore alternative realities, where they meet strange creatures and quirky situations that challenge logic. However, these getaways only add to the stress already present in Morty's life, both at home and at school. Family dynamics are also complicated by the presence of Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), who struggles with her own demons and her desire to please her father, while seeking to protect her son.

programme.title: Green Lantern : Beware My Power
programme.desc: John Stewart (J.J. Abrams), a former Marine Corps sniper, found himself propelled into a galactic universe when he entered into possession of an alien ring that gave him the power to become a Green Lantern of the Earth. As he learns to master these new abilities, he quickly realizes that his world is at risk. Sinestro, an ancient Green Lantern who became a powerful opponent, leads a horde of interplanetary killers determined to eradicate all ring-bearers. To face this growing threat, John must join iconic heroes such as Green Arrow (Justin Hartley), an outstanding archer, Hawkgirl (Katrina Law), a formidable warrior, and Adam Strange (Ciarán Hinds), an intergalactic adventurer. Together, they embark on a bold mission through the stars, engaging in a brilliant war between the planets Rann and Thanagar, while fighting for the survival of the universe and their own lives.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In this new season of Rick and Morty, the two crazy heroes, Rick Sanchez (voice of Chris Parnell) and his grandson Morty Smith (voice of Spencer Grammer), are embarking on even more crazy and unpredictable interdimensional adventures. As they navigate through alternative realities, they find themselves face to face with Unity, a collective entity with ambiguous intentions, and Rick Prime, an alternative version of Rick whose motivations remain mysterious. During their journey, they must rescue aliens tragically transformed into spaghetti after their death, while trying to help a Water-T overcome by complex mathematical dilemmas. This season promises a gallery of colourful characters, with prestigious guest stars such as Hugh Jackman, Christina Hendricks, Ice-T and Liev Schreiber, who come to enrich this already extravagant universe. The stakes are higher than ever, while Rick and Morty face their own demons while exploring the limits of the imagination.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In a secluded villa in the heart of the Moroccan desert, fourteen iconic television personalities gather to participate in an unprecedented season of "The Power!". This intense strategy game features experienced competitors, ready to do anything to win. Every week, a Power Player is designated, becoming the absolute master of the game, with the power to manipulate, control and eliminate another player. This season, tension is rising by a step: the Power Player can now designate two targets, increasing suspense and fragile alliances between participants. Delta, the game's instigator, also introduces an element of rebellion, allowing unelected players to thwart their opponent's plans. Over the weeks, strategies are emerging, alliances are formed and broken, while each one tries to navigate through manipulations and the theater shots. Who will succeed in taking power and surviving in this fierce struggle?

programme.title: Common Side Effects
programme.desc: Marshall and Frances, former laboratory partners in high school, are beginning to unravel a conspiracy involving the major pharmaceutical companies and the federal government to remove the knowledge of a rare fungus that could be the key to the healing of all the diseases in the world.
programme.desc-more: In a world where science and magic intertwine, "Common Side Effects" plunges us into the intriguing adventure of Marshall (Dave King) and Frances (Emily Pendergast), two friends inseparable from complementary personalities. As they lead an ordinary life, their daily lives turn around when they discover an insidious plot to destroy a legendary mushroom, known for its miraculous properties capable of curing all the diseases of the world. In the face of this threat, Marshall and Frances find themselves on a thrilling quest that drives them to explore unexplored areas and meet colorful characters, ranging from eccentric scientists to secret agents with obscure motivations. Their determination to protect this precious resource will lead them into a whirlwind of unexpected events, where each decision can have far-reaching consequences. As they sink into the meanderings of this plot, our heroes will have to be ingenuity and courage to overcome unforeseen obstacles while navigating a world where alliances can change at any time. "Common Side Effects" is a series of exciting animations, mixing humour, suspense and reflection on the ethical issues of modern medicine.

programme.title: The Lawkeepers League: New Generation
programme.desc: In a world where superheroes reign as masters, Robin (Khary Payton), Aqualad (Jesse McCartney), Kid Flash (Crispin Freeman) and Miss Martian (Danica McKellar) are preparing to prove themselves to the Justice League. Driven by iconic figures such as Batman and Superman, these young heroes aspire to join their mentors. However, they quickly discover that seniors do not intend to consider them equal in the fight against crime. Frustrated by this lack of recognition, they decide to take charge and act according to their own methods. Together, they face threats that threaten peace in the world, while learning to navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and responsibility. Together, they redefine what it means to be a hero in a universe where expectations are high and dangers ubiquitous.
programme.desc-more: Under the supervision of the world's greatest superheroes, Robin (Jesse McCartney), Aqualad (Khary Payton), Kid Flash (Jason Spisak) and Miss Martian (Danica McKellar) have been trained since their childhood to become full heroes. As they prepare to join the prestigious Ligue des Justiciers, they quickly discover that their mentors do not intend to consider them equal in the fight against crime. Disappointed by the lack of recognition and opportunities offered to them, these young heroes decide to unite to face evil in their own way. By developing their own strategies and using their unique skills, they are embarking on a series of thrilling adventures that challenge their elders' methods. Through epic fighting and unexpected alliances, they will have to prove that they are worthy of being righteous, while facing threats that could endanger the entire world.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In this new season of Rick and Morty, the two crazy heroes, Rick Sanchez (voice of Chris Parnell) and his grandson Morty Smith (voice of Spencer Grammer), are embarking on even more crazy and unpredictable interdimensional adventures. As they navigate through alternative realities, they find themselves face to face with Unity, a collective entity with ambiguous intentions, and Rick Prime, an alternative version of Rick whose motivations remain mysterious. During their journey, they must rescue aliens tragically transformed into spaghetti after their death, while trying to help a Water-T overcome by complex mathematical dilemmas. This season promises a gallery of colourful characters, with prestigious guest stars such as Hugh Jackman, Christina Hendricks, Ice-T and Liev Schreiber, who come to enrich this already extravagant universe. The stakes are higher than ever, while Rick and Morty face their own demons while exploring the limits of the imagination.
programme.desc-more: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but unstable scientist, has reunited with his family after years of absence. His grandson Morty (Spencer Grammer), an anxious teenager, became his companion despite himself in extravagant and often perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through space and explore alternative realities, where they meet strange creatures and quirky situations that challenge logic. However, these getaways only add to the stress already present in Morty's life, both at home and at school. Family dynamics are also complicated by the presence of Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), who struggles with her own demons and her desire to please her father, while seeking to protect her son.

programme.desc: While the planet Oa, from where the famous Green Lantern troupe originates, is threatened by an ancient evil force, Hal Jordan (voice of Joshua Duhamel) is entrusted with the task of forming a new recruit, Arisia (voice of Elizabeth Moss). In a context of growing tension, Hal takes the time to share with her the stories of her early days as Green Lantern and the challenges he and his comrades faced. Through his stories, Arisia discovers the heroism, sacrifice and camaraderie that unite members of the Green Lantern Corps. Both heroes must navigate between the trials of the past and the imminent dangers, while striving to protect the universe from this growing threat. As this training progresses, Arisia will learn not only to master her powers, but also to understand the true essence of the courage and responsibility of a Green Lantern.

programme.title: Batman: Attack on Arkham
programme.desc: In a Gotham plunged into chaos, the government formed the Suicide Squad, a heteroclite team of super-villains carrying out a perilous mission: infiltrating Arkham's asylum to recover crucial information stolen by the Sphinx. Driven by Amanda Waller, these anti-hero men, including Deadshot (Will Smith) and Harley Quinn (Margot Robbie), are quickly finding themselves in a spiral of violence and betrayal. While Batman (Kevin Conroy) joined them in countering the machinations of the Joker (Troy Baker), tensions rose when one of the Squad members freed the clown prince from the crime. With bombs hidden through Arkham and Gotham, the Joker threatens to plunge the city into disaster. The allies of one day must navigate in a maze of doubtful loyalty and deadly confrontations, while time is running out and the destiny of the city is at stake.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland), a brilliant but deeply unstable scientist, has returned to his family after a long absence. His main accomplice is his grandson Morty Smith (Justin Roiland), a naive and anxious teenager, who finds himself trained in perilous interdimensional adventures. Together, they travel through unknown galaxies and alternative realities, encountering strange creatures and absurd situations that test their family ties. Meanwhile, Morty's mother, Beth (Sarah Chalke), tries to maintain a semblance of normality in their chaotic home, while her father, Jerry (Chris Parnell), struggles with his own insecurities. These unbridled getaways exacerbate the stress already present in Morty's life, confronting him with moral dilemmas and unimaginable dangers. Through black humour and reflections on human nature, this series depicts a dysfunctional and endearing family dynamic.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In this explosive episode of the series, Morty (Justin Roiland) finds himself at the origin of an unexpected escalation of tensions between his grandfather Rick (Justin Roiland) and the king of the ocean, a dreadful entity that reigns over the depths of the sea. While Morty hoped to spend a romantic moment with Jessica (Spencer Grammer), he quickly found himself caught up in a titanium conflict that threatened not only his appointment, but also the balance between the aquatic and terrestrial worlds. Rick, always quick to use his wild inventions, must navigate between the anger of the marine creatures and the whims of his grandson, while trying to save the situation. The stakes are growing as both opponents prepare their armies, and Morty has to face responsibility for his actions. This episode promises hilarious twists and moments of tension, while exploring the tumultuous family relationships that define this cult series.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.sub-title: My doubles, my Morty and me.
programme.desc: In a world where science and absurdity meet, Rick Sanchez's family (Justin Roiland) faces a new unexpected threat: killer squid attacks on their home. As the situation becomes more and more chaotic, Morty (Justin Roiland) and his sister Summer (Spencer Grammer) are plunged into a whirlwind of unpredictable events. To escape this threat, Rick implements his eccentric inventions, but he quickly discovers that the situation is much more complex than it seems. By trying to protect his family, they eventually discover the existence of their own lures, versions of themselves created to help them in perilous situations. This revelation confronts them with existential questions about their identity and value, while leading them into a series of hilarious and unexpected twists. Between black humour and deep reflections, this episode explores the limits of family and reality.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the animated series "Rick et Morty", Morty (Justin Roiland) falls under the charm of Planetina, an eco-friendly superhero who struggles for the protection of the environment. Their intense encounter triggers a passionate romance, plunged Morty into a whirlwind of emotions while leading him to question his own values and choices. Meanwhile, Rick (Justin Roiland) and Summer (Spencer Grammer) decided to escape into the vastness of space to celebrate, seeking to escape the complexities of their earthly life. Their escape leads them into a rock-like and unpredictable situation, testing their fraternal relationship. While Morty explores the implications of her love for Planetina, Rick and Summer face unexpected challenges. This episode is a brilliant example of the themes of love, ecology and family relations, while maintaining the off-beat humour and absurdity that characterize the series.

programme.title: Rick and Morty
programme.desc: In this explosive episode of "Rick and Morty", Rick Sanchez (Justin Roiland) is struggling with the consequences of a failed experience that leads to the creation of grotesque monsters. These creatures, coming from a desperate attempt to push the limits of science, begin to threaten national security, plunge the country into chaos. Morty (Justin Roiland), his grandson, finds himself on an absurd and unexpected adventure, trying to manage the situation while trying to understand his grandfather's motivations. Between encounters with quirky characters and unexpected twists, the episode highlights the tumultuous relationships between Rick and Morty, while exploring themes of responsibility and consequences. As monsters multiply, Rick will face his mistakes and how they affect those around him, while maintaining his black humour and subversive spirit.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: As the Earth is on the brink of extinction, a final battle is being fought between humans and the dreadful Esphenis aliens. Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, returns from a mysterious captivity aboard an alien ship, more determined than ever to defend his species. Upon his return, he discovered that the situation had changed considerably, as the alien forces had taken control of several regions. In parallel, the 2nd Massachusetts Regiment, led by charismatic Weaver (Will Patton), is organizing to conduct a desperate offensive to release prisoners held in the alien ghettos. Meanwhile, young fighters, like Ben Mason (Drew Roy) and Matt Mason (Maxim Knight), must navigate through the confusion and fear that reign among the survivors. In this exciting season of Falling Skies, the stakes are higher than ever, and every decision could change the fate of humanity.
programme.desc-more: In a world devastated by an alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Within a few days, infrastructure was destroyed and 90% of the human population disappeared, leaving survivors in a desperate struggle for their survival. In Boston, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a history teacher, finds himself alongside his sons in this fierce struggle against the invaders. While the alien forces capture and enslave the still alive teenagers, Mason becomes the leader of a group of resistors determined to regain their planet. Together, they try to decipher the motivations and strategies of these hostile creatures. By exploring family dynamics and human resilience to adversity, "Falling Skies" plunges spectators into an odyssey of survival, hope and sacrifice, while questioning the very nature of humanity in the face of the unknown.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: As the Earth is on the brink of extinction, a final battle is being fought between humans and the dreadful Esphenis aliens. Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, returns from a mysterious captivity aboard an alien ship, more determined than ever to defend his species. Upon his return, he discovered that the situation had changed considerably, as the alien forces had taken control of several regions. In parallel, the 2nd Massachusetts Regiment, led by charismatic Weaver (Will Patton), is organizing to conduct a desperate offensive to release prisoners held in the alien ghettos. Meanwhile, young fighters, like Ben Mason (Drew Roy) and Matt Mason (Maxim Knight), must navigate through the confusion and fear that reign among the survivors. In this exciting season of Falling Skies, the stakes are higher than ever, and every decision could change the fate of humanity.
programme.desc-more: In a world devastated by an alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Within a few days, infrastructure was destroyed and 90% of the human population disappeared, leaving survivors in a desperate struggle for their survival. By exploring family dynamics and human resilience to adversity, "Falling Skies" plunges spectators into an odyssey of survival, hope and sacrifice, while questioning the very nature of humanity in the face of the unknown.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the ball in the blind spot

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, just emerged from a detoxification cure, determined to regain control of her chaotic life. As she tries to rebuild her daily life, her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic whose she has not heard from in years, is resurfaced with the intention of getting closer to her daughter. This unexpected intrusion complicates the situation, for Bonnie, with her often immature attitude and inappropriate moral lessons, does not facilitate Christy's task. At the same time, Christy's life is also disturbed by the challenges associated with her teenage daughter, Violet (Sadie Calvano), who is facing her own rebellions and trials. By juggling her work as a waitress with family tumults, Christy discovers that the road to redemption and mutual understanding is strewn with pitfalls, but it is also full of moments of tenderness and unexpected laughter.

programme.title: Scrubs
programme.desc: Two medical students, and also roommates, JD Dorian and Christopher Turk, began their boarding school at the Sacred Heart Hospital. Turk is sensitive to the charm of the energetic chief nurse, Carla Espinosa, while JD would gladly fall for another freshly arrived intern, Elliot Reid. JD has a difficult relationship with Dr. Cox, whose arrogance is equal only to the competence, and even more so with the concierge, who becomes his sworn enemy. Between humour and gravity, a collection of characters and situations that have been staggered in the hospital universe. From his first season, "Scrubs" pulled his pin from the game and was able to win.
programme.desc-more: In the frantic and often comic world of the Sacred Heart Hospital, young intern Elliot Reid (Sarah Chalke) is convinced that she has identified the voice of Dr. Bob Kelso (Ken Jenkins) singing "Tuscaloosa Heart" on a tape left by a patient. Convinced that this discovery could reveal a hidden aspect of Dr. Kelso's personality, she embarked on a humorous and touching investigation, bringing her friends and colleagues into her quest. J.D. (Zach Braff), his best friend and an intern often in the midst of his own emotional dilemmas, finds himself juggling his support for Elliot with his own love complications. Meanwhile, Turk (Donald Faison), his inseparable friend, tries to find a balance between his professional life and his relationship with Carla (Judy Reyes). Through the baffling situations and moments of sincere camaraderie, the characters navigate the challenges of hospital life while exploring their own identities.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 2 of the Superstore series
programme.desc-more: In the suburbs of Saint-Louis, the Cloud 9 supermarket is the scene of the colourful daily life of its employees. Amy (America Ferrera), a clever saleswoman, juggles her professional responsibilities with her personal life, while navigating in the often hilarious dynamics of her colleagues. At his side, Dina (Lauren Ash), the manager's assistant, imposes an authoritarian management style that leaves no room for challenge. Garrett (Colton Dunn), a paraplegic and micro ad person, brings a unique perspective on the world of work, while Cheyenne (Nichole Bloom), a naive teenager, brings a dose of innocence and enthusiasm to the team. programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In the 99th district of New York, the morale of the troops was at the lowest, with the inhabitants losing all confidence in the police. Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher), determined to correct the situation, finds himself facing an eccentric and often disorganized team, composed of Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant but immature detective, Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), a formidable investigator, Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), a sergeant both muscular and sensitive, and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), a perfectionist with a great heart. While the team needs to rethink its investigative methods, the investigations are going to be a little bit of a problem. Jake, with his sense of humour and sometimes awe-inspiring ideas, offers unexpected solutions to revive team spirit. This sixth season, marked by a strong fan mobilization after the Fox canceled, promises thrilling intrigues and hilarious moments of camaraderie.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Star Trek: first contact
programme.desc: The Borg, half-organic, half-synthetic creatures, invade the Federation. Their ship is heading towards Earth. Starfleet is wary of Captain Picard, because he was captured in the past by the Borg. The Enterprise must stay away from the fighting. But Picard decided to take a Borg ship by pursuit. He manages to destroy it and hunts down a shuttle that escaped... to return to the past.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: Sheldon goes back to high school
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Wild Cards
programme.sub-title: The good, the brute, and the scumbag
programme.desc: Max and Ellis, two experienced investigators, find themselves facing an intriguing mystery when they are called on an isolated ranch, where an attempted murder was perpetrated against a high-value stallion. By exploring the site, they quickly discover that behind this attack are deeply buried family secrets, linked to the turbulent history of the ranch and its owners. As they interrogate family members and employees, Max (Vanessa Morgan) and Ellis (Giacomo Gianniotti) are sinking into a maze of intrigues and rivalries, revealing old tensions that threaten to explode. Each clue brings them closer to a disturbing truth, but also to unexpected dangers. Investigators must navigate through lies and unsaid, while protecting themselves from the dark forces that want to prevent the light from being made on this tragedy. The investigation will lead them to redefine family ties and confront their own demons.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: America Ferrera and Ben Feldman are in a comedy (produced by the producer of "The Office") in which they are part of a family of employees of a hypermarket. Whether they are small new with sparkling eyes, old ones who have already seen everything, summer trainees or career managers, together, they face the flood of discount hunters every day with humour, face the riots of shock sales and try to survive the bearded professional training.
programme.desc-more: In the suburbs of Saint-Louis, the Cloud 9 supermarket is the scene of the colourful daily life of its employees. Amy (America Ferrera), a clever saleswoman, juggles her professional responsibilities with her personal life, while navigating in the often hilarious dynamics of her colleagues. At his side, Dina (Lauren Ash), the manager's assistant, imposes an authoritarian management style that leaves no room for challenge. Garrett (Colton Dunn), a paraplegic and micro ad person, brings a unique perspective on the world of work, while Cheyenne (Nichole Bloom), a naive teenager, brings a dose of innocence and enthusiasm to the team. Through the daily drama and bumpy situations, the series explores the challenges of modern working life and consumer culture, offering a satirical and touching look at human relations and solidarity in a often chaotic working environment.
