programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: In the suburbs of Saint Louis, Cloud 9 is a large surface where you can find everything. The store is run by Glenn, a fundamentally nice, assisted by Dina, a gun enthusiast. Two new employees, Jonah Simms and Mateo Fernando, discover the workings of this company, alongside their colleagues. Amy has been employed for several years, and she has no illusions about her situation, which leaves her melancholy. This comedy, which is more profound than it seems, is quickly becoming popular, and is carried by a casting in tune, with America Ferrera, revealed by the series "Ugly Betty".

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Time has passed since Jake and Rosa were sentenced to prison terms. The two police officers did not escape the sentence and slowly get used to their prisoner status, while at the police station, they are being worked on to clear them. But to do this, Amy and Charles will have to find Melanie Hawkins first. And will Amy Santiago realize her dream and finally move to sergeant? Unconditionals can rejoice: an unexpected season 5 is offered to them, and none of the main characters miss the call.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In the 99th district of New York, the morale of the troops was at the lowest, with the inhabitants losing all confidence in the police. Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher), determined to correct the situation, finds himself facing an eccentric and often disorganized team, composed of Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant but immature detective, Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), a formidable investigator, Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), a sergeant both muscular and sensitive, and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), a perfectionist with a great heart. While the team needs to rethink its investigative methods, the investigations are going to be a little bit of a problem. Jake, with his sense of humour and sometimes awe-inspiring ideas, offers unexpected solutions to revive team spirit. This sixth season, marked by a strong fan mobilization after the Fox canceled, promises thrilling intrigues and hilarious moments of camaraderie.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the second season of the cult series progresses, tensions between the characters take an unexpected turn. Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), with his obsessional character and eccentric mania, is becoming increasingly difficult to manage for his entourage. Meanwhile, Penny (Kaley Cuoco), who recently broke up with Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki), gradually moved closer to the gang of friends. His passion for video games and science flourished, especially because of the arrival of a new seductive physicist, who only increased rivalry among boys. Leonard, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are plunged into a fierce scientific competition, while a joint project could unite them. However, this dynamic could also threaten their friendship with Penny, resulting in emotional dilemmas and difficult choices. This exciting season has captured more than ten million viewers in the United States.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

Leonard, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are plunged into a fierce scientific competition, while a joint project could unite them. However, this dynamic could also threaten their friendship with Penny, resulting in emotional dilemmas and difficult choices. This exciting season has captured more than ten million viewers in the United States.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Sabri and Jamel always have unlikely combinations to achieve their ends. Aymé, on her side, is ready to do anything to seduce a woman. Charlotte, Professor Strauss' very pretty daughter, arrives from the United States and starts working in the hospital. She's gonna become the three boys' favorite and fantasy. Her father still considers her a little girl when she's 25 years old. Sabri is still a bartender, not far from the hospital, and there are always mishaps in his bar. A third season of 20 episodes still as effective. Former Miss France Linda Hardy integrates casting into the role of Professor Strauss' daughter.

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: The fighters of the sky
programme.desc: Designed in the 1970s by Rockwell International, the B-1 Lancer is a supersonic, variable wing heavy bomber. Launched in 1986 to replace the aging B-52 Stratofortress, he became the main American strategic bomber. He was able to fly quickly at low altitude to penetrate hostile spaces, and participated in the Gulf wars of 1991 and 2003 with operational success.

programme.title: The fighters of the sky
programme.desc: Designed in the early 1950s, the Hawker Hunter was one of the best post-war combat aircraft and one of the greatest success stories of British aeronautics.

programme.title: Why do they hate us?
programme.desc: Director, screenwriter and actor, Gurwann Tran Van Gie has been taking on his homosexuality since he was 20 years old. In 2013, the violent homophobic reactions of supporters of the "Manif for All", whom he hears from his balcony, made him fear that he would be targeted for the first time. That year, attacks on homosexuals were sixfold. While returning to his path, Gurwann Tran Van Gie explores the roots of homophobia. He presents the work of the Contact Rhône association, which tries to maintain or renew the dialogue between lesbian, gay, bisexual, and their families. The association The Refuge, it collects the homosexual minors expelled by their parents, to number 1,000 each year.

programme.title: Gaza, an endless cycle
programme.desc: The third episode began in 1993, when Israel partially evacuated its military forces from the Gaza Strip under the Oslo agreements and Yasser Arafat took the lead in the Palestinian authority. The peace process was sabotaged by Israeli extremists, when Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin was assassinated by one of them in 1995, and by Palestinian extremists, Hamas, who were carrying out attacks on Israeli soil. In 2007, after the second intifada and the death of Yasser Arafat, Hamas took control of the Gaza Strip.

programme.title: Washington
programme.desc: George Washington, an ambitious young officer born in 1732 in a family of wealthy landowners, will change the face of the United States of America. First at the service of the British army, he suffered a devastating defeat against the French of General Lafayette. Back in Virginia, he became a tobacco planter, and was caught by politics and became Governor of Virginia. Amerged by his experience in the service of his majesty, he led the rebellion against London and was a major actor in American independence during the secession war.

programme.title: The War of the Thrones, the True History of Europe
programme.sub-title: Henry IV, to the conquest of the throne (1590-1594)
programme.desc: In 1589 Henry IV became the new king of France. But his coronation is disputed because he is Protestant. In the spring of 1590, Henri IV was led by the powerful Catholic League, which wanted to prevent him from joining his throne. - with his faithful advisor Sully - to get to his ends. When the king of Spain joined the French ultra-Catholics, he decided to convert.

programme.title: The War of the Thrones, the True History of Europe
programme.desc: In 1594 Henry IV was finally the legitimate king of France. To heal his country from the wounds caused by religious wars, the monarch devoted himself to restoring it. As for his love, he wished to marry his favorite, Gabrielle d'Estrées, and to make their son the heir to the throne of France. But for that, he must repudiate his wife, Queen Margot.

programme.title: Hitler: The Devil's Circle
programme.desc: From the putsch in Munich in 1923 to the defeat of the Third Reich in 1945, this series is interested in Hitler's close circle, which helped him take control of Germany.

programme.title: On the other side
programme.desc: In the snowy landscapes of the upper Doubs, the world of watchmaking is mixed with a devastating tragedy. Manon, a young apprentice promised a bright future at the Watch School, was found dead at the foot of a cliff, causing shock within her establishment. While the thesis of suicide seems the most plausible, many believe that the unbearable pressure to be the only girl in her promotion would have been right. However, Jeanne Keller (Alix Poisson), the Senior Education Advisor, refused to accept this version of the facts. Determined to discover the truth, Jeanne joins her friend Alice (Tiphaine Daviot), the local police officer, in an investigation that will plunge them into the dark meanderings of the watch industry. By exploring the well-kept rivalries and secrets of the artisans, they find themselves confronted with unexpected obstacles that test their friendship and determination. As they get closer to the truth, Jeanne and Alice have to navigate between personal and professional issues, while crossing the Swiss border, where the beauty of watches hides much deeper drama. programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: On the other side
programme.desc: A senior education counsellor and a friend of hers are investigating the death of a young apprentice who was attending a watch school.
programme.desc-more: In the snowy landscapes of the upper Doubs, the world of watchmaking is mixed with a devastating tragedy. Manon, a young apprentice promised a bright future at the Watch School, was found dead at the foot of a cliff, causing shock within her establishment. While the thesis of suicide seems the most plausible, many believe that the unbearable pressure to be the only girl in her promotion would have been right. However, Jeanne Keller (Alix Poisson), the Senior Education Advisor, refused to accept this version of the facts. Determined to discover the truth, Jeanne joins her friend Alice (Tiphaine Daviot), the local police officer, in an investigation that will plunge them into the dark meanderings of the watch industry. By exploring the well-kept rivalries and secrets of the artisans, they find themselves confronted with unexpected obstacles that test their friendship and determination. As they get closer to the truth, Jeanne and Alice have to navigate between personal and professional issues, while crossing the Swiss border, where the beauty of watches hides much deeper drama. The survey will lead them to discover a complex world where excellence and anguish are associated, revealing unsuspecting facets of those who work for time.

programme.title: On the other side
programme.desc: In the snowy landscapes of the upper Doubs, the world of watchmaking is mixed with a devastating tragedy. Manon, a young apprentice promised a bright future at the Watch School, was found dead at the foot of a cliff, causing shock within her establishment. While the thesis of suicide seems the most plausible, many believe that the unbearable pressure to be the only girl in her promotion would have been right. However, Jeanne Keller (Alix Poisson), the Senior Education Advisor, refused to accept this version of the facts. Determined to discover the truth, Jeanne joins her friend Alice (Tiphaine Daviot), the local police officer, in an investigation that will plunge them into the dark meanderings of the watch industry. By exploring the well-kept rivalries and secrets of the artisans, they find themselves confronted with unexpected obstacles that test their friendship and determination. As they get closer to the truth, Jeanne and Alice have to navigate between personal and professional issues, while crossing the Swiss border, where the beauty of watches hides much deeper drama. The survey will lead them to discover a complex world where excellence and anguish are associated, revealing unsuspecting facets of those who work for time.

programme.title: Candice Renoir
programme.desc: As Candice and Antoine come out of a movie session, a car suddenly runs into four young women, members of an association for battered women, who stick posters with the anti-femicide slogan: "She leaves him, he kills her". One of them, struck with full whip, is seriously injured. In the hospital, Candice meets the victim's mother who tells her that she was beaten by ex-husband. This confession revives the commander's unclosed wounds, including her own father, a violent but loving man.
programme.desc-more: One evening, while Candice Renoir (Cécile Bois) is about to enjoy a romantic evening in complete discretion with Hervé, an emergency call interrupts her moment of respite. A wheelchair man was found seriously injured after falling from one floor in a hotel, thus diving Candice into a delicate investigation. The victim, already weakened by leukemia, finds himself in a coma, leaving doubt about the circumstances of this accident. With the help of his twins, Candice embarks on a thorough investigation, seeking to unravel the true of the false in this disturbing affair. Between contradictory testimony and well-kept secrets, she must determine whether it is an act of despair, a tragic accident or an attempted or orchestrated murder. As the discoveries unfold, Candice faces challenges that lead him to reconsider his own values and face disturbing truths.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: A series of attacks, carried out in the same manner, intriguing Benson and Carisi. At each crime scene, DNA records are different.
programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Disappearance of concern
programme.desc: In Strasbourg, a cold day takes a tragic turn when nine students of a Protestant school mysteriously disappear during a visit to the majestic cathedral of the city. As anxiety grows, the child's mistress collapses and dies on the spot, leaving the community in disarray. No leads, no witnesses can provide clues about the fate of children, plunging the city into an atmosphere of tension and despair. Maya Rosetti (Sara Forestier), a young and determined commissioner, is responsible for this delicate investigation. However, to solve this mystery, she has to face her own demons by reconnecting with her ex-compagnon, a man who prefers to turn the page. In addition, the prosecutor, in disagreement with her methods, further complicates her work. In this fight against time, Maya will have to juggle her personal relationships with the professional stakes to find the missing children.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: Although they find it difficult to accept it, Herrmann and the members of Barracks 51 must find a replacement for one of their own, injured in an intervention.
programme.desc-more: In this new season full of tension and twists, the Chicago fire crew is facing a major crisis as a fire ravages their barracks. Chief Boden (Eamonn Walker), in disagreement with his team's opinions, made the bold decision to use water guns to control the situation, causing internal tensions. When Boden was replaced, firefighters Casey (Jesse Spencer), Brett (Kara Killmer) and Dawson (Monica Raymund) disagreed with the Chief's new directions. At the same time, Kidd (Miranda Rae Mayo) learns that she must be transferred to another barracks, raising concerns among her colleagues. Dawson's relationship with Casey is being tested, adding a layer of emotional complexity to this already challenging season. At the heart of the action, each character must navigate through difficult choices, thus revealing the strength and solidarity of this team of heroes of everyday life.

programme.title: Chicago Police Department
programme.desc: An infiltration operation within a drug cartel is more complicated and dangerous than expected. Voight pleads mercy for Ruzek.
programme.desc-more: In the tumultuous streets of Chicago, the Hank Voight (Jason Beghe) brigade continues to fight crime relentlessly. Determined to protect their city, the team members do not hesitate to cross the limits of legality to achieve their goals. However, this seventh season is marked by internal tensions, including the arrest of Ruzek (Patrick John Flueger) for professional misconduct and obstruction, an incident that challenges the team's loyalty and integrity. At the same time, Voight is in the spotlight as the main suspect in the murder of Brian Kelton, the recently elected mayor. As the internal affairs investigation is intensifying, each member of the team faces difficult choices and moral dilemmas. The arrival of new characters, including those performed by Anne Heche and Paul Adelstein, promises to add even more complexity to this season full of twists.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: FBI takes control of the barracks for a undercover mission. Casey and Severide are volunteers to help investigators.
programme.desc-more: In this new season full of tension and twists, the Chicago fire crew is facing a major crisis as a fire ravages their barracks. Chief Boden (Eamonn Walker), in disagreement with his team's opinions, made the bold decision to use water guns to control the situation, causing internal tensions. When Boden was replaced, firefighters Casey (Jesse Spencer), Brett (Kara Killmer) and Dawson (Monica Raymund) disagreed with the Chief's new directions. At the same time, Kidd (Miranda Rae Mayo) learns that she must be transferred to another barracks, raising concerns among her colleagues. Dawson's relationship with Casey is being tested, adding a layer of emotional complexity to this already challenging season. At the heart of the action, each character must navigate through difficult choices, thus revealing the strength and solidarity of this team of heroes of everyday life.

programme.title: Chicago Police Department
programme.desc: As the virus continues to spread throughout the city, the police identify a suspect and start a race against the clock to find him.
programme.desc-more: In the tumultuous streets of Chicago, the Hank Voight (Jason Beghe) brigade continues to fight crime relentlessly. Determined to protect their city, the team members do not hesitate to cross the limits of legality to achieve their goals. However, this seventh season is marked by internal tensions, including the arrest of Ruzek (Patrick John Flueger) for professional misconduct and obstruction, an incident that challenges the team's loyalty and integrity. At the same time, Voight is in the spotlight as the main suspect in the murder of Brian Kelton, the recently elected mayor. As the internal affairs investigation is intensifying, each member of the team faces difficult choices and moral dilemmas. The arrival of new characters, including those performed by Anne Heche and Paul Adelstein, promises to add even more complexity to this season full of twists.

programme.title: The Return of the Mummy
programme.desc: While they thought they had defeated Imhotep's terrible mummy ten years earlier, O'Connell's spouses were again confronted with the fearsome creature.

programme.title: The Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: To save her father and lift the curse that is on hers, a young girl, Belle, is forced to go live in the castle of a terrible Beast.
programme.desc-more: In a world where magic and reality intertwine, a rich merchant, traumatized by the loss of his wife, strives to ensure the happiness of his children. Unfortunately, a violent storm capsized his largest ship, plunged him into ruin and forced him to flee for his life. As he gets lost in a snow-covered forest, he discovers the refuge of a mysterious castle, whose walls hide countless treasures. His host, an enigmatic being (Vincent Cassel), granted him permission to take some presents for his beloved daughter, Belle (Léa Seydoux). However, in an innocent gesture, the merchant picks a rose to delight his daughter, which causes the anger of the owner of the place. This unexpected gesture has dramatic consequences, and the merchant must face the cruelty of an ancient curse. Beautiful, courageous and compassionate, soon finds itself at the heart of a struggle to bring redemption not only to herself, but also to the one she has inadvertently provoked. The stakes are increasing as the return to normality seems increasingly compromised, leading all the characters to intertwined and unpredictable destiny.

programme.title: Belphégor, the ghost of the Louvre
programme.desc: A mummy just discovered and exposed at the Louvre Museum is re-emerging by taking on the body and spirit of a young woman too curious.
programme.desc-more: In Paris, in the year 2000, the mystical atmosphere of the Louvre Museum was disturbed by the discovery of an ancient mummy, recently studied in the reserves. Lisa (Sophie Marceau), a young woman living in her late grandmother's apartment, finds herself in a contest of circumstances to come into contact with this mummy. Shortly after this encounter, strange events begin to occur around her, changing her behavior inexplicably. Nights at the museum are haunted by mysterious appearances and inexplicable phenomena that plunge the guards and staff into anguish. Meanwhile, the police inspector (Frédéric Diefenthal) and a famous Egyptologist (Michel Serrault) are launching an investigation to uncover the mystery of these disturbing events. As the border between the world of the living and the world of the dead fades, Lisa will have to discover the truth hidden behind the legend of Belphegor, a farce spirit that haunts the places.

programme.title: Grimm
programme.desc: Adalind, who lost her powers, gives birth to the baby she designed with Nick. She decides to call him Kelly, in memory of his mother. For Adalind and Nick, the priority is to protect their child. But there are many dangers, because the Wesen are ready to take power in Portland. Hank is also assigned a new partner. Rosalee, for her part, is confronted with the ghosts of her past. This fifth season is rising in intensity, with the arrival of new particularly dangerous enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the fantastic is close to everyday life, the series "Grimm" plunges spectators into a world of mythological creatures, the Wesen, who hide behind the faces of humans. Nick Burkhardt (David Giuntoli), a detective of the Portland police, discovers that he is the heir of a line of monster hunters called the Grimms. As he tried to reconcile his professional life with his new responsibilities, Nick found himself plunged into an ancestral conflict between the Wesen and the human. In this thrilling episode, tension rises as Renard's mother (Sasha Roiz) arrives at the hospital in a critical state, using her powers to try to save her son. Meanwhile, Adalind (Claire Coffee), who had successfully completed his mission in Austria, found himself trapped in Viktor Castle, which questioned his loyalty following the mysterious death of one of his agents. While Theresa (Bree Turner) follows a Wesen with tentacles, Monroe (Silas Weir Mitchell) and Rosalee (Bree Turner) are trying to find a way to restore Nick's powers, adding a layer of complexity to this struggle for survival. The stakes are increasing, and each character faces crucial choices, while the danger is around every corner, making their quest even more perilous.

programme.title: Journey to the center of the Earth
programme.desc: Scientists are lost somewhere under the Earth's surface, in order to rescue them an expedition is quickly organized. However, the rescuers find themselves in the centre of the Earth and discover a world that no one suspected existed. Although wonderful, this world is sipped with an aggressive and dangerous fauna and flora.

programme.title: The Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: In a world where magic and reality intertwine, a rich merchant, traumatized by the loss of his wife, strives to ensure the happiness of his children. Unfortunately, a violent storm capsized his largest ship, plunged him into ruin and forced him to flee for his life. As he gets lost in a snow-covered forest, he discovers the refuge of a mysterious castle, whose walls hide countless treasures. His host, an enigmatic being (Vincent Cassel), granted him permission to take some presents for his beloved daughter, Belle (Léa Seydoux). However, in an innocent gesture, the merchant picks a rose to delight his daughter, which causes the anger of the owner of the place. This unexpected gesture has dramatic consequences, and the merchant must face the cruelty of an ancient curse. Beautiful, courageous and compassionate, soon finds itself at the heart of a struggle to bring redemption not only to herself, but also to the one she has inadvertently provoked. The stakes are increasing as the return to normality seems increasingly compromised, leading all the characters to intertwined and unpredictable destiny.

programme.title: Belphégor, the ghost of the Louvre
programme.desc: A mummy just discovered and exposed at the Louvre Museum is re-emerging by taking on the body and spirit of a young woman too curious.
programme.desc-more: In Paris, in the year 2000, the mystical atmosphere of the Louvre Museum was disturbed by the discovery of an ancient mummy, recently studied in the reserves. Lisa (Sophie Marceau), a young woman living in her late grandmother's apartment, finds herself in a contest of circumstances to come into contact with this mummy. Shortly after this encounter, strange events begin to occur around her, changing her behavior inexplicably. Nights at the museum are haunted by mysterious appearances and inexplicable phenomena that plunge the guards and staff into anguish. Meanwhile, the police inspector (Frédéric Diefenthal) and a famous Egyptologist (Michel Serrault) are launching an investigation to uncover the mystery of these disturbing events. As the border between the world of the living and the world of the dead fades, Lisa will have to discover the truth hidden behind the legend of Belphegor, a farce spirit that haunts the places.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: For Phineas and Ferb, every day is a new adventure.
programme.desc-more: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: The recipe for disaster / Fracasse Maths
programme.desc: Gretel gets, along with his hamster, superpowers by aliens. They then become a duo of superheroes who devote themselves to protecting their city.
programme.desc-more: In this thrilling episode of "Hamster & Gretel", Kevin and Gretel face a major challenge: saving the family dinner that is going to be catastrophic. As tension rises in the kitchen, Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) faces a cowboy who is as unpredictable as he is fearsome, threatening to disrupt their plans. At the same time, their father, Dave (Matt Jones), is struggling to find the perfect birthday gift for Caroline (Liza Koshy), but his efforts seem doomed to failure. In a whirlwind of comedic events and unpredictable actions, the characters navigate between humour and thrills. The interactions between Kevin (Michael Cimino), Gretel and other family members bring a touch of emotion and camaraderie, while unexpected twists test their ingenuity and determination. This mixture of family adventure and comedy promises to captivate the public, while exploring the themes of responsibility and brotherly love.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: Heroic brotherly rivalry / The goat is a mystery!
programme.desc: Gretel gets, along with his hamster, superpowers by aliens. They then become a duo of superheroes who devote themselves to protecting their city.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the ordinary is close to the extraordinary, Hamster and Gretel, two brothers united by an unfailing bond, receive super powers from a mysterious race of aliens. While Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) embraces her new role as superhero with enthusiasm and determination, her brother Kevin (Michael Cimino), although not having received any powers, finds himself in a delicate position, acting as "collateral damage" to their adventures. While a meteorite threatens to crash into their city, a divergence of opinion is emerging between Kevin and Gretel on how best to deal with this imminent crisis. Kevin, a pragmatic, advocates a strategic approach, while Gretel, driven by his boldness, leans for direct intervention. This fraternal rivalry puts their relationship to the test, while they must learn to collaborate to save their community. Between humour, action and life lessons, this episode explores the complex dynamics between power, responsibility and family ties.

programme.sub-title: It's the pompon / La Cebolla's ballad

programme.desc-more: In a world where the extraordinary meets daily life, Hamster and Gretel, a dynamic duo, receive super powers from mysterious aliens, transforming their ordinary existence into a thrilling adventure. While Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) embraces her new heroic identity with enthusiasm, her brother Kevin (Michael Cimino) accidentally finds himself as collateral damage, juggling with the reality of an ordinary teenager facing extraordinary situations. As a threatening meteorite approaches the Earth, the two protagonists disagree on how best to stop it. Gretel advocates a bold and heroic approach, while Kevin, more cautious, puts forward pragmatic solutions. This conflict puts their fraternal relationship to the test, pushing them to understand that collaboration is essential to overcome the challenges. With a touch of humour and adventure, this episode explores the themes of friendship, responsibility and differences of opinion in a heroic context.

With a touch of humour and adventure, this episode explores the themes of friendship, responsibility and differences of opinion in a heroic context.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: Far from his native campaign, Cricket Green learned how to adapt to life in a big city, where he moved with his family. But integration is not a rest.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Marieve Herington) finds himself facing a serious creative block as he prepares to celebrate the traditional April Fish. He was accustomed to being the band's farcer, and felt compelled by the pressure to concoct a memorable joke, which plunged him into a state of growing frustration. Meanwhile, Bill (Chris Houghton), his father's protector, hides a secret from his mischievous daughter, Tilly (Artemis Pebdani), who convinced her that everything was fine as he struggled with his own concerns. As preparations for this day of jokes intensify, family tensions rise and hidden truths begin to emerge. Between Cricket's attempts to overcome his blockage and Bill's lies that threaten to change everything, this episode explores the themes of creativity, trust and family relations, all in a humorous and touching setting.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: The SuperChatons and the takeoff of Rashtuuse / The SuperChatons and the Jewel of Heaven
programme.desc: If a problem occurs in the fictitious city of Kittydale, four cute little cats instantly become superheroes with special skills and are ready to help their fellow citizens at any time. Their mission is to show that even the most difficult problem can be solved with good behavior and kindness.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "SuperChatons", the heroine Polaris (Emma Berman), dreams of becoming the first Astro-chat to lay its legs on the moon. However, Rastic (Dee Bradley Baker), a determined rival, is determined to fail his ambitious project. To counter the plans of Rastic, the SuperChatons, a group of united and courageous friends, are mobilizing. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover that Zsa-Zsa (Carmen Carter), a malicious kitten, stole a precious stone from the local museum, a gem known for its extraordinary powers. The SuperChatons must then juggle between Polaris protection and the recovery of the stolen gem. With challenges that test their friendship and ingenuity, they engage in a thrilling adventure that will lead them to unexpected discoveries about themselves and the true value of friendship.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: With a sincere and amusing look at the life of a modern family, this series boasts the merits of the creative imagination that helps children develop well. Bluey is an Australian dog with an unlimited imagination. She makes family life a daily and fun adventure. With her little sister Bingo, she explores the world around them through the game. They free themselves from their fears and tried to become great people. Nothing amuses them more than to train their parents, especially their father, in their entertainment. Chilli, their mother, works outside and Bandit, their father, at home to look after them but her authority is put to the test when the girls decide to make him play in the comedy they invented!
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Iron Man and his incredible friends
programme.sub-title: Wonders of Wakanda / Thor and Loki race
programme.desc: The adventures of the best friends and superhero, Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho, while they team up to protect their city. To help them in their missions, they each have their own Iron Suit that allows them to fly and to give each of them a great strength. They develop their plans from their HQ, driven by the powerful android Vision, and accompanied by their own Gamma puppy, which has its own super-combination and accompanies the Iron Friends in their adventures.
programme.desc-more: Follow the adventures (and misadventures) of Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho, three best friends and super geniuses, who work together to solve problems, both big and small, and protect their city.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.sub-title: Ock's Obedience Ray / Lemurian at Freedom
programme.desc: Spidey, our favourite flyer, joins Ghost-Spider (Gwen Stacey) and Miles Morales to form the Spidey team. They will all be assisted by Trace-E, the amusing and faithful Spider-robot of Spidey. And if Spidey finds himself in a difficult situation that requires even more superpowers, no doubt a friend of Avenger will rush to help him. Whether the Spidey team acts alone or assisted by an Avenger, these superheroes will join forces to save the situation! Some flashing sequences or light patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In the small town of Danville, in the U.S. state of Virginia, Phineas and Ferb Fletcher, two half-brothers, are bored. To deceive their disloyalty, they embark on inventions that are more abrasive than each other. Their big sister, Candice, is watching their constructions with caution.
programme.desc-more: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are just adorable kittens that share their time between snoring and snoring in Purr 'N' Play. But when troubles come, they turn into... super-chatons! Re-establishing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet is designed to protect animals and the inhabitants of Kittydale from the bad guys like Mr. Puppypaws, Lab Rat, Cat Burglar and Zsa-Zsa. Thanks to their superpowers, their cat-martred gadgets and, above all, their kindness and empathy, the SuperChatons make the world a better and more cat-like place.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and lively world, the SuperChatons, a group of fearless and resourceful kittens, find themselves confronted with an unexpected situation when Bitsy, one of their members, causes an incident by accidentally cloned with the help of an invention by Rastic. Bitsy's clones, though cute, turn out to be little troublemakers, sowing disorder and making the daily life of the SuperChatons chaotic. In the face of this crisis, the team must show solidarity and ingenuity to thwart the clones' plans and restore order in their neighbourhood. At the same time, Zsa-Zsa, a bold SuperChaton, embarks on an unexpected adventure by flying the Super-Robochaton. She hopes to escape the intense training she fears so much. This mix of humour and action will test the team spirit of the SuperChatons, who will have to overcome their differences to save their friend and regain harmony.

programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: With a sincere and amusing look at the life of a modern family, this series boasts the merits of the creative imagination that helps children develop well. Bluey is an Australian dog with an unlimited imagination. She makes family life a daily and fun adventure. With her little sister Bingo, she explores the world around them through the game. They free themselves from their fears and tried to become great people. Nothing amuses them more than to train their parents, especially their father, in their entertainment. Chilli, their mother, works outside and Bandit, their father, at home to look after them but her authority is put to the test when the girls decide to make him play in the comedy they invented!
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In the small town of Danville, in the U.S. state of Virginia, Phineas and Ferb Fletcher, two half-brothers, are bored. To deceive their disloyalty, they embark on inventions that are more abrasive than each other. Their big sister, Candice, is watching their constructions with caution.
programme.desc-more: In this thrilling episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the famous summer brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decide to put on capes and turn into a superhero to live an epic adventure. With the help of their friend Isabella Garcia-Shapiro (Ashley Tisdale), they commit to fighting evil and protecting their city from dangers. However, their enthusiasm attracts the attention of a formidable super villain, Dr. Doofenshmirtz (voice of Dan Povenmire), who has his own Machiavellical plans in mind. As tension rises, young heroes must not only use their ingenuity to thwart the plans of the naughty, but also learn to work together to overcome the challenges that lie on their way. In a series of hilarious battles and nasty situations, they will discover that true power lies in friendship and collaboration.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: The recipe for disaster / Fracasse Maths
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Hamster & Gretel", Kevin and Gretel face a major challenge: saving the family dinner that is going to be catastrophic. As tension rises in the kitchen, Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) faces a cowboy who is as unpredictable as he is fearsome, threatening to disrupt their plans. At the same time, their father, Dave (Matt Jones), is struggling to find the perfect birthday gift for Caroline (Liza Koshy), but his efforts seem doomed to failure. In a whirlwind of comedic events and unpredictable actions, the characters navigate between humour and thrills. The interactions between Kevin (Michael Cimino), Gretel and other family members bring a touch of emotion and camaraderie, while unexpected twists test their ingenuity and determination. This mixture of family adventure and comedy promises to captivate the public, while exploring the themes of responsibility and brotherly love.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: Heroic brotherly rivalry / The goat is a mystery!
programme.desc: In a world where the ordinary is close to the extraordinary, Hamster and Gretel, two brothers united by an unfailing bond, receive super powers from a mysterious race of aliens. While Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) embraces her new role as superhero with enthusiasm and determination, her brother Kevin (Michael Cimino), although not having received any powers, finds himself in a delicate position, acting as "collateral damage" to their adventures. While a meteorite threatens to crash into their city, a divergence of opinion is emerging between Kevin and Gretel on how best to deal with this imminent crisis. Kevin, a pragmatic, advocates a strategic approach, while Gretel, driven by his boldness, leans for direct intervention. This fraternal rivalry puts their relationship to the test, while they must learn to collaborate to save their community. Between humour, action and life lessons, this episode explores the complex dynamics between power, responsibility and family ties.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: It's the pompon / La Cebolla's ballad
programme.desc: In a world where the extraordinary meets daily life, Hamster and Gretel, a dynamic duo, receive super powers from mysterious aliens, transforming their ordinary existence into a thrilling adventure. While Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) embraces her new heroic identity with enthusiasm, her brother Kevin (Michael Cimino) accidentally finds himself as collateral damage, juggling with the reality of an ordinary teenager facing extraordinary situations. As a threatening meteorite approaches the Earth, the two protagonists disagree on how best to stop it. Gretel advocates a bold and heroic approach, while Kevin, more cautious, puts forward pragmatic solutions. This conflict puts their fraternal relationship to the test, pushing them to understand that collaboration is essential to overcome the challenges. With a touch of humour and adventure, this episode explores the themes of friendship, responsibility and differences of opinion in a heroic context.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Marieve Herington) finds himself facing a serious creative block as he prepares to celebrate the traditional April Fish. He was accustomed to being the band's farcer, and felt compelled by the pressure to concoct a memorable joke, which plunged him into a state of growing frustration. Meanwhile, Bill (Chris Houghton), his father's protector, hides a secret from his mischievous daughter, Tilly (Artemis Pebdani), who convinced her that everything was fine as he struggled with his own concerns. As preparations for this day of jokes intensify, family tensions rise and hidden truths begin to emerge. Between Cricket's attempts to overcome his blockage and Bill's lies that threaten to change everything, this episode explores the themes of creativity, trust and family relations, all in a humorous and touching setting.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: The SuperChatons and the takeoff of Rashtuuse / The SuperChatons and the Jewel of Heaven
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "SuperChatons", the heroine Polaris (Emma Berman), dreams of becoming the first Astro-chat to lay its legs on the moon. However, Rastic (Dee Bradley Baker), a determined rival, is determined to fail his ambitious project. To counter the plans of Rastic, the SuperChatons, a group of united and courageous friends, are mobilizing. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover that Zsa-Zsa (Carmen Carter), a malicious kitten, stole a precious stone from the local museum, a gem known for its extraordinary powers. The SuperChatons must then juggle between Polaris protection and the recovery of the stolen gem. With challenges that test their friendship and ingenuity, they engage in a thrilling adventure that will lead them to unexpected discoveries about themselves and the true value of friendship.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Once again, Mickey and his friends solve a mystery on Ice Cream Day. With a magnifying glass, a rhinoceros, an ostrich and Molly the mallet, they all manage to clarify the situation.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Lego Disney The Snow Queen: Bird Retribution
programme.desc: After the events of \" The Snow Queen \", Anna and Elsa want to take a new start in Arendelle and make the castle a little more comfortable. As they struggle to free themselves from the constraints of tradition, the Duke of Weselton, who surrounded himself with a cloud of threatening macaroons, has other plans for their beautiful home.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and lively world, the SuperChatons, a group of fearless and resourceful kittens, find themselves confronted with an unexpected situation when Bitsy, one of their members, causes an incident by accidentally cloned with the help of an invention by Rastic. Bitsy's clones, though cute, turn out to be little troublemakers, sowing disorder and making the daily life of the SuperChatons chaotic. In the face of this crisis, the team must show solidarity and ingenuity to thwart the clones' plans and restore order in their neighbourhood. At the same time, Zsa-Zsa, a bold SuperChaton, embarks on an unexpected adventure by flying the Super-Robochaton. She hopes to escape the intense training she fears so much. This mix of humour and action will test the team spirit of the SuperChatons, who will have to overcome their differences to save their friend and regain harmony.

programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: Thanks to the monster mother, our heroes now know how to free Bobby from his curse. This involves a complex ritual that requires a long list of strange ingredients. Doug, determined to help Bobby, decides he'll be the one who will perform the incantation that will separate Mordam's and Bobby's souls. He sent the team to look for the ingredients needed for the ritual, but Mordam sent his army of evil shadows to stop them. It's a race against the clock as they all fight for Bobby's life.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

This evil feline, endowed with a formidable intelligence and an eccentric personality, plots to take control of the city. To top it all off, Hamster and Gretel also have to face a formidable mid-horse mid-man opponent, an extravagant character who loves to party and who does not hesitate to use his charism to manipulate the inhabitants. Together, Hamster and Gretel will have to join forces and show courage to thwart the plans of these naughty people. Between thrilling adventures and moments of camaraderie, this episode promises to be rich in twists and lessons on friendship and teamwork.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: In a world where adventure and humour are interspersed, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) and Gretel (Liza Koshy) face a major challenge: saving the school's end-of-year prom. As preparations are full, a mutant eel is emerging, sowing chaos and panic among students. Hamster, always ready to face the challenges with his daring spirit, joins Gretel in defeating the plans of this extraordinary aquatic creature. With the help of their friends, including comic Beck Bennett, they are developing an ingenious plan to neutralize the eel while preserving the festive spirit of the ball. However, obstacles are increasing, and our heroes will have to show courage and determination to restore order and ensure that this memorable evening is not ruined. Friendship and solidarity will be tested in this thrilling and hilarious adventure.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: The Counterfeit of Intelligence / Bailey's Birthday
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Hamster & Gretel", the world of social networks takes an unexpected turn when Churro, Gretel's faithful companion (Melissa Povenmire), becomes a viral sensation on the Internet. His adorable frascism and his appealing personality attract the attention of the netizens, propelling Churro in the spotlight in a way he would never have imagined. Meanwhile, Gretel finds himself overwhelmed by preparations for his friend Bailey's birthday. Between the challenges of organizing the party, managing its daily responsibilities and the unforeseen events of Churro's sudden celebrity, Gretel must skillfully juggle with its priorities. As the party approaches, tensions rise and the situation gets rough, testing Gretel's friendship and creativity. This episode combines humour and tenderness, providing an insight into the life of a young heroine in the face of the vagaries of popularity and friendship.

As the city prepares for a neighbourhood party, the two competitors, always looking for new ideas to spice up their daily life, decide to make a memorable joke that quickly escapes their control. What begins as a simple joke turns into a real chaos, leading the inhabitants into a spiral of comic rivalries and misunderstandings. Meanwhile, the neighbourhood, caught in the effervescence of this unexpected event, has to face some nasty situations, ranging from the impossibility of moving to hilarious confrontations between neighbours. Tensions rise as each seeks to restore order, but the spirit of comradeship and humour eventually prevails, transforming this discord into an unexpected celebration of the community.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and holes very disturbing / SuperChatons and the Pieuvre-Robot
programme.desc: In a colorful and lively world, the SuperChatons, brave felines with extraordinary talents, are facing a major challenge. Mr. Petites-Pattes, a cunning antagonist, threatens to transform the track of the Folie-course into a real disaster field by digging holes everywhere. The SuperChatons, united by their team spirit and determination, commit themselves to prevent this imminent catastrophe. At the same time, Bitsy, one of the SuperChatons, feels a deep sense of insecurity when Sparks, another team member, receives an impressive upgrade that makes him super fast. This technological evolution transforms it into a crucial asset to counter the PPE-Robot, a formidable mechanical creature that sows chaos on their way. As the SuperChatons traveled through this exciting adventure, they learned the importance of collaboration, trust and acceptance of changes within their group dynamics, while fighting to save their precious track.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Play it like Doofenshmirtz / Doofenshmirtz in series
programme.desc: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Iron Man and his incredible friends
programme.sub-title: Not so fast, Captain America! / Ironheart's incredible playground
programme.desc: Follow the adventures (and misadventures) of Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho, three best friends and super geniuses, who work together to solve problems, both big and small, and protect their city.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Princess Sofia: Magical apprentice
programme.desc: For his first day at the Royal Magic School, Sofia teamed up with new friends to win a race and received the magical visit of Rapunce.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.sub-title: You see me, you see me more / Meeting with Squirrel Girl
programme.desc: Spidey, our favourite flyer, joins Ghost-Spider (Gwen Stacey) and Miles Morales to form the Spidey team. They will all be assisted by Trace-E, the amusing and faithful Spider-robot of Spidey. And if Spidey finds himself in a difficult situation that requires even more superpowers, no doubt a friend of Avenger will rush to help him. Whether the Spidey team acts alone or assisted by an Avenger, these superheroes will join forces to save the situation! Some flashing sequences or light patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Vampirina : The vampire teen
programme.desc: Vee left Transylvania to integrate a boarding school and to get closer to her musical dream. But by concealing her vampire nature, she finds herself confronted with unforeseen events that risk re-immerse her in the darkness.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: Billie, a young and powerful witch at the centre of a mysterious prophecy, is sent to the mortal world with the only sorcerer teacher who can help her master her powers, Justin Russo.

programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: Bobby and Romy are back at the megalith, hoping to cancel Bobby's curse. But things go wrong when a marsh monster chases them. Worse still, they're being chased by a fierce warrior, who thinks Bobby's curse makes him a threat. They're looking for answers from the mysterious lighthouse guard. Bobby and Romy have to face their double opponents and find a solution before the end of the time.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of the animated series, Irving, Phineas's best friend and Ferb, finds himself in the grip of a surprising revelation. Convinced by his older brother Albert of the existence of the famous inventors, he set out on a quest to meet them. However, upon his arrival, he found only Buford (Bader) and Baljeet (Baker), leaving his expectations outstanding. Meanwhile, Candice, Phineas's sister and Ferb, is developing a bold plan to expose her brothers and prove to their mother their countless farfelus projects. She trains her friends Stacy (Stoner) and Jenny in a commando demasking operation, mixing trick and determination. As the two intrigues cross, humour and absurdity take precedence over reality, creating a series of nasty and unexpected situations. This episode promises hilarious twists and unforgettable moments of camaraderie.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: The giant drop of water / Where is Pinky?
programme.desc: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Gloria (Marieve Herington) finds herself stuck in a broken elevator with the Green family, composed of eccentric and colorful members. As the situation becomes more and more tense, each of the family members, starting with the hilarious patriarch, reveals secrets and hidden tensions. The exchanges between Gloria and the Greens reveal unexpected facets of their personality, oscillating between humour and moments of deep reflection. As time passes, characters have to face their differences and find common ground to overcome this delicate situation. Vivid dialogues and quiproquos bring lightness to this challenge, while providing an overview of the family dynamics that govern the lives of the Greens. This episode promises laughter and revelations, while capturing the essence of urban life in Big City.
