programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: The Cauchemarionette / The world of Abuelita
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Hamster & Gretel", our young heroes find themselves confronted with a formidable super naughty, who exploits the deep fears of the inhabitants of their city to sow terror. The latter, a skilled manipulator, turns anxiety into real nightmares, making the fight against him all the more personal. Meanwhile, Gretel's grandmother (Melissa Povenmire) and Kevin (Michael Cimino) arrived to look after the children, but she imposed strict rules that made their mission difficult. His authority and high expectations are opposed to Gretel's free and fearless spirit and his faithful companion, Hamster. While the duo tries to reconcile their superhero life with family constraints, they must navigate between the challenges of their heroic quest and the rules imposed by their grandmother, creating a hilarious mix of unexpected situations and dramatic tension.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: I'm bored / The Cute and the Beast
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Hamster & Gretel", Kevin and his faithful companion Hamster meet in front of a terrible super naughty who threatens their peaceful city. While Kevin is trying to thwart the Machiavellical plans of this new antagonist, Gretel, Kevin's sister, is dedicated to seemingly banal domestic tasks, but which may well prove more crucial than they seem. The situation takes an unexpected turn when Hamster and Gretel face a giant otter, an unexpected challenge that not only tests their skills as superheroes, but also their brotherly bond. With humour and action, this episode explores the themes of friendship, courage and responsibility, while highlighting the unique talents of each of the characters. Kevin, Hamster and Gretel's adventures show that even in the most ordinary moments, heroism can arise in a surprising way.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: What's happening in Vegas part 1 / What's happening in Vegas, part 2
programme.desc: The Grant-Gomez family is embarking on a thrilling adventure in Las Vegas, where the excitement of the City of Lights promises unforgettable moments. Dave (Michael Cimino) and Carolina (Melissa Povenmire) take advantage of this getaway to reflect on their children-free lives, a theme that drives them to explore their personal relationships and aspirations. Meanwhile, their children, Kevin (Beck Bennett), Hamster and Gretel, face a major challenge that will put their ingenuity and team spirit to the test. By immerse themselves in the flamboyant universe of Las Vegas, they discover crazy situations and colorful characters, while overcoming unexpected obstacles. Between dazzling shows and unexpected encounters, this getaway will teach them valuable lessons about family, friendship and growing up, while sailing through the trials and joys that life holds for them.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: Santa Claus chocolate / Happiness is in the Pre
programme.desc: In the middle of summer, Big City's small town is preparing to host an outdoor festival, promising laughter and festivities. However, Cricket (Marieve Herington), in charge of the famous chocolate Santa Claus for Bill (Bob Joles), is facing a major challenge: creating a new chocolate that will capture the festive spirit while meeting the expectations of the community. While she hopes to enjoy a peaceful weekend in the countryside at Grandma's (Artemis Pebdani), her plans are disturbed by the effervescence of the festival that attracts a bigarrée crowd. Between chaotic preparations and unexpected interactions with visitors, Cricket must juggle with the pressure of his responsibilities and the desire to please his family. This weekend promises to become a memorable adventure, where creativity and tradition intertwine, and where each character plays a key role in this summer celebration.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: Hard decision / You win, I win
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Christopher Houghton) is confronted with a personal crisis when his girlfriend decides to break up with him. Determined to win her back, he embarked on a process of personal transformation, striving to become a better man. Meanwhile, Bill (Bob Joles), his competitive friend, jealously observed Cricket's progress. Bill's obsession with victory led him to compete with Cricket in all aspects of their lives, even defying his friend on a variety of activities, whether it was sports or everyday challenges. This friendly competition quickly turns into a wild race, where personal and emotional issues are mixed. As the trials progressed, the two friends discovered that the true meaning of victory lay not only in success, but also in friendship and mutual understanding.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and the Zsa-Zsa tube / SuperChatons and Pickles picnic
programme.desc: In the charming town of Kittydale, Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are not just kittens: they are the SuperChatons, a feline quartet with superpowers dedicated to protecting the inhabitants and animals of their community. When a new threat is emerging on the horizon with the arrival of Zsa-Zsa, a cunning antagonist, the SuperChatons must unite their forces to face this new challenge. Between their adventures in the Purr 'N' Play space and their heroic getaways, the four friends show courage and empathy to correct the wrongs and defend the oppressed. Armed with cat-martre gadgets and their sense of justice, they embark on thrilling missions that lead them to meet formidable enemies such as Mr. Puppypaws and Lab Rat. In this magical world full of surprises, kindness and friendship are the real superpowers that allow them to overcome obstacles and make Kittydale a more warm and welcoming place.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette wants to make sure that Alix can spend her birthday with her friends and family. But a super-villain of a new kind will upset his plans.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: Kiff/Kiff's mix at the flying school
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Kiff", Kiff (Kimiko Glenn) makes an unexpected discovery by inadvertently creating the perfect cereal mix, a feat that does not go unnoticed. Desiring to reproduce this magical recipe, she surrounds herself with her friends, Barry (Michael Croner) and Trevor, to try to recreate this delicious concoction. However, Kiff also feels the need to prove his worth to his comrades, particularly Beryl and his group of friends. To do this, she makes a bold decision by enrolling in the flying school, a place where she hopes to gain credibility and respect. As lessons and challenges go on, Kiff finds himself confronted with unexpected situations that test not only his driving skills, but also his friendship with Barry and Trevor. This episode highlights themes of determination, camaraderie and the quest for acceptance, while keeping a touch of humour and adventure.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. This episode explores the themes of friendship, rivalry and redefinition of self within a complex and fascinating urban environment.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

Meanwhile, Professor Exclamation (Beck Bennett) attends a meeting of former students, where memories and rivalries resurface, adding a comical and nostalgic dimension to the episode. This confrontation between good and evil, combined with Gretel's discovery of oneself, promises exciting moments and valuable lessons about friendship and courage.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: Too many bad guys / Fred President
programme.desc: In a world where children's imagination is coming to life, Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) finds herself facing a formidable villain who can multiply at will, sowing chaos in her neighbourhood. This new antagonist, both clever and elusive, puts to the test the skills and bravery of Gretel, who must unite his strength with his brother, the heroic hamster, to counter this growing threat. Meanwhile, Fred (Michael Cimino), with the energy and determination that characterize him, decides to start the race for the presidency of the student body. His ambitions lead him into a series of hilarious and unexpected adventures, as he tries to seduce his comrades with farfetched promises and innovative ideas. As Gretel fights against the bad guy and Fred strives to become the leader of his peers, their paths cross a journey full of twists, friendships and life lessons.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", a documentary on nature reveals the mysteries of Big City, portrayed as a wild and vibrant ecosystem. At the heart of this adventure, Rémy (Chris Houghton), a passionate collector, finds himself in a crisis of existential existence when he discovers that his friend Cricket (Marieve Herington) has taken hold of the rarest and most coveted collection map of all. This moment of revelation triggers a series of reflections on Rémy's devouring passion for collectibles and human relations. As he tries to overcome this disappointment, he embarks on a frantic quest to prove his worth and regain his place in the world of collectors. This episode explores the themes of friendship, rivalry and redefinition of self within a complex and fascinating urban environment.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: The meaning of the dollar / The true cry
programme.desc: To prove to his parents that he has a true sense of business, Rémy (Chris Houghton) embarks on the entrepreneurial adventure by setting up his own business. This initiative, though ambitious, is in reality a deep need for recognition and affection from his family. At the same time, Bill (Zeno Robinson), feeling neglected and isolated, seeks comfort from a group of ravens, establishing an unexpected connection with these malicious birds. As Rémy tries to navigate the complex world of business, he discovers the challenges of responsibility and the trials of failure. Bill, for his part, finds a form of camaraderie in this singular friendship, offering him a new insight into the notion of family and belonging. Both characters, each in their own way, will have to learn to overcome their feelings of loneliness and redefine what it really means to be surrounded by those they love.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and Toy Theft / SuperChatons and Lights Off
programme.desc: In the colourful world of Féliville, the SuperChatons, a group of brave and clever young felines, embark on an essential mission to save dog toys. Their sworn enemy, Mr. Petites-Pattes, a cunning and clever rodent, has concocted a diabolical plan to steal all the city's toys, thus threatening the joy of the dogs of Féliville. As the SuperChatons team mobilizes to counter its plans, another challenge is presented: Rastic, a mysterious creature, decided to turn off all the lights in the city. In total darkness, Bitsy (Emma Berman), one of the SuperChatons, must overcome his fear of the dark. By facing her fears, she discovers her inner strength and proves that even in the darkest moments, friendship and courage can triumph. Together, the SuperChatons join forces to restore light and protect toys, while discovering the value of teamwork and bravery.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+", Minnie (Kaitlyn Robrock) decides to surprise her friends by making beautiful colorful backpacks, each specially designed for their needs. Enthusiasmous by this creation, Mickey (Bret Iwan), Dingo (Bill Farmer), and their companions embark on an exciting adventure towards the majestic Falaise Dingo. On their way, they face fun challenges that require the use of their Maxi-tools, a collection of clever tools that help them overcome obstacles. Dingo, in particular, is brave and ingenuity when using his skills to climb the cliff and capture a memorable moment with his camera. This episode teaches young spectators the importance of friendship, creativity and collaboration, while offering a joyous adventure full of laughter and discoveries. The characters, full of energy, remind children that every challenge can be overcome together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the Miraculous series, the adventures of Ladybug and Chat Noirs, with Anouck Oboe, Benjamin Bollen, Antoine Tomé
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: DJ Eleven Thirty / A Summer at the Town Hall
programme.desc: In this episode of the series "Kiff", Kiff (Kimiko Glenn) and his friend Barry (Michael Croner) find themselves immersed in an intriguing adventure as they decide to investigate the mysterious absences of their comrade Harry. Intrigued by his frequent egresses during the classes, they are determined to discover the truth. At the same time, Kiff and Barry are getting a summer job at Table Town City Hall, where they are eager to contribute to the well-being of their community. Their enthusiasm is tested as they face unexpected challenges, meeting citizens with varied and sometimes baffled concerns. By sailing through bureaucratic intrigues and quiproquos, they learn the importance of civic commitment and friendship. This mix of humour and adventure highlights the perpetencies of a summer that promises to be as rewarding as it is entertaining for both young investigators.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: As Kim is now at peace with the upsetting truth of the history of his origins, Bobby and Romy decide to make him discover the world and teach him to be a real \" \" teenager. They're heading for the arcade game room, but things are turning vinegar, when Mordam sends a bad zombie fisherman and his army of zombie fish to eliminate Bobby. They're gonna have to work together if they want to get out of it alive... Even if it means teaming up with the tyrannical spoiled kids of Ouimper.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette and Adrien have become real friends, but to admit her feelings remains a puzzle, especially with Kagami increasingly present in Adrien's daily life. Lila resurfaces in college, still as lying, and discovers that Marinette has unmasked her. Ladybug and Chat Noir, armed with new powers and backed by teammates ready to intervene, face a more formidable Butterfly than ever. Season 3 puts heroes to the test: more power, more bad ones and secrets to protect on a daily basis.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+", Minnie (Kaitlyn Robrock) decides to surprise her friends by making beautiful colorful backpacks, each specially designed for their needs. Enthusiasmous by this creation, Mickey (Bret Iwan), Dingo (Bill Farmer), and their companions embark on an exciting adventure towards the majestic Falaise Dingo. On their way, they face fun challenges that require the use of their Maxi-tools, a collection of clever tools that help them overcome obstacles. Dingo, in particular, is brave and ingenuity when using his skills to climb the cliff and capture a memorable moment with his camera. This episode teaches young spectators the importance of friendship, creativity and collaboration, while offering a joyous adventure full of laughter and discoveries. The characters, full of energy, remind children that every challenge can be overcome together.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Spidey and his extraordinary friends", the team of young heroes manages to foil a Machiavellical plan orchestrated by the infamous Octopus, who was trying to achieve a daring break. Frustrated by the outcome of their confrontation, the team members, in a furious spirit, get rid of the villain's tentacular costume, leaving an opportunity for the fearsome Rhino to take over. As the situation becomes increasingly perilous, Spidey (Justin Shenkarow) finds himself distracted by an unexpected event: his pumpkin, initially harmless, turns into a surprising threat. This unexpected change has hilarious and dangerous consequences, forcing Spidey and his friends to juggle their superhero responsibilities with the management of this new crisis. By confronting both Rhino and mutant pumpkin, the team will have to show solidarity and creativity to restore order and protect their neighbourhood.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: Thanks to the monster mother, our heroes now know how to free Bobby from his curse. This involves a complex ritual that requires a long list of strange ingredients. programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Boys Against Girls / The Comet of Kermilian
programme.desc: For Phineas and Ferb, every day is a new adventure.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the rivalry between boys and girls reaches its climax in an epic match to determine who, of both sexes, is the best. Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and his brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) join their friends in taking up this challenge. Meanwhile, their sister Candice (Ashley Tisdale) and his classmates are preparing to prove that the girls are undeniably superior. The stakes rise as each team sets in place bold strategies, juggling friendly competition and fierce rivalry. At the same time, Phineas and Ferb are embarking on an ambitious project: the construction of a giant observatory to follow the passage of comet Kermilian. With the help of Alyson Stoner and other friends, they transform their garden into a true astronomical observation centre, combining science and fun. The two intrigues cross, promising moments of laughter, adventure and team spirit.

Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: Valerian and Laureline
programme.desc: Valerian and Laureline are contacted by the Shinguz, who offer them a simple and very well paid mission: to recover the sacred amphora of Fulbok.
programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: A few years earlier, Kerubim created the agency SOS Aventures, specialized in the design and realization of "real false" adventures.
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. programme.title: Valerian and Laureline
programme.desc: By looking for spare parts for his ship, Valerian meets Roger, an android. This robot was designed by a Vlagos-scientist.
programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.desc-more: On the advice of a friend, the young d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover), full of passion and ambition, leaves his native Gascony to join Paris with the hope of serving the King and becoming a Musketeer. Upon his arrival, he discovered a capital full of dangers and conspiracies, where honour and loyalty were often put to the test. His dreams of greatness were quickly darkened by a difficult reality: the rivalry between the Musketeers, the court plotters and the machinations of Cardinal de Richelieu, who sought to destabilize the kingdom. On the way, d'Artagnan became friends with the famous Musketeers, Athos (Jesús Nieto), Porthos (Manuel Peiró) and Aramis (Rafael de Penagos), who taught him the values of camaraderie and bravery. But while d'Artagnan tries to prove his worth, he must also navigate in a world where imposture and betrayal reign as masters.

programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.
